title: Leviticus 22:3
text: Say unto them, Every one of all your seed, throughout your generations, that approacheth the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:4
text: Whatsoever man of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a flux, he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. And he that toucheth any one that is unclean by a dead person, or a man whose seed of copulation hath passed from him;

title: Leviticus 22:5
text: or a man that toucheth any crawling thing whereby he becometh unclean, or a man by whom he may become unclean, whatever may be his uncleanness,

title: Leviticus 22:6
text: --a person that toucheth any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things; but he shall bathe his flesh with water,

title: Leviticus 22:7
text: and when the sun goeth down, he shall be clean, and may afterwards eat of the holy things; for it is his food.

title: Leviticus 22:8
text: Of a dead carcase and what is torn shall he not eat, to make himself unclean therewith: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:9
text: And they shall keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die by it, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who do hallow them.

title: Leviticus 22:10
text: ¶And no stranger shall eat the holy thing; the sojourner with the priest, and the hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

title: Leviticus 22:11
text: But if a priest buy any one for money, he may eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they may eat of his food.

title: Leviticus 22:12
text: And a priest's daughter who is [married] to a stranger may not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.

title: Leviticus 22:13
text: But a priest's daughter that becometh a widow, or is divorced, and hath no seed, and returneth unto her father's house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food; but no stranger shall eat thereof.

title: Leviticus 22:14
text: And if a man eat of a holy thing through inadvertence, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

title: Leviticus 22:15
text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel which they offer unto Jehovah,

title: Leviticus 22:16
text: and cause them to bear the iniquity of trespass when they eat their holy things; for I am Jehovah who do hallow them.

title: Leviticus 22:17
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:18
text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that presenteth his offering for any of his vows, and for any of his voluntary offerings, which they present to Jehovah as a burnt-offering,

title: Leviticus 22:19
text: it shall be for your acceptance, without blemish, a male of the oxen, of the sheep, and of the goats.

title: Leviticus 22:20
text: Nothing that hath a defect shall ye present; for it shall not be acceptable for you.

title: Leviticus 22:21
text: And if any present a sacrifice of peace-offering to Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or a voluntary offering of oxen or small cattle, it shall be without blemish to be accepted: there shall be no defect therein.

title: Leviticus 22:22
text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or ulcerous, or with itch, or scabbed--ye shall not present these to Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:23
text: A bullock and a sheep that hath a member too long or too short, that mayest thou offer as a voluntary offering; but as a vow it shall not be accepted.

title: Leviticus 22:24
text: That which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut shall ye not present to Jehovah; neither in your land shall ye do [the like].

title: Leviticus 22:25
text: Nor from the hand of the stranger shall ye present the bread of your God, of any of these; for their corruption is in them: a defect is in them; they shall not be accepted for you.

title: Leviticus 22:26
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 22:27
text: An ox, or a sheep, or a goat, when it is brought forth, shall be seven days under its dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:28
text: A cow, or sheep--it and its young shall ye not slaughter in one day.

title: Leviticus 22:29
text: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.

title: Leviticus 22:30
text: On that day shall it be eaten: ye shall leave none of it until morning: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:31
text: And ye shall observe my commandments and do them: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 22:32
text: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who do hallow you,

title: Leviticus 22:33
text: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, [Concerning] the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim as holy convocations--these are my set feasts.

title: Leviticus 23:3
text: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation; no manner of work shall ye do: it is the sabbath to Jehovah in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:4
text: ¶These are the set feasts of Jehovah, holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons:

title: Leviticus 23:5
text: In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, between the two evenings, is the passover to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:6
text: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast of unleavened bread to Jehovah; seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread.

title: Leviticus 23:7
text: On the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Leviticus 23:8
text: And ye shall present to Jehovah an offering by fire seven days; on the seventh day is a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Leviticus 23:9
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:10
text: Speak unto the children of Israel and say unto them, When ye come into the land that I give unto you, and ye reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:11
text: And he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you; on the next day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

title: Leviticus 23:12
text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf, a he-lamb without blemish, a yearling, for a burnt-offering to Jehovah;

title: Leviticus 23:13
text: and the oblation thereof: two tenths of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering by fire to Jehovah for a sweet odour; and the drink-offering thereof, of wine, a fourth part of a hin.

title: Leviticus 23:14
text: And ye shall not eat bread, or roast corn, or green ears, until the same day that ye have brought the offering of your God: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:15
text: ¶And ye shall count from the morning after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering, seven weeks; they shall be complete;

title: Leviticus 23:16
text: even unto the morning after the seventh sabbath shall ye count fifty days; and ye shall present a new oblation to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:17
text: Out of your dwellings shall ye bring two wave-loaves, of two tenths of fine flour; with leaven shall they be baken; [as] first-fruits to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:18
text: And ye shall present with the bread seven he-lambs without blemish, yearlings, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering to Jehovah with their oblation, and their drink-offerings, an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:19
text: And ye shall sacrifice one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs, yearlings, for a sacrifice of peace-offering.

title: Leviticus 23:20
text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits as a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two he-lambs; they shall be holy to Jehovah, for the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:21
text: And ye shall make proclamation on that same day--a holy convocation shall it be unto you: no manner of servile work shall ye do: [it is] an everlasting statute in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

title: Leviticus 23:22
text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not in thy harvest entirely reap the corners of thy field, and the gleaning of thy harvest shalt thou not gather: thou shalt leave them unto the poor and to the stranger: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 23:23
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:24
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first of the month, shall ye have a rest, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

title: Leviticus 23:25
text: No manner of servile work shall ye do; and ye shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:26
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:27
text: Also on the tenth of this seventh month is the day of the atonement: a holy convocation shall it be unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and present an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:28
text: And ye shall do no manner of work on that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 23:29
text: For every soul that is not afflicted on that same day, shall be cut off from among his peoples.

title: Leviticus 23:30
text: And every soul that doeth any manner of work on that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

title: Leviticus 23:31
text: No manner of work shall ye do: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 23:32
text: A sabbath of rest shall it be unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls. On the ninth of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

title: Leviticus 23:33
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 23:34
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths seven days to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:35
text: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Leviticus 23:36
text: Seven days ye shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah; on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Leviticus 23:37
text: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present an offering by fire to Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and an oblation, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, everything upon its day;

title: Leviticus 23:38
text: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your voluntary offerings, which ye give to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 23:39
text: But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the produce of the land, ye shall celebrate the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day there shall be rest.

title: Leviticus 23:40
text: And ye shall take on the first day the fruit of beautiful trees, palm branches and the boughs of leafy trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.

title: Leviticus 23:41
text: And ye shall celebrate it as a feast to Jehovah seven days in the year: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations; in the seventh month shall ye celebrate it.

title: Leviticus 23:42
text: In booths shall ye dwell seven days; all born in Israel shall dwell in booths;

title: Leviticus 23:43
text: that your generations may know that I caused the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 23:44
text: And Moses declared the set feasts of Jehovah to the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 24:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 24:2
text: Command the children of Israel that they bring unto thee pure beaten olive oil for the light, to light the lamp continually.

title: Leviticus 24:3
text: Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron dress it from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

title: Leviticus 24:4
text: Upon the pure candlestick shall he arrange the lamps before Jehovah continually.

title: Leviticus 24:5
text: And thou shalt take fine wheaten flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof; each cake shall be of two tenths.

title: Leviticus 24:6
text: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six in a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:7
text: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row; and it shall be a bread of remembrance, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:8
text: Every sabbath day he shall arrange it before Jehovah continually, on the part of the children of Israel: [it is] an everlasting covenant.

title: Leviticus 24:9
text: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy unto him of Jehovah's offerings by fire: [it is] an everlasting statute.

title: Leviticus 24:10
text: ¶And the son of an Israelitish woman--but withal the son of an Egyptian, --went out among the children of Israel; and this son of the Israelitess and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

title: Leviticus 24:11
text: and the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. And his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

title: Leviticus 24:12
text: And they confined him, that they might decide at the mouth of Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 24:13
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 24:14
text: Lead the reviler outside the camp; and all that heard [him] shall lay their hands upon his head, and the whole assembly shall stone him.

title: Leviticus 24:15
text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Every one when he revileth his God shall bear his sin.

title: Leviticus 24:16
text: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah shall certainly be put to death; all the assembly shall certainly stone him; as well the stranger as he that is home-born, when he blasphemeth the Name, shall be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:17
text: And if any one smiteth any man mortally, he shall certainly be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:18
text: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.

title: Leviticus 24:19
text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour, as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

title: Leviticus 24:20
text: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him.

title: Leviticus 24:21
text: He that smiteth a beast [mortally] shall make it good; and he that smiteth a man [mortally] shall be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:22
text: Ye shall have one law: as the stranger, so the home-born; for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 24:23
text: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they led the reviler outside the camp and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 25:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

title: Leviticus 25:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel and say unto them, When ye come into the land that I will give you, the land shall celebrate a sabbath to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 25:3
text: Six years shalt thou sow thy field, and six years shalt thou prune thy vineyard, and gather in the produce thereof,

title: Leviticus 25:4
text: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest for the land, a sabbath to Jehovah. Thy field shalt thou not sow, and thy vineyard shalt thou not prune.

title: Leviticus 25:5
text: That which springeth up from the scattered seed of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thine undressed vines thou shalt not gather: a year of rest shall it be for the land.

title: Leviticus 25:6
text: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you, for thee, and for thy bondman, and for thy handmaid, and for thy hired servant, and for him that dwelleth as a sojourner with thee, and for thy cattle,

title: Leviticus 25:7
text: and for the beasts that are in thy land: all the produce thereof shall be for food.

title: Leviticus 25:8
text: ¶And thou shalt count seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; so that the days of the seven sabbaths of years be unto thee forty-nine years.

title: Leviticus 25:9
text: Then shalt thou cause the loud sound of the trumpet to go forth in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month; on the day of atonement shall ye cause the trumpet to go forth throughout your land.

title: Leviticus 25:10
text: And ye shall hallow the year of the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty in the land unto all the inhabitants thereof; a [year of] jubilee shall it be unto you, and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family;

title: Leviticus 25:11
text: a year of jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap its aftergrowth, nor gather [the fruit of] its undressed vines.

title: Leviticus 25:12
text: For it is the jubilee; it shall be holy unto you; out of the field shall ye eat its produce.

title: Leviticus 25:13
text: In this year of the jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:14
text: And if ye sell ought unto your neighbour, or buy of your neighbour's hand, ye shall not overreach one another.

title: Leviticus 25:15
text: According to the number of years since the jubilee, thou shalt buy of thy neighbour; according to the number of years of the produce, he shall sell unto thee.

title: Leviticus 25:16
text: According to the greater number of the years, thou shalt increase the price thereof; and according to the fewness of years, thou shalt diminish the price of it; for it is the number of crops that he selleth unto thee.

title: Leviticus 25:17
text: And ye shall not oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God; for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 25:18
text: And ye shall do my statutes, and observe mine ordinances and do them: thus shall ye dwell in your land securely.

title: Leviticus 25:19
text: And the land shall yield its fruit, and ye shall eat and be satisfied, and dwell therein securely.

title: Leviticus 25:20
text: And if ye say, What shall we eat in the seventh year? behold, we may not sow, nor gather in our produce;

title: Leviticus 25:21
text: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, that it may bring forth produce for three years;

title: Leviticus 25:22
text: and ye shall sow in the eighth year, and ye shall eat of the old fruit until the ninth year; until her produce come in, ye shall eat the old.

title: Leviticus 25:23
text: ¶And the land shall not be sold for ever; for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

title: Leviticus 25:24
text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

title: Leviticus 25:25
text: If thy brother grow poor, and sell of his possession, then shall his redeemer, his nearest relation, come and redeem that which his brother sold.

title: Leviticus 25:26
text: And if the man have no one having right of redemption, and his hand have acquired and found what sufficeth for its redemption,

title: Leviticus 25:27
text: then shall he reckon the years since the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and so return unto his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:28
text: And if his hand have not found what sufficeth for him to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of the purchaser, until the year of jubilee; and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

title: Leviticus 25:29
text: And if any one sell a dwelling-house in a walled city, then he shall have the right of redemption up to the end of the year of the sale thereof; for a full year shall he have the right of redemption.

title: Leviticus 25:30
text: But if it be not redeemed until a whole year is complete, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it, throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:31
text: But the houses in villages that have no wall round about them shall be reckoned as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.

title: Leviticus 25:32
text: But as to the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites shall have a perpetual right of redemption.

title: Leviticus 25:33
text: And if any one redeem from one of the Levites, then the house that was sold, in the city of his possession, shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 25:34
text: And the field of the suburbs of their cities shall not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

title: Leviticus 25:35
text: And if thy brother grow poor, and he be fallen into decay beside thee, then thou shalt relieve him, [be he] stranger or sojourner, that he may live beside thee.

title: Leviticus 25:36
text: Thou shalt take no usury nor increase of him; and thou shalt fear thy God; that thy brother may live beside thee.

title: Leviticus 25:37
text: Thy money shalt thou not give him upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

title: Leviticus 25:38
text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, to be your God.

title: Leviticus 25:39
text: ¶And if thy brother grow poor beside thee, and be sold unto thee, thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

title: Leviticus 25:40
text: as a hired servant, as a sojourner, shall he be with thee; until the year of jubilee shall he serve thee.

title: Leviticus 25:41
text: Then shall he depart from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

title: Leviticus 25:42
text: For they are my bondmen, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as [men] sell bondmen.

title: Leviticus 25:43
text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; and thou shalt fear thy God.

title: Leviticus 25:44
text: And as for thy bondman and thy handmaid whom thou shalt have--of the nations that are round about you, of them shall ye buy bondmen and handmaids.

title: Leviticus 25:45
text: Moreover of the children of them that dwell as sojourners with you, of them may ye buy, and of their family that is with you, which they beget in your land, and they shall be your possession.

title: Leviticus 25:46
text: And ye shall leave them as an inheritance to your children after you, to inherit them as a possession: these may ye make your bondmen for ever; but as for your brethren, the children of Israel, ye shall not rule over one another with rigour.

title: Leviticus 25:47
text: And if a stranger or sojourner become wealthy beside thee, and thy brother beside him grow poor, and sell himself unto the stranger, who is settled by thee, or to a scion of the stranger's family,

title: Leviticus 25:48
text: after that he is sold there shall be right of redemption for him; one of his brethren may redeem him.

title: Leviticus 25:49
text: Either his uncle or his uncle's son may redeem him, or one of his next relations of his family may redeem him; or if his means be sufficient, he may redeem himself.

title: Leviticus 25:50
text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee; and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of the years, according to the days of a hired servant shall he be with him.

title: Leviticus 25:51
text: If there are yet many years, according unto them shall he return his redemption [money] out of the money that he was bought for;

title: Leviticus 25:52
text: and if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according unto his [remaining] years [of service] shall he give him back his redemption [money].

title: Leviticus 25:53
text: As a hired servant shall he be with him year by year; [his master] shall not rule with rigour over him before thine eyes.

title: Leviticus 25:54
text: And if he be not redeemed in this manner, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he and his children with him.

title: Leviticus 25:55
text: For the children of Israel are servants unto me; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 26:1
text: ¶Ye shall make yourselves no idols, neither rear you up for yourselves carved image, or statue, nor shall ye set up a figured stone in your land, to bow down unto it; for I am Jehovah your God.

title: Leviticus 26:2
text: Ye shall observe my sabbaths, and my sanctuary shall ye reverence: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 26:3
text: If ye walk in my statutes, and observe my commandments and do them,

title: Leviticus 26:4
text: then I will give your rain in the season thereof, and the land shall yield its produce, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit;

title: Leviticus 26:5
text: and your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing-time; and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land securely.

title: Leviticus 26:6
text: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid; and I will put away the evil beasts out of the land; and the sword shall not go through your land.

title: Leviticus 26:7
text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword;

title: Leviticus 26:8
text: and five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight; and your enemies shall fall beside you by the sword.

title: Leviticus 26:9
text: And I will turn my face towards you and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

title: Leviticus 26:10
text: And ye shall eat old store, and clear away the old because of the new.

title: Leviticus 26:11
text: And I will set my habitation among you; and my soul shall not abhor you;

title: Leviticus 26:12
text: and I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be to me a people.

title: Leviticus 26:13
text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

title: Leviticus 26:14
text: ¶But if ye hearken not unto me, and do not all these commandments,

title: Leviticus 26:15
text: and if ye shall despise my statutes, and if your soul shall abhor mine ordinances, so that ye do not all my commandments, that ye break my covenant,

title: Leviticus 26:16
text: I also will do this unto you--I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and fever, which shall cause the eyes to fail, and the soul to waste away; and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 26:17
text: And I will set my face against you, that ye may be routed before your enemies; they that hate you shall have dominion over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

title: Leviticus 26:18
text: And if for this ye hearken not unto me, I will punish you sevenfold more for your sins,

title: Leviticus 26:19
text: and I will break the arrogance of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as bronze,

title: Leviticus 26:20
text: and your strength shall be spent in vain, and your land shall not yield its produce; and the trees of the land shall not yield their fruit.

title: Leviticus 26:21
text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me, I will bring sevenfold more plagues upon you according to your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:22
text: And I will send the beasts of the field among you, that they may rob you of your children, and cut off your cattle, and make you few in number; and your streets shall be desolate.

title: Leviticus 26:23
text: And if ye will not be disciplined by me through these, but walk contrary unto me,

title: Leviticus 26:24
text: then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will smite you, even I, sevenfold for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:25
text: And I will bring a sword upon you that avengeth with the vengeance of the covenant, and ye shall be gathered together into your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

title: Leviticus 26:26
text: When I break the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and shall deliver you the bread again by weight; and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

title: Leviticus 26:27
text: And if for this ye hearken not to me, but walk contrary unto me,

title: Leviticus 26:28
text: then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven-fold for your sins.

title: Leviticus 26:29
text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

title: Leviticus 26:30
text: And I will lay waste your high places, and cut down your sun-pillars, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols; and my soul shall abhor you.

title: Leviticus 26:31
text: And I will lay waste your cities and desolate your sanctuaries; and I will not smell your sweet odours.

title: Leviticus 26:32
text: And I will bring the land into desolation; that your enemies who dwell there in may be astonished at it.

title: Leviticus 26:33
text: And I will scatter you among the nations, and will draw out the sword after you; and your land shall be desolation, and your cities waste.

title: Leviticus 26:34
text: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths all the days of the desolation, when ye are in your enemies' land; then shall the land rest, and enjoy its sabbaths.

title: Leviticus 26:35
text: All the days of the desolation it shall rest, [the days in] which it did not rest on your sabbaths, when ye dwelt therein.

title: Leviticus 26:36
text: And as to those that remain of you--I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, that the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them, and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth;

title: Leviticus 26:37
text: and they shall stumble one over another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth; and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

title: Leviticus 26:38
text: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

title: Leviticus 26:39
text: And they that remain of you shall waste away through their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also through the iniquities of their fathers shall they waste away with them.

title: Leviticus 26:40
text: ¶And they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, through their unfaithfulness wherein they were unfaithful to me, and also that they have walked contrary unto me,

title: Leviticus 26:41
text: so that I also walked contrary unto them, and brought them into the land of their enemies. If then their uncircumcised heart be humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

title: Leviticus 26:42
text: I will remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

title: Leviticus 26:43
text: For the land shall be left by them, and shall enjoy its sabbaths, when it is in desolation without them; and they shall accept the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they despised my judgments, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

title: Leviticus 26:44
text: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not despise them, and will not abhor them, to make an end of them utterly, to break my covenant with them, for I am Jehovah their God.

title: Leviticus 26:45
text: But I will remember toward them the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, that I might be their God: I am Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 26:46
text: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws which Jehovah made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 27:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 27:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel and say unto them, When any one devoteth [anything] by a vow, the persons shall be for Jehovah according to thy valuation.

title: Leviticus 27:3
text: And thy valuation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old: thy valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary;

title: Leviticus 27:4
text: and if it be of a female, thy valuation shall be thirty shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:5
text: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, thy valuation of the male shall be twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:6
text: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, thy valuation of the male shall be five shekels of silver; and for the female thy valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:7
text: And if it be from sixty years old and above, if it be a male, thy valuation shall be fifteen shekels; and for the female ten shekels.

title: Leviticus 27:8
text: And if he be poorer than thy valuation, he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him: according to his means that vowed shall the priest value him.

title: Leviticus 27:9
text: And if it be a beast whereof men bring an offering unto Jehovah, all that they give of such unto Jehovah shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:10
text: They shall not alter it nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; and if he at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 27:11
text: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not bring an offering unto Jehovah, then he shall present the beast before the priest;

title: Leviticus 27:12
text: and the priest shall value it, [judging] between good and bad: according to the valuation of the priest, so shall it be.

title: Leviticus 27:13
text: And if they will in any wise redeem it, then they shall add a fifth [part] thereof unto thy valuation.

title: Leviticus 27:14
text: ¶And when any one halloweth his house, that it may be holy to Jehovah, the priest shall value it, [judging] between good and bad: as the priest shall value it, so shall it stand.

title: Leviticus 27:15
text: And if he that halloweth it will redeem his house, he shall add the fifth of the money of thy valuation unto it, and it shall be his.

title: Leviticus 27:16
text: And if a man hallow to Jehovah [part] of a field of his possession, thy valuation shall be according to what may be sown in it: the homer of barley seed at fifty shekels of silver.

title: Leviticus 27:17
text: If he hallow his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy valuation shall it stand;

title: Leviticus 27:18
text: but if he hallow his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, until the year of the jubilee; and there shall be a reduction from thy valuation.

title: Leviticus 27:19
text: And if he that hallowed the field will in any wise redeem it, he shall add the fifth of the money of thy valuation unto it, and it shall be assured to him;

title: Leviticus 27:20
text: but if he do not redeem the field, or if he sell the field to another man, it cannot be redeemed any more;

title: Leviticus 27:21
text: and the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy to Jehovah, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.

title: Leviticus 27:22
text: And if he hallow to Jehovah a field that he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession,

title: Leviticus 27:23
text: the priest shall reckon unto him the amount of thy valuation, unto the year of the jubilee; and he shall give thy valuation on that day, [as] holy to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:24
text: In the year of the jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought--to him to whom the land belonged.

title: Leviticus 27:25
text: And all thy valuation shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

title: Leviticus 27:26
text: ¶Only the firstling which is offered as firstling to Jehovah among the cattle, that shall no man hallow, whether it be ox or sheep; it is Jehovah's.

title: Leviticus 27:27
text: But if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall ransom it according to thy valuation, and shall add a fifth of it thereto; and if it be not redeemed, it shall be sold according to thy valuation.

title: Leviticus 27:28
text: Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man hath devoted to Jehovah of all that he hath, of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:29
text: Nothing devoted, which shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed: it shall certainly be put to death.

title: Leviticus 27:30
text: And as to every tithe of the land, of the seed of the land, and of the fruit of the tree, it is Jehovah's: it is holy to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:31
text: And if any one will at all redeem of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth thereof.

title: Leviticus 27:32
text: And as to every tithe of the herd, or of the flock, of whatever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Jehovah.

title: Leviticus 27:33
text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it; and if he change it at all, then both it and the exchange thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

title: Leviticus 27:34
text: These are the commandments which Jehovah commanded Moses for the children of Israel upon mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai in the tent of meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year after their departure from the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Numbers 1:2
text: Take the sum of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, every male, according to their polls;

title: Numbers 1:3
text: from twenty years and upward, all that go forth to military service in Israel: ye shall number them according to their hosts, thou and Aaron.

title: Numbers 1:4
text: And with you there shall be a man for every tribe, a man who is the head of his father's house.

title: Numbers 1:5
text: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: for Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur;

title: Numbers 1:6
text: for Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;

title: Numbers 1:7
text: for Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab;

title: Numbers 1:8
text: for Issachar, Nethaneel the son of Zuar;

title: Numbers 1:9
text: for Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon;

title: Numbers 1:10
text: for the children of Joseph: for Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; for Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;

title: Numbers 1:11
text: for Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni;

title: Numbers 1:12
text: for Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;

title: Numbers 1:13
text: for Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran;

title: Numbers 1:14
text: for Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel;

title: Numbers 1:15
text: for Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 1:16
text: These were those summoned of the assembly, princes of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the thousands of Israel.

title: Numbers 1:17
text: ¶And Moses and Aaron took these men who are expressed by their names,

title: Numbers 1:18
text: and gathered the whole assembly together on the first of the second month. And they declared their pedigrees after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, according to their polls.

title: Numbers 1:19
text: As Jehovah had commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 1:20
text: And the sons of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, according to their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:21
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:22
text: Of the sons of Simeon: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, those that were numbered of them, by the number of the names, according to their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:23
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

title: Numbers 1:24
text: Of the sons of Gad: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:25
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:26
text: Of the sons of Judah: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:27
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

title: Numbers 1:28
text: Of the sons of Issachar: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:29
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:30
text: Of the sons of Zebulun: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:31
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:32
text: Of the sons of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:33
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:34
text: Of the children of Manasseh: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:35
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

title: Numbers 1:36
text: Of the sons of Benjamin: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:37
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:38
text: Of the sons of Dan: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:39
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

title: Numbers 1:40
text: Of the sons of Asher: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:41
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 1:42
text: Of the sons of Naphtali: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:

title: Numbers 1:43
text: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 1:44
text: ¶These are those that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, the twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

title: Numbers 1:45
text: And all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, according to their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service in Israel,

title: Numbers 1:46
text: all they that were numbered were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 1:47
text: ¶But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

title: Numbers 1:48
text: For Jehovah had spoken to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 1:49
text: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 1:50
text: But thou, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all its vessels; and they shall serve it, and round about the tabernacle shall they encamp;

title: Numbers 1:51
text: and when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle encampeth, the Levites shall set it up; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 1:52
text: And the children of Israel shall encamp every man in his camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their hosts;

title: Numbers 1:53
text: but the Levites shall encamp round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there come not wrath upon the assembly of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

title: Numbers 1:54
text: And the children of Israel did so; according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so did they.

title: Numbers 2:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 2:2
text: The children of Israel shall encamp every one by his standard, with the ensign of their father's house; round about the tent of meeting, afar off, opposite to it shall they encamp.

title: Numbers 2:3
text: ¶And [for] those encamping eastward toward the sun-rising [there shall be] the standard of the camp of Judah according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab;

title: Numbers 2:4
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

title: Numbers 2:5
text: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the prince of the sons of Issachar shall be Nethaneel the son of Zuar;

title: Numbers 2:6
text: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty-four thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:7
text: [With them shall be] the tribe of Zebulun; and the prince of the sons of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon;

title: Numbers 2:8
text: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:9
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah were a hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their hosts. They shall set forth first.

title: Numbers 2:10
text: The standard of the camp of Reuben shall be southward according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur;

title: Numbers 2:11
text: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, forty-six thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:12
text: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Simeon; and the prince of the sons of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;

title: Numbers 2:13
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

title: Numbers 2:14
text: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel;

title: Numbers 2:15
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:16
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Reuben were a hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth second.

title: Numbers 2:17
text: And the tent of meeting shall set forth, the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so shall they set forth, every man in his place, according to their standards.

title: Numbers 2:18
text: The standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts shall be westward; and the prince of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud;

title: Numbers 2:19
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:20
text: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and the prince of the sons of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;

title: Numbers 2:21
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand two hundred.

title: Numbers 2:22
text: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Benjamin; and the prince of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni;

title: Numbers 2:23
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, thirty-five thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:24
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred and eight thousand one hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.

title: Numbers 2:25
text: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be northward according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;

title: Numbers 2:26
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

title: Numbers 2:27
text: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher; and the prince of the sons of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran;

title: Numbers 2:28
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty-one thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 2:29
text: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Naphtali; and the prince of the sons of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan;

title: Numbers 2:30
text: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 2:31
text: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set forth last according to their standards.

title: Numbers 2:32
text: These are those that were numbered of the children of Israel, according to their fathers' houses: all those that were numbered of the camps, according to their hosts, were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 2:33
text: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 2:34
text: And the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses: so they encamped according to their standards, and so they journeyed, every one according to their families, according to their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 3:1
text: ¶And these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spoke with Moses on mount Sinai.

title: Numbers 3:2
text: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

title: Numbers 3:3
text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, who were consecrated to exercise the priesthood.

title: Numbers 3:4
text: And Nadab and Abihu died before Jehovah when they offered strange fire before Jehovah in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Eleazar and Ithamar exercised the priesthood in the presence of Aaron their father.

title: Numbers 3:5
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 3:6
text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him;

title: Numbers 3:7
text: and they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole assembly, before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 3:8
text: And they shall keep all the utensils of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 3:9
text: And thou shalt give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given to him out of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:10
text: And Aaron and his sons shalt thou appoint that they may attend to their priest's office; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:11
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 3:12
text: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of every firstborn that breaketh open the womb among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine;

title: Numbers 3:13
text: for every firstborn is mine. On the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both of man and beast; mine shall they be: I am Jehovah.

title: Numbers 3:14
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

title: Numbers 3:15
text: Number the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, after their families; every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

title: Numbers 3:16
text: And Moses numbered them, according to the commandment of Jehovah, --as he had been commanded.

title: Numbers 3:17
text: And these are the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

title: Numbers 3:18
text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon according to their families: Libni and Shimei.

title: Numbers 3:19
text: And the sons of Kohath according to their families: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:20
text: And the sons of Merari according to their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 3:21
text: Of Gershon, the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

title: Numbers 3:22
text: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, those that were numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 3:23
text: The families of the Gershonites encamped behind the tabernacle westward.

title: Numbers 3:24
text: And the prince of the father's house of the Gershonites was Eliasaph the son of Lael.

title: Numbers 3:25
text: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting was: the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the curtain of the entrance to the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 3:26
text: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain of the entrance to the court, which surrounds the tabernacle and the altar, and the cords thereof for all its service.

title: Numbers 3:27
text: And of Kohath, the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

title: Numbers 3:28
text: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, who kept the charge of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:29
text: The families of the sons of Kohath encamped on the side of the tabernacle southward.

title: Numbers 3:30
text: And the prince of the father's house of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

title: Numbers 3:31
text: And their charge was the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the utensils of the sanctuary with which they ministered, and the curtain, and all that belongs to its service.

title: Numbers 3:32
text: And the prince of princes of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest: he had the oversight of them that kept the charge of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:33
text: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

title: Numbers 3:34
text: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

title: Numbers 3:35
text: And the prince of the father's house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They encamped on the side of the tabernacle northward.

title: Numbers 3:36
text: And the charge of the sons of Merari consisted in the oversight of the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its bases, and all its furniture, and all that belongs to its service,

title: Numbers 3:37
text: and the pillars of the court round about, and their bases, and their pegs, and their cords.

title: Numbers 3:38
text: And those who encamped before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, were Moses, and Aaron and his sons, who kept the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 3:39
text: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, according to their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

title: Numbers 3:40
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

title: Numbers 3:41
text: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites, instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:42
text: And Moses numbered, as Jehovah had commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 3:43
text: And all the firstborn males, by the number of the names, from a month old and upward, according to their numbering, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.

title: Numbers 3:44
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 3:45
text: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.

title: Numbers 3:46
text: And for those that are to be ransomed, the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are in excess over the Levites,

title: Numbers 3:47
text: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll, according to the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them, --twenty gerahs the shekel;

title: Numbers 3:48
text: and thou shalt give the money unto Aaron and unto his sons for those in excess among them who are to be ransomed.

title: Numbers 3:49
text: And Moses took the ransom-money from them that were over and above those who were ransomed by the Levites;

title: Numbers 3:50
text: of the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, a thousand three hundred and sixty-five [shekels], according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 3:51
text: And Moses gave the money of them that were ransomed to Aaron and to his sons, according to the commandment of Jehovah, --as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 4:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 4:2
text: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, according to their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:3
text: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, all that enter into the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:4
text: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting: it is most holy.

title: Numbers 4:5
text: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron and his sons shall go in, and they shall take down the veil of separation and cover the ark of testimony with it;

title: Numbers 4:6
text: and shall put thereon a covering of badgers' skin, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put its staves [to it].

title: Numbers 4:7
text: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue; and put thereon the dishes, and the cups, and the bowls, and goblets of the drink-offering; and the continual bread shall be thereon.

title: Numbers 4:8
text: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put its staves [to it].

title: Numbers 4:9
text: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-trays, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they perform its service;

title: Numbers 4:10
text: and they shall put it and all the utensils thereof within a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put it upon a pole.

title: Numbers 4:11
text: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put its staves [to it].

title: Numbers 4:12
text: And they shall take all the instruments of service, wherewith they serve in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put them upon a pole.

title: Numbers 4:13
text: And they shall cleanse the altar of the ashes, and spread a purple cloth thereon;

title: Numbers 4:14
text: and they shall put upon it all the utensils thereof, wherewith they perform service about it: the firepans, the forks, and the shovels, and the bowls, --all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skin, and put its staves [to it].

title: Numbers 4:15
text: And when Aaron and his sons have ended covering the sanctuary, and all the utensils of the sanctuary, when the camp setteth forward, then afterwards the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the holy things, lest they die. This is what the sons of Kohath have to carry in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:16
text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall have the oversight of the oil for the light, and the fragrant incense, and the continual oblation, and the anointing oil, --the oversight of the whole tabernacle, and of all that is therein, over the sanctuary, and over its furniture.

title: Numbers 4:17
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 4:18
text: Ye shall not cut off the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites,

title: Numbers 4:19
text: but this shall ye do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they draw near unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;

title: Numbers 4:20
text: but they shall not go in and see for a moment the holy things, lest they die.

title: Numbers 4:21
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 4:22
text: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, according to their fathers' houses, after their families.

title: Numbers 4:23
text: From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old shalt thou number them; every one that cometh to labour in the work, to perform the service in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:24
text: This shall be the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving, and in carrying:

title: Numbers 4:25
text: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of badgers' skin that is above upon it, and the curtain of the entrance to the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:26
text: and the hangings of the court, and the curtain of the entrance, of the gate of the court, which surroundeth the tabernacle and the altar, and the cords thereof, and all the instruments of their service; and all that is to be done for these things shall they perform.

title: Numbers 4:27
text: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their carrying, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their carrying.

title: Numbers 4:28
text: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting, and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:29
text: The sons of Merari: after their families, according to their fathers' houses shalt thou number them;

title: Numbers 4:30
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the labour, to perform the service of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:31
text: And this shall be the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and bases thereof,

title: Numbers 4:32
text: and the pillars of the court round about, and their bases, and their pegs, and their cords, all their instruments, according to all their service; and by name ye shall number to them the materials which are their charge to carry.

title: Numbers 4:33
text: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 4:34
text: ¶And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the assembly numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and according to their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:35
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entered into the labour, for service in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 4:36
text: And those that were numbered of them according to their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

title: Numbers 4:37
text: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, every one that served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah through Moses.

title: Numbers 4:38
text: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, after their families, and according to their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:39
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entered into the labour, for service in the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:40
text: even those that were numbered of them, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 4:41
text: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all that served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 4:42
text: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, after their families, according to their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:43
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entered into the labour, for service in the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:44
text: even those that were numbered of them according to their families, were three thousand two hundred.

title: Numbers 4:45
text: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah through Moses.

title: Numbers 4:46
text: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, after their families and according to their fathers' houses,

title: Numbers 4:47
text: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that came to serve [in] the work of the service, and [in] the work of carrying, in the tent of meeting,

title: Numbers 4:48
text: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.

title: Numbers 4:49
text: According to the commandment of Jehovah they were numbered by Moses, every one for his service, and for his burden, and numbered by him, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 5:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:2
text: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by a dead person:

title: Numbers 5:3
text: both male and female shall ye put out; outside the camp shall ye put them, that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

title: Numbers 5:4
text: And the children of Israel did so, and put them outside the camp: as Jehovah had said to Moses, so did the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 5:5
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:6
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any of all the sins of man to work unfaithfulness against Jehovah, and that soul is guilty,

title: Numbers 5:7
text: then they shall confess their sin which they have done; and he shall recompense his trespass according to the principal thereof, and shall add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

title: Numbers 5:8
text: And if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, the trespass which is recompensed to Jehovah shall be the priest's, besides the ram of the atonement, wherewith an atonement is made for him.

title: Numbers 5:9
text: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.

title: Numbers 5:10
text: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatever any man giveth the priest shall be his.

title: Numbers 5:11
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 5:12
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go astray, and commit unfaithfulness against him,

title: Numbers 5:13
text: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and she be defiled in secret, and there be no witness against her, and she have not been caught;

title: Numbers 5:14
text: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she have been defiled, --or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she have not been defiled,

title: Numbers 5:15
text: --then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, a tenth part of an ephah of barley-meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an oblation of jealousy, a memorial oblation, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

title: Numbers 5:16
text: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 5:17
text: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle, and put it into the water.

title: Numbers 5:18
text: And the priest shall set the woman before Jehovah, and uncover the woman's head, and put the memorial oblation in her hands, which is the jealousy offering; and in the hand of the priest shall be the bitter water that bringeth the curse.

title: Numbers 5:19
text: And the priest shall adjure her, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone astray in uncleanness, in being with another instead of thy husband, be free from this bitter water that bringeth the curse.

title: Numbers 5:20
text: But if thou hast gone astray to another instead of thy husband, and hast been defiled, and a man other than thy husband have lain with thee,

title: Numbers 5:21
text: --then the priest shall adjure the woman with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman: Jehovah make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when Jehovah doth make thy thigh to shrink, and thy belly to swell;

title: Numbers 5:22
text: and this water that bringeth the curse shall enter into thy bowels, to make the belly to swell, and the thigh to shrink. And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

title: Numbers 5:23
text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and shall blot them out with the bitter water,

title: Numbers 5:24
text: and he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that bringeth the curse, that the water that bringeth the curse may enter into her for bitterness.

title: Numbers 5:25
text: And the priest shall take out of the woman's hand the oblation of jealousy, and shall wave the oblation before Jehovah, and shall present it at the altar.

title: Numbers 5:26
text: And the priest shall take a handful of the oblation as a memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar; and afterwards he shall make the woman drink the water.

title: Numbers 5:27
text: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she have been defiled, and have committed unfaithfulness against her husband, that the water that bringeth the curse shall enter into her, for bitterness, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall shrink; and the woman shall become a curse among her people.

title: Numbers 5:28
text: But if the woman have not been defiled, and be clean, then she shall be clear, and shall conceive seed.

title: Numbers 5:29
text: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth astray to another instead of her husband and is defiled,

title: Numbers 5:30
text: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon a man, and he is jealous as regards his wife; then shall he set the woman before Jehovah, and the priest shall do to her according to all this law.

title: Numbers 5:31
text: Then shall the man be free from iniquity, but that woman shall bear her iniquity.

title: Numbers 6:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 6:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If a man or a woman have vowed the special vow of a Nazarite, to consecrate themselves to Jehovah;

title: Numbers 6:3
text: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink: he shall drink no vinegar of wine, nor vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat grapes, fresh or dried.

title: Numbers 6:4
text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine, from the seed-stones, even to the skin.

title: Numbers 6:5
text: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head; until the days be fulfilled, that he hath consecrated himself to Jehovah, he shall be holy; he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

title: Numbers 6:6
text: All the days that he hath consecrated himself to Jehovah, he shall come near no dead body.

title: Numbers 6:7
text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister when they die; for the consecration of his God is upon his head.

title: Numbers 6:8
text: All the days of his separation he is holy to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 6:9
text: And if any one die unexpectedly by him suddenly, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day shall he shave it.

title: Numbers 6:10
text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 6:11
text: And the priest shall offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead person; and he shall hallow his head that same day.

title: Numbers 6:12
text: And he shall [again] consecrate to Jehovah the days of his separation, and shall bring a yearling lamb for a trespass-offering. But the first days are forfeited, for his consecration hath been defiled.

title: Numbers 6:13
text: And this is the law of the Nazarite on the day when the days of his consecration are fulfilled: he shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 6:14
text: And he shall present his offering to Jehovah, one yearling he-lamb without blemish for a burnt-offering, and one yearling ewe-lamb without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for a peace-offering;

title: Numbers 6:15
text: and a basket with unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their oblation, and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 6:16
text: And the priest shall present them before Jehovah, and shall offer his sin-offering and his burnt-offering:

title: Numbers 6:17
text: and he shall offer the ram, a sacrifice of peace-offering to Jehovah, with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall offer also his oblation and his drink-offering.

title: Numbers 6:18
text: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his consecration at the entrance to the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his consecration, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace-offering.

title: Numbers 6:19
text: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after he hath shaven [the hair of] his consecration.

title: Numbers 6:20
text: And the priest shall wave them as wave-offering before Jehovah; it is holy for the priest, with the breast of the wave-offering and with the shoulder of the heave-offering; and afterwards the Nazarite may drink wine.

title: Numbers 6:21
text: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed: his offering to Jehovah for his consecration, beside what his hand is able to get; according to the vow which he vowed, so shall he do, according to the law of his consecration.

title: Numbers 6:22
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 6:23
text: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel: saying unto them,

title: Numbers 6:24
text: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee;

title: Numbers 6:25
text: Jehovah make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee;

title: Numbers 6:26
text: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

title: Numbers 6:27
text: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

title: Numbers 7:1
