text: ¶And it came to pass on the day that Moses had completed the setting up of the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and hallowed it, and all the furniture thereof, and the altar and all its utensils, and had anointed them, and hallowed them,

title: Numbers 7:2
text: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, the princes of the tribes, they that were over them that had been numbered, offered;

title: Numbers 7:3
text: and they brought their offering before Jehovah, six covered waggons, and twelve oxen; a waggon for two princes, and an ox for each; and they presented them before the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 7:4
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 7:5
text: Take it of them, and they shall be for the performance of the service of the tent of meeting, and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to each according to his service.

title: Numbers 7:6
text: And Moses took the waggons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

title: Numbers 7:7
text: Two waggons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service;

title: Numbers 7:8
text: and four waggons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, --under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 7:9
text: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, for the service of the sanctuary was upon them: they bore [what they carried] upon the shoulder.

title: Numbers 7:10
text: ¶And the princes presented the dedication-gift of the altar on the day that it was anointed; and the princes presented their offering before the altar.

title: Numbers 7:11
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, They shall present their offering for the dedication of the altar, each prince on his day.

title: Numbers 7:12
text: And he that presented his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.

title: Numbers 7:13
text: And his offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl, of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:14
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:15
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:16
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:17
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

title: Numbers 7:18
text: On the second day offered Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar;

title: Numbers 7:19
text: he presented his offering; one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour, mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:20
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:21
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:22
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:23
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

title: Numbers 7:24
text: On the third day, the prince of the children of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon:

title: Numbers 7:25
text: his offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:26
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:27
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:28
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:29
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 7:30
text: On the fourth day, the prince of the children of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 7:31
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:32
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:33
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:34
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:35
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Elizur, the son of Shedeur.

title: Numbers 7:36
text: On the fifth day, the prince of the children of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 7:37
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:38
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:39
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:40
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:41
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

title: Numbers 7:42
text: On the sixth day, the prince of the children of Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

title: Numbers 7:43
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:44
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:45
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:46
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:47
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

title: Numbers 7:48
text: On the seventh day, the prince of the children of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 7:49
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:50
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:51
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:52
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:53
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 7:54
text: On the eighth day, the prince of the children of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 7:55
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:56
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:57
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:58
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:59
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

title: Numbers 7:60
text: On the ninth day, the prince of the children of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 7:61
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:62
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:63
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:64
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:65
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 7:66
text: On the tenth day, the prince of the children of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 7:67
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:68
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:69
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:70
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:71
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

title: Numbers 7:72
text: On the eleventh day, the prince of the children of Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran.

title: Numbers 7:73
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:74
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:75
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:76
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:77
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

title: Numbers 7:78
text: On the twelfth day, the prince of the children of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 7:79
text: His offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation;

title: Numbers 7:80
text: one cup of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense;

title: Numbers 7:81
text: one young bullock, one ram, one yearling lamb, for a burnt-offering;

title: Numbers 7:82
text: one buck of the goats for a sin-offering;

title: Numbers 7:83
text: and for a sacrifice of peace-offering, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five yearling lambs. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 7:84
text: This was the dedication-gift of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, from the princes of Israel: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, twelve cups of gold:

title: Numbers 7:85
text: each silver dish of a hundred and thirty [shekels], and each bowl seventy: all the silver of the vessels was two thousand four hundred [shekels] according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

title: Numbers 7:86
text: twelve golden cups full of incense, each cup of ten [shekels], according to the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the cups, a hundred and twenty [shekels].

title: Numbers 7:87
text: All the cattle for the burnt-offering was: twelve bullocks, twelve rams, twelve yearling lambs and their oblation; and twelve bucks of the goats for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 7:88
text: And all the cattle for the sacrifice of the peace-offering was: twenty-four bullocks, sixty rams, sixty he-goats, sixty yearling lambs. This was the dedication-gift of the altar, after it had been anointed.

title: Numbers 7:89
text: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with Him, then he heard the voice speaking to him from off the mercy-seat which was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to Him.

title: Numbers 8:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses saying,

title: Numbers 8:2
text: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

title: Numbers 8:3
text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 8:4
text: And this was the work of the candlestick: [it was] of beaten gold; from its base to its flowers was it beaten work; according to the form which Jehovah had shewn Moses, so had he made the candlestick.

title: Numbers 8:5
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 8:6
text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

title: Numbers 8:7
text: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: sprinkle upon them water of purification from sin; and they shall pass the razor over all their flesh, and shall wash their garments, and make themselves clean.

title: Numbers 8:8
text: And they shall take a young bullock and its oblation of fine flour mingled with oil; and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 8:9
text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tent of meeting; and thou shalt gather together the whole assembly of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 8:10
text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before Jehovah; and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites.

title: Numbers 8:11
text: And Aaron shall offer the Levites as a wave-offering before Jehovah from the children of Israel, and they shall perform the service of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 8:12
text: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks, and thou shalt offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, to Jehovah, to make atonement for the Levites.

title: Numbers 8:13
text: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave-offering to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 8:14
text: And thou shalt separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, that the Levites may be mine.

title: Numbers 8:15
text: And afterwards shall the Levites come in to do the service of the tent of meeting. And thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them as a wave-offering.

title: Numbers 8:16
text: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of every one that breaketh open the womb, instead of every firstborn among the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

title: Numbers 8:17
text: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both of man and beast; on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I hallowed them to myself.

title: Numbers 8:18
text: And I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 8:19
text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons, from among the children of Israel, to perform the service of the children of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel draw near to the sanctuary.

title: Numbers 8:20
text: And Moses and Aaron, and all the assembly of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses concerning the Levites: so did the children of Israel to them.

title: Numbers 8:21
text: And the Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their garments; and Aaron offered them as a wave-offering before Jehovah; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

title: Numbers 8:22
text: And afterwards the Levites came in to perform their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron, and before his sons; as Jehovah had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they to them.

title: Numbers 8:23
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 8:24
text: This is that which concerneth the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward shall he come to labour in the work of the service of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 8:25
text: And from fifty years old he shall retire from the labour of the service, and shall serve no more;

title: Numbers 8:26
text: but he shall minister with his brethren in the tent of meeting, and keep the charge, but he shall not serve [in] the service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites with regard to their charges.

title: Numbers 9:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after their departure from the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Numbers 9:2
text: Let the children of Israel also hold the passover at its set time;

title: Numbers 9:3
text: on the fourteenth day in this month between the two evenings, ye shall hold it at its set time; according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ordinances thereof shall ye hold it.

title: Numbers 9:4
text: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should hold the passover.

title: Numbers 9:5
text: And they held the passover in the first [month] on the fourteenth day of the month, between the two evenings, in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 9:6
text: And there were men, who were unclean through the dead body of a man, and could not hold the passover on that day; and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day.

title: Numbers 9:7
text: And those men said to him, We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man: why are we kept back, that we may not present the offering of Jehovah at its set time among the children of Israel?

title: Numbers 9:8
text: And Moses said to them, Stay, and I will hear what Jehovah commands concerning you.

title: Numbers 9:9
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 9:10
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any one of you or of your generations be unclean by reason of a dead body or be on a journey afar off, yet he shall hold the passover to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 9:11
text: In the second month, on the fourteenth day, between the two evenings, shall they hold it; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs shall they eat it.

title: Numbers 9:12
text: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone thereof: according to every ordinance of the passover shall they hold it.

title: Numbers 9:13
text: But a man that is clean, and is not on a journey, and forbeareth to hold the passover, that soul shall be cut off from among his peoples; because he presented not the offering of Jehovah at its set time: that man shall bear his sin.

title: Numbers 9:14
text: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and would hold the passover to Jehovah, according to the rite of the passover, and according to the ordinance thereof, so shall he do. Ye shall have one rite, both for the stranger and for him that is born in the land.

title: Numbers 9:15
text: ¶And on the day that the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle of the tent of testimony; and at even it was upon the tabernacle as the appearance of fire, until the morning.

title: Numbers 9:16
text: So it was continually: the cloud covered it, and at night it was as the appearance of fire.

title: Numbers 9:17
text: And when the cloud rose from the tent, then the children of Israel journeyed; and at the place where the cloud stood still, there the children of Israel encamped.

title: Numbers 9:18
text: According to the commandment of Jehovah the children of Israel journeyed, and according to the commandment of Jehovah they [remained] encamped; all the days that the cloud dwelt upon the tabernacle they encamped.

title: Numbers 9:19
text: And when the cloud was long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of Jehovah, and journeyed not.

title: Numbers 9:20
text: And if it were so that the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle, according to the commandment of Jehovah they encamped, and according to the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed.

title: Numbers 9:21
text: And if it were so that the cloud was there from the evening until the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed; or a day and a night, and the cloud was taken up, they journeyed;

title: Numbers 9:22
text: or two days, or a month, or many days, when the cloud was long upon the tabernacle, dwelling upon it, the children of Israel [remained] encamped, and journeyed not; but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

title: Numbers 9:23
text: At the commandment of Jehovah they encamped, and at the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed: they kept the charge of Jehovah according to the commandment of Jehovah through Moses.

title: Numbers 10:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 10:2
text: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of beaten work shalt thou make them; and they shall serve for the calling together of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

title: Numbers 10:3
text: And when they shall blow with them, the whole assembly shall gather to thee at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 10:4
text: And if they blow with one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather unto thee.

title: Numbers 10:5
text: And when ye blow an alarm, the camps that lie eastward shall set forward.

title: Numbers 10:6
text: And when ye blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie southward shall set forward; they shall blow an alarm on their setting forward.

title: Numbers 10:7
text: And when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not blow an alarm:

title: Numbers 10:8
text: the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

title: Numbers 10:9
text: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before Jehovah your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

title: Numbers 10:10
text: And in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in your new moons, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt-offerings and over your sacrifices of peace-offering; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Numbers 10:11
text: ¶And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth of the month, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

title: Numbers 10:12
text: And the children of Israel set forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stood still in the wilderness of Paran.

title: Numbers 10:13
text: And they first took their journey, according to the commandment of Jehovah through Moses.

title: Numbers 10:14
text: The standard of the camp of the children of Judah set forward first according to their hosts, and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab;

title: Numbers 10:15
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar;

title: Numbers 10:16
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

title: Numbers 10:17
text: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward bearing the tabernacle.

title: Numbers 10:18
text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their hosts, and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur;

title: Numbers 10:19
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;

title: Numbers 10:20
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

title: Numbers 10:21
text: And the Kohathites set forward bearing the sanctuary: and [the others] set up the tabernacle whilst they came.

title: Numbers 10:22
text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their hosts, and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud;

title: Numbers 10:23
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;

title: Numbers 10:24
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

title: Numbers 10:25
text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, the rear-guard of all the camps according to their hosts, and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;

title: Numbers 10:26
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran;

title: Numbers 10:27
text: and over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

title: Numbers 10:28
text: These were the settings forward of the children of Israel according to their hosts: so did they set forward.

title: Numbers 10:29
text: ¶And Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, We are journeying to the place of which Jehovah said, I will give it unto you: come with us, and we will do thee good; for Jehovah has spoken good concerning Israel.

title: Numbers 10:30
text: And he said to him, I will not go; but to mine own land, and to my kindred will I go.

title: Numbers 10:31
text: And he said, Leave me not, I pray thee, because thou knowest where we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou wilt be to us for eyes.

title: Numbers 10:32
text: And it shall be, if thou come with us, that whatever good Jehovah doeth unto us, so will we do to thee.

title: Numbers 10:33
text: And they set forward from the mountain of Jehovah [and went] three days' journey; and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting-place for them.

title: Numbers 10:34
text: And the cloud of Jehovah was over them by day when they set forward out of the camp.

title: Numbers 10:35
text: And it came to pass when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Jehovah, and let thine enemies be scattered; And let them that hate thee flee before thy face.

title: Numbers 10:36
text: And when it rested, he said, Return, Jehovah, unto the myriads of the thousands of Israel.

title: Numbers 11:1
text: ¶And it came to pass that when the people murmured, it was evil in the ears of Jehovah; and Jehovah heard it, and his anger was kindled, and the fire of Jehovah burned among them, and consumed [some] in the extremity of the camp.

title: Numbers 11:2
text: And the people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Jehovah--and the fire abated.

title: Numbers 11:3
text: And they called the name of that place Taberah; because a fire of Jehovah burned among them.

title: Numbers 11:4
text: ¶And the mixed multitude that was among them lusted; and the children of Israel also wept again and said, Who will give us flesh to eat?

title: Numbers 11:5
text: We remember the fish that we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

title: Numbers 11:6
text: and now our soul is dried up: there is nothing at all but the manna before our eyes.

title: Numbers 11:7
text: And the manna was as coriander seed, and its appearance as the appearance of bdellium.

title: Numbers 11:8
text: The people went about, and gathered it, and ground it with hand-mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it; and the taste of it was as the taste of oil-cakes.

title: Numbers 11:9
text: And when the dew fell upon the camp by night, the manna fell upon it.

title: Numbers 11:10
text: And Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every one at the entrance of his tent; and the anger of Jehovah was kindled greatly; it was also evil in the eyes of Moses.

title: Numbers 11:11
text: And Moses said to Jehovah, Why hast thou done evil to thy servant, and why have I not found favour in thine eyes, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

title: Numbers 11:12
text: Have I conceived all this people, have I brought them forth, that thou sayest to me, Carry them in thy bosom, as the nursing-father beareth the suckling, unto the land which thou didst swear unto their fathers?

title: Numbers 11:13
text: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh that we may eat!

title: Numbers 11:14
text: I am not able to bear all this people alone, for it is too heavy for me.

title: Numbers 11:15
text: And if thou deal thus with me, slay me, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, that I may not behold my wretchedness.

title: Numbers 11:16
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and their officers; and take them to the tent of meeting, and they shall stand there with thee.

title: Numbers 11:17
text: And I will come down and talk with thee there; and I will take of the Spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, and thou shalt not bear it alone.

title: Numbers 11:18
text: And unto the people shalt thou say, Hallow yourselves for to-morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying, Who will give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt; and Jehovah will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

title: Numbers 11:19
text: Not one day shall ye eat, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

title: Numbers 11:20
text: [but] for a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it become loathsome unto you; because that ye have despised Jehovah who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

title: Numbers 11:21
text: And Moses said, The people in whose midst I am are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou sayest, I will give them flesh that they may eat a whole month.

title: Numbers 11:22
text: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered for them, to suffice them?

title: Numbers 11:23
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Hath Jehovah's hand become short? Now shalt thou see whether my word will come to pass unto thee or not.

title: Numbers 11:24
text: ¶And Moses went out and told the people the words of Jehovah; and he gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tent.

title: Numbers 11:25
text: And Jehovah came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy men, the elders; and it came to pass, that when the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did not repeat [it].

title: Numbers 11:26
text: And two men remained in the camp, the name of the one, Eldad, and the name of the other, Medad; and the Spirit rested upon them (and they were among them that were written, but they had not gone out to the tent); and they prophesied in the camp.

title: Numbers 11:27
text: And there ran a youth, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.

title: Numbers 11:28
text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the attendant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them!

title: Numbers 11:29
text: But Moses said to him, Enviest thou for my sake? would that all Jehovah's people were prophets, [and] that Jehovah would put his Spirit upon them!

title: Numbers 11:30
text: And Moses withdrew into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

title: Numbers 11:31
text: ¶And there went forth a wind from Jehovah, and drove quails from the sea, and cast them about the camp, about a day's journey on this side, and about a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits above the earth.

title: Numbers 11:32
text: And the people rose up all that day, and the whole night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered little gathered ten homers; and they spread them abroad for themselves round about the camp.

title: Numbers 11:33
text: The flesh was yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, when the wrath of Jehovah was kindled against the people, and Jehovah smote the people with a very great plague.

title: Numbers 11:34
text: And they called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah; because there they buried the people who lusted.

title: Numbers 11:35
text: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed to Hazeroth; and they were at Hazeroth.

title: Numbers 12:1
text: ¶And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had taken; for he had taken a Cushite as wife.

title: Numbers 12:2
text: And they said, Has Jehovah indeed spoken only to Moses? has he not spoken also to us? And Jehovah heard it.

title: Numbers 12:3
text: But the man Moses was very meek, above all men that were upon the face of the earth.

title: Numbers 12:4
text: ¶Then Jehovah spoke suddenly to Moses, and to Aaron, and to Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting. And they went out, they three.

title: Numbers 12:5
text: And Jehovah came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood at the entrance of the tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.

title: Numbers 12:6
text: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Jehovah will make myself known to him in a vision, I will speak to him in a dream.

title: Numbers 12:7
text: Not so my servant Moses: he is faithful in all my house.

title: Numbers 12:8
text: Mouth to mouth do I speak to him openly, and not in riddles; and the form of Jehovah doth he behold. Why then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?

title: Numbers 12:9
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against them, and he went away;

title: Numbers 12:10
text: ¶and the cloud departed from off the tent. And behold, Miriam was leprous as snow; and Aaron turned toward Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

title: Numbers 12:11
text: Then Aaron said to Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not this sin upon us, wherein we have been foolish, and have sinned!

title: Numbers 12:12
text: Let her not be as one stillborn, half of whose flesh is consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb.

title: Numbers 12:13
text: And Moses cried to Jehovah, saying, O *God, heal her, I beseech thee!

title: Numbers 12:14
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, But had her father anyways spat in her face, should she not be shamed seven days? She shall be shut outside the camp seven days, and afterwards she shall be received in [again].

title: Numbers 12:15
text: And Miriam was shut outside the camp seven days; and the people did not journey till Miriam was received in [again].

title: Numbers 12:16
text: And afterwards the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

title: Numbers 13:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 13:2
text: Send thou men, that they may search out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel. Ye shall send a man of every tribe of his fathers, each a prince among them.

title: Numbers 13:3
text: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran: according to the commandment of Jehovah, all of them heads of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 13:4
text: And these are their names: for the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;

title: Numbers 13:5
text: for the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;

title: Numbers 13:6
text: for the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;

title: Numbers 13:7
text: for the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;

title: Numbers 13:8
text: for the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;

title: Numbers 13:9
text: for the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;

title: Numbers 13:10
text: for the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;

title: Numbers 13:11
text: for the tribe of Joseph, for the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;

title: Numbers 13:12
text: for the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;

title: Numbers 13:13
text: for the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;

title: Numbers 13:14
text: for the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;

title: Numbers 13:15
text: for the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

title: Numbers 13:16
text: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to search out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Jehoshua.

title: Numbers 13:17
text: And Moses sent them to search out the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up this way by the south and go up into the hill-country,

title: Numbers 13:18
text: and ye shall see the land, what it is; and the people that dwell in it, whether they are strong or weak, few or many;

title: Numbers 13:19
text: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

title: Numbers 13:20
text: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there are trees in it, or not. And take courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first grapes.

title: Numbers 13:21
text: ¶And they went up, and searched out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, where one comes towards Hamath.

title: Numbers 13:22
text: And they went up by the south, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. Now Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

title: Numbers 13:23
text: And they came as far as the valley of Eshcol, and cut down thence a branch with one bunch of grapes, and they bore it between two upon a pole; and [they brought] of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

title: Numbers 13:24
text: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the grapes which the children of Israel had cut down there.

title: Numbers 13:25
text: And they returned from searching out the land after forty days.

title: Numbers 13:26
text: ¶And they came, and went to Moses and to Aaron, and to the whole assembly of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them, and to the whole assembly; and shewed them the fruit of the land.

title: Numbers 13:27
text: And they told him, and said, We came to the land to which thou didst send us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

title: Numbers 13:28
text: Only, the people are strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, very great; moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

title: Numbers 13:29
text: Amalek dwells in the land of the south; and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the hill-country; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the side of the Jordan.

title: Numbers 13:30
text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up boldly and possess it, for we are well able to do it.

title: Numbers 13:31
text: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.

title: Numbers 13:32
text: And they brought to the children of Israel an evil report of the land which they had searched out, saying, The land, which we have passed through to search it out, is a land that eateth up its inhabitants; and all the people that we have seen in it are men of great stature;

title: Numbers 13:33
text: and there have we seen giants--the sons of Anak are of the giants--and we were in our sight as grasshoppers, and so we were also in their sight.

title: Numbers 14:1
text: ¶And the whole assembly lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

title: Numbers 14:2
text: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron; and the whole assembly said to them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or in this wilderness would that we had died!

title: Numbers 14:3
text: And why is Jehovah bringing us to this land that we may fall by the sword, that our wives and our little ones may become a prey? Is it not better for us to return to Egypt?

title: Numbers 14:4
text: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return to Egypt.

title: Numbers 14:5
text: ¶Then Moses and Aaron fell upon their faces before the whole congregation of the assembly of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 14:6
text: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of them that searched out the land, rent their garments.

title: Numbers 14:7
text: And they spoke to the whole assembly of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it out, is a very, very good land.

title: Numbers 14:8
text: If Jehovah delight in us, he will bring us into this land, and give it us, a land that flows with milk and honey;

title: Numbers 14:9
text: only rebel not against Jehovah; and fear not the people of the land; for they shall be our food. Their defence is departed from them, and Jehovah is with us: fear them not.

title: Numbers 14:10
text: And the whole assembly said that they should be stoned with stones. And the glory of Jehovah appeared in the tent of meeting to all the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 14:11
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe me, for all the signs which I have done among them?

title: Numbers 14:12
text: I will smite them with the pestilence, and destroy them, and will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.

title: Numbers 14:13
text: And Moses said to Jehovah, Then the Egyptians will hear it; for in thy might thou broughtest up this people from the midst of them;

title: Numbers 14:14
text: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land, [who] have heard that thou, Jehovah, art in the midst of this people, that thou, Jehovah, lettest thyself be seen eye to eye, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night;

title: Numbers 14:15
text: if thou now slayest this people as one man, then the nations that have heard thy fame will speak, saying,

title: Numbers 14:16
text: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land that he had sworn unto them, he has therefore slain them in the wilderness.

title: Numbers 14:17
text: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of the Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

title: Numbers 14:18
text: Jehovah is slow to anger, and abundant in goodness, forgiving iniquity and transgression, but by no means clearing [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and fourth [generation].

title: Numbers 14:19
text: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of thy loving-kindness, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

title: Numbers 14:20
text: ¶And Jehovah said, I have pardoned according to thy word.

title: Numbers 14:21
text: But as surely as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Jehovah!

title: Numbers 14:22
text: for all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice,

title: Numbers 14:23
text: shall in no wise see the land which I did swear unto their fathers: none of them that despised me shall see it.

title: Numbers 14:24
text: But my servant Caleb, because he hath another spirit in him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he came; and his seed shall possess it.

title: Numbers 14:25
text: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwell in the valley.) To-morrow turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness, on the way to the Red sea.

title: Numbers 14:26
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 14:27
text: How long [shall I bear] with this evil assembly, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

title: Numbers 14:28
text: Say unto them, As surely as I live, saith Jehovah, if I do not do unto you as ye have spoken in mine ears!

title: Numbers 14:29
text: In this wilderness shall your carcases fall; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number from twenty years old and upwards, who have murmured against me,

title: Numbers 14:30
text: shall in no wise come into the land, concerning which I have lifted up my hand to make you dwell in it; save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 14:31
text: But your little ones, of whom ye said they should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land that ye have despised.

title: Numbers 14:32
text: And as to you, your carcases shall fall in this wilderness.

title: Numbers 14:33
text: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

title: Numbers 14:34
text: After the number of the days in which ye have searched out the land, forty days, each day for a year shall ye bear your iniquities forty years, and ye shall know mine estrangement [from you].

title: Numbers 14:35
text: I Jehovah have spoken; I will surely do it unto all this evil assembly which have gathered together against me! in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

title: Numbers 14:36
text: ¶And the men whom Moses had sent to search out the land, who returned, and made the whole assembly to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report upon the land,

title: Numbers 14:37
text: even those men who had brought up an evil report upon the land, died by a plague before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 14:38
text: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, lived still of the men that had gone to search out the land.

title: Numbers 14:39
text: And Moses told all these sayings to all the children of Israel; then the people mourned greatly.

title: Numbers 14:40
text: And they rose up early in the morning, and went up to the hill-top, saying, Here are we, and we will go up to the place of which Jehovah has spoken; for we have sinned.

title: Numbers 14:41
text: And Moses said, Why now do ye transgress the commandment of Jehovah? but it shall not prosper!

title: Numbers 14:42
text: Go not up, for Jehovah is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies;

title: Numbers 14:43
text: for the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword; for as ye have turned away from Jehovah, Jehovah will not be with you.

title: Numbers 14:44
text: Yet they presumed to go up to the hill-top; but the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and Moses, did not depart from the midst of the camp.

title: Numbers 14:45
text: And the Amalekites and the Canaanites who dwelt on that hill, came down and smote them, and cut them to pieces, as far as Hormah.

title: Numbers 15:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 15:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of your dwellings, which I give unto you,

title: Numbers 15:3
text: and will make an offering by fire to Jehovah, a burnt-offering or a sacrifice for the performance of a vow, or as a voluntary offering, or in your set feasts, to make a sweet odour to Jehovah, of the herd or of the flock,

title: Numbers 15:4
text: then shall he that presenteth his offering to Jehovah bring as oblation a tenth part of fine flour mingled with a fourth part of a hin of oil;

title: Numbers 15:5
text: and of wine for a drink-offering shalt thou offer the fourth part of a hin with the burnt-offering, or with the sacrifice, for one lamb.

title: Numbers 15:6
text: And for a ram thou shalt offer as oblation two tenth parts of fine flour mingled with oil, a third part of a hin,

title: Numbers 15:7
text: and of wine for a drink-offering shalt thou offer the third part of a hin; for a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:8
text: And when thou offerest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice for the performance of a vow, or for a peace-offering to Jehovah,

title: Numbers 15:9
text: then shall they present with the bullock as oblation three tenth parts of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil;

title: Numbers 15:10
text: and of wine shalt thou present half a hin, for a drink-offering, as an offering by fire, of a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:11
text: Thus shall it be done for one ox, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or for a kid;

title: Numbers 15:12
text: according to the number that ye offer, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

title: Numbers 15:13
text: And all that are born in the land shall do these things thus, in presenting an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:14
text: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whoever be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah, --as ye do, so shall he do.

title: Numbers 15:15
text: As to the congregation, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an everlasting statute throughout your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be, before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 15:16
text: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

title: Numbers 15:17
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 15:18
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

title: Numbers 15:19
text: then it shall be, when ye eat of the bread of the land, that ye shall offer a heave-offering to Jehovah;

title: Numbers 15:20
text: the first of your dough shall ye offer, a cake, for a heave-offering; as the heave-offering of the threshing-floor, so shall ye offer this.

title: Numbers 15:21
text: Of the first of your dough ye shall give to Jehovah a heave-offering throughout your generations.

title: Numbers 15:22
text: ¶And if ye sin inadvertently, and do not all these commandments, which Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses,

title: Numbers 15:23
text: all that Jehovah hath commanded you through Moses, from the day that Jehovah gave commandment, and henceforward throughout your generations;

title: Numbers 15:24
text: then it shall be, if ought be committed by inadvertence [hid] from the eyes of the assembly, that the whole assembly shall offer one young bullock for a burnt-offering, for a sweet odour to Jehovah, and its oblation and its drink-offering according to the ordinance, and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 15:25
text: And the priest shall make atonement for the whole assembly of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it was a sin of inadvertence, and they have brought before Jehovah their offering, as an offering by fire to Jehovah, and their sin-offering for their [sin of] inadvertence;

title: Numbers 15:26
text: and it shall be forgiven the whole assembly of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; for with all the people there was [a sin of] inadvertence.

title: Numbers 15:27
text: And if one soul sin through inadvertence, then he shall present a yearling she-goat for a sin-offering.

title: Numbers 15:28
text: And the priest shall make atonement for the soul that hath done inadvertently, when he sinneth by inadvertence before Jehovah, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Numbers 15:29
text: For him that is born in the land among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them--there shall be one law for you, for him who doeth anything through inadvertence.

title: Numbers 15:30
text: ¶But the soul that doeth ought with a high hand, whether born in the land, or a stranger, he reproacheth Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

title: Numbers 15:31
text: For he hath despised the word of Jehovah, and hath broken his commandment: that soul shall surely be cut off; his iniquity is upon him.

title: Numbers 15:32
text: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness they found a man gathering sticks on the sabbath day.

title: Numbers 15:33
text: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to the whole assembly.

title: Numbers 15:34
text: And they put him in custody, for it was not declared what should be done to him.

title: Numbers 15:35
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, The man shall certainly be put to death: the whole assembly shall stone him with stones outside the camp.

title: Numbers 15:36
text: And the whole assembly led him outside the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 15:37
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 15:38
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them tassels on the corners of their garments, throughout their generations, and that they attach to the tassel of the corners a lace of blue;

title: Numbers 15:39
text: and it shall be unto you for a tassel, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of Jehovah, and do them; and that ye seek not after [the lusts of] your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye go a whoring;

title: Numbers 15:40
text: that ye may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

title: Numbers 15:41
text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am Jehovah your God.

title: Numbers 16:1
text: ¶And Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, made bold, and [with him] Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, the sons of Reuben;

title: Numbers 16:2
text: and they rose up against Moses, with two hundred and fifty men of the children of Israel, princes of the assembly, summoned to the council, men of renown;

title: Numbers 16:3
text: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, It is enough; for all the assembly, all of them are holy, and Jehovah is among them; and why do ye lift up yourselves above the congregation of Jehovah?

title: Numbers 16:4
text: When Moses heard this, he fell on his face.

title: Numbers 16:5
text: And he spoke to Korah and to all his band, saying, Even to-morrow will Jehovah make known who is his, and who is holy; and he will cause him to come near to him; and him whom he has chosen, him will he cause to come near to him.

title: Numbers 16:6
text: This do: take you censers, Korah, and all his band,

title: Numbers 16:7
text: and put fire therein, and lay incense thereon before Jehovah to-morrow; and it shall be that the man whom Jehovah doth choose, he shall be holy. It is enough, ye sons of Levi!

title: Numbers 16:8
text: And Moses said to Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi!

title: Numbers 16:9
text: Is it too little for you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the assembly of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the work of the tabernacle of Jehovah, and to stand before the assembly to minister to them?

title: Numbers 16:10
text: --that he has brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee; and seek ye now the priesthood also?

title: Numbers 16:11
text: For which cause thou and all thy band are banded together against Jehovah; and Aaron, who is he that ye murmur against him?

title: Numbers 16:12
text: ¶And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; but they said, We will not come up!

title: Numbers 16:13
text: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that thou must make thyself altogether a ruler over us?

title: Numbers 16:14
text: Moreover, thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up!

title: Numbers 16:15
text: Then Moses was very wroth, and said to Jehovah, Have no regard to their oblation: not one ass have I taken from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

title: Numbers 16:16
text: And Moses said to Korah, Be thou and all thy band before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow.

title: Numbers 16:17
text: And take each his censer, and put incense thereon, and present before Jehovah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; and thou, and Aaron, each his censer.

title: Numbers 16:18
text: And they took each his censer, and put fire on them, and laid incense thereon, and stood before the entrance to the tent of meeting, as well as Moses and Aaron.

title: Numbers 16:19
text: And Korah gathered the whole assembly against them to the entrance of the tent of meeting. And the glory of Jehovah appeared to all the assembly.

title: Numbers 16:20
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 16:21
text: Separate yourselves from the midst of this assembly, and I will consume them in a moment.

title: Numbers 16:22
text: And they fell on their faces, and said, O *God, the God of the spirits of all flesh! shall *one* man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with the whole assembly?

title: Numbers 16:23
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 16:24
text: Speak unto the assembly, saying, Get you up from about the habitation of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

title: Numbers 16:25
text: And Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

title: Numbers 16:26
text: And he spoke to the assembly, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye perish in all their sins.

title: Numbers 16:27
text: And they got up from the habitation of Koran, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. And Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the entrance of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

title: Numbers 16:28
text: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that Jehovah has sent me to do all these deeds, for they are not out of my own heart:

title: Numbers 16:29
text: if these men die as all men die, and are visited with the visitation of all men, Jehovah has not sent me;

title: Numbers 16:30
text: but if Jehovah make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, and all that they have, and they go down alive into Sheol, then ye shall know that these men have despised Jehovah.

title: Numbers 16:31
text: And it came to pass when he had ended speaking all these words, that the ground clave apart that was under them.

title: Numbers 16:32
text: And the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men that belonged to Korah, and all their property.

title: Numbers 16:33
text: And they went down, they and all that they had, alive into Sheol, and the earth covered them; and they perished from among the congregation.

title: Numbers 16:34
text: And all Israel that were round about them fled at their cry; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up!

title: Numbers 16:35
text: ¶And there came out a fire from Jehovah, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that had presented incense.

title: Numbers 16:36
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 16:37
text: Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning; and scatter the fire afar; for they are hallowed,

title: Numbers 16:38
text: the censers of these sinners who have forfeited their life; and they shall make them into broad plates for the covering of the altar; for they presented them before Jehovah, therefore they are hallowed; and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 16:39
text: And Eleazar the priest took the copper censers, which they that were burnt had presented; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:

title: Numbers 16:40
text: as a memorial to the children of Israel, that no stranger who is not of the seed of Aaron come near to burn incense before Jehovah, that he be not as Korah, and as his band, --as Jehovah had said to him through Moses.

title: Numbers 16:41
text: ¶And the whole assembly of the children of Israel murmured on the morrow against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 16:42
text: And it came to pass, when the assembly was gathered together against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tent of meeting, and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Jehovah appeared.

title: Numbers 16:43
text: And Moses and Aaron went before the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 16:44
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 16:45
text: Get you up from the midst of this assembly, and I will consume them in a moment. And they fell on their faces.

title: Numbers 16:46
text: And Moses said to Aaron, Take the censer, and put fire thereon from off the altar, and lay on incense, and carry it quickly to the assembly, and make atonement for them; for there is wrath gone out from Jehovah: the plague is begun.

title: Numbers 16:47
text: And Aaron took as Moses had said, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and behold, the plague had begun among the people; and he put on incense, and made atonement for the people.

title: Numbers 16:48
text: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

title: Numbers 16:49
text: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides them that had died because of the matter of Korah.

title: Numbers 16:50
text: And Aaron returned to Moses to the entrance of the tent of meeting; and the plague was stayed.

title: Numbers 17:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 17:2
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of them a staff, a staff for each father's house, of all their princes according to the houses of their fathers, twelve staves: thou shalt write each one's name upon his staff.

title: Numbers 17:3
text: And Aaron's name shalt thou write upon the staff of Levi; for one staff shall be for [each] head of their fathers' houses.

title: Numbers 17:4
text: And thou shalt lay them up in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

title: Numbers 17:5
text: And it shall come to pass, that the man whom I shall choose, his staff shall bud forth; and I will make to cease from before me the murmurings of the children of Israel, that they murmur against you.

title: Numbers 17:6
text: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and all their princes gave him a staff, one staff for each prince according to their fathers' houses, twelve staves, and the staff of Aaron was among their staves.

title: Numbers 17:7
text: And Moses laid the staves before Jehovah in the tent of the testimony.

title: Numbers 17:8
text: ¶And it came to pass, when on the morrow Moses went into the tent of the testimony, behold, the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and ripened almonds.

title: Numbers 17:9
text: And Moses brought out all the staves from before Jehovah to all the children of Israel, and they looked and took each one his staff.

title: Numbers 17:10
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Bring Aaron's staff again before the testimony, to be kept as a token for the sons of rebellion, that thou mayest put an end to their murmurings before me, that they may not die.

title: Numbers 17:11
text: And Moses did so: as Jehovah had commanded him, so did he.

title: Numbers 17:12
text: And the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, Lo, we expire, we perish, we all perish.

title: Numbers 17:13
text: Every one that comes at all near to the tabernacle of Jehovah shall die: shall we then expire altogether?

title: Numbers 18:1
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

title: Numbers 18:2
text: And thy brethren also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring near with thee, that they may unite with thee, and minister unto thee; but thou and thy sons with thee [shall serve] before the tent of the testimony.

title: Numbers 18:3
text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of the whole tent: only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they may not die, and you as well as they.

title: Numbers 18:4
text: And they shall unite with thee, and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; and no stranger shall come near to you.

title: Numbers 18:5
text: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar; that there come no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 18:6
text: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren, the Levites, from among the children of Israel; to you are they given as a gift for Jehovah to perform the service of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 18:7
text: But thou and thy sons with thee shall attend to your priesthood for all that concerneth the altar, and for that which is inside the veil; and ye shall perform the service: I give you your priesthood as a service of gift, and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

title: Numbers 18:8
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Aaron, And I, behold, I have given thee the charge of my heave-offerings, of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; to thee have I given them, because of the anointing, and to thy sons by an everlasting statute.

title: Numbers 18:9
text: This shall be thine of the most holy things, [reserved] from the fire: every offering of theirs, of all their oblations, and of all their sin-offerings, and of all their trespass-offerings, which they render unto me, it is most holy for thee and for thy sons.

title: Numbers 18:10
text: As most holy shalt thou eat it: every male shall eat it; it shall be holy unto thee.

title: Numbers 18:11
text: And this shall be thine: the heave-offering of their gift, with all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by an everlasting statute; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

title: Numbers 18:12
text: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the new wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they give to Jehovah, have I given thee.

title: Numbers 18:13
text: The first ripe of everything that is in their land, which they shall bring to Jehovah, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

title: Numbers 18:14
text: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be thine.

title: Numbers 18:15
text: Everything that breaketh open the womb of all flesh, which they present to Jehovah, of men or of beasts, shall be thine; nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou in any case ransom, and the firstborn of unclean beasts shalt thou ransom.

title: Numbers 18:16
text: And those that are to be ransomed from a month old shalt thou ransom, according to thy valuation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

title: Numbers 18:17
text: But the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, thou shalt not ransom: they are holy. Thou shalt sprinkle their blood on the altar, and their fat shalt thou burn as an offering by fire for a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 18:18
text: And their flesh shall be thine; as the wave-breast and as the right shoulder shall it be thine.

title: Numbers 18:19
text: All the heave-offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Jehovah, have I given thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by an everlasting statute: it shall be an everlasting covenant of salt before Jehovah unto thee and thy seed with thee.

title: Numbers 18:20
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Aaron, In their land thou shalt have no inheritance, neither shalt thou have any portion among them: I am thy portion and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 18:21
text: And to the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithes in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they perform, the service of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 18:22
text: Neither shall the children of Israel henceforth come near the tent of meeting, to bear sin and die.

title: Numbers 18:23
text: But the Levite, he shall perform the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it is an everlasting statute throughout your generations. And among the children of Israel shall they possess no inheritance;

title: Numbers 18:24
text: for I have given for an inheritance to the Levites the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as a heave-offering to Jehovah; therefore I have said of them, They shall possess no inheritance among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 18:25
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 18:26
text: And to the Levites shalt thou speak, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer a heave-offering from it for Jehovah, the tenth of the tithe.

title: Numbers 18:27
text: And your heave-offering shall be reckoned unto you, as the corn from the threshing-floor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

title: Numbers 18:28
text: Thus ye also shall offer Jehovah's heave-offering of all your tithes, which ye take of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof Jehovah's heave-offering to Aaron the priest.

title: Numbers 18:29
text: Out of all that is given you ye shall offer the whole heave-offering of Jehovah, --of all the best thereof the hallowed part thereof.

title: Numbers 18:30
text: And thou shalt say unto them, When ye heave the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as produce of the threshing-floor, and as produce of the winepress.

title: Numbers 18:31
text: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households; for it is your reward for your service in the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 18:32
text: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, if ye heave from it the best of it; and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

title: Numbers 19:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

title: Numbers 19:2
text: This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without blemish, wherein is no defect, and upon which never came yoke;

title: Numbers 19:3
text: and ye shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring it outside the camp, and one shall slaughter it before him.

title: Numbers 19:4
text: And Eleazar the priest shall take of its blood with his finger, and shall sprinkle of its blood directly before the tent of meeting seven times.

title: Numbers 19:5
text: And one shall burn the heifer before his eyes; its skin and its flesh, and its blood, with its dung, shall he burn.

title: Numbers 19:6
text: And the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

title: Numbers 19:7
text: And the priest shall wash his garments, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterwards he shall come into the camp; and the priest shall be unclean until the even;

title: Numbers 19:8
text: and he that hath burned it shall wash his garments in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

title: Numbers 19:9
text: And a clean man shall gather the ashes of the heifer, and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the assembly of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

title: Numbers 19:10
text: And he that hath gathered the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even. And it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, an everlasting statute.

title: Numbers 19:11
text: ¶He that toucheth a dead person, any dead body of a man, shall be unclean seven days.

title: Numbers 19:12
text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

title: Numbers 19:13
text: Whoever toucheth a dead person, the dead body of a man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; for the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him: he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

title: Numbers 19:14
text: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: every one that cometh into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

title: Numbers 19:15
text: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, shall be unclean.

title: Numbers 19:16
text: And every one that toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead person, or the bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

title: Numbers 19:17
text: And they shall take for the unclean of the ashes of the purification-offering that hath been burned, and shall put running water thereon in a vessel;

title: Numbers 19:18
text: and a clean man shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, and upon all the utensils, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that hath touched the bone, or the one slain, or the dead person, or the grave;

title: Numbers 19:19
text: and the clean shall sprinkle it on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day; and he shall purify him on the seventh day; and he shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

title: Numbers 19:20
text: And the man that is unclean, and doth not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the congregation, for he hath defiled the sanctuary of Jehovah: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled on him: he is unclean.

title: Numbers 19:21
text: And it shall be an everlasting statute unto them. And he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his garments, and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

title: Numbers 19:22
text: And whatever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

title: Numbers 20:1
text: ¶And the children of Israel, the whole assembly, came into the wilderness of Zin, in the first month; and the people abode at Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

title: Numbers 20:2
text: And there was no water for the assembly, and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

title: Numbers 20:3
text: And the people contended with Moses, and spoke, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before Jehovah!

title: Numbers 20:4
text: And why have ye brought the congregation of Jehovah into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our beasts?

title: Numbers 20:5
text: And why have ye made us to go up out of Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates, neither is there any water to drink.

title: Numbers 20:6
text: And Moses and Aaron went from before the congregation to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and fell upon their faces; and the glory of Jehovah appeared to them.

title: Numbers 20:7
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 20:8
text: Take the staff, and gather the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes, and it shall give its water; and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock, and shalt give the assembly and their beasts drink.

title: Numbers 20:9
text: And Moses took the staff from before Jehovah, as he had commanded him.

title: Numbers 20:10
text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said to them, Hear now, ye rebels: shall we bring forth to you water out of this rock?

title: Numbers 20:11
text: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his staff smote the rock twice, and much water came out, and the assembly drank, and their beasts.

title: Numbers 20:12
text: And Jehovah said to Moses and to Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to hallow me before the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land that I have given them.

title: Numbers 20:13
text: These are the waters of Meribah, where the children of Israel contended with Jehovah, and he hallowed himself in them.

title: Numbers 20:14
text: ¶And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, Thus says thy brother Israel: Thou knowest all the trouble that hath befallen us,

title: Numbers 20:15
text: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians evil entreated us and our fathers;

title: Numbers 20:16
text: and when we cried to Jehovah, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt; and behold, we are at Kadesh, a city at the extremity of thy border.

title: Numbers 20:17
text: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country; we will not pass through fields, or through vineyards, neither will we drink water out of the wells: we will go by the king's road; we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy border.

title: Numbers 20:18
text: But Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

title: Numbers 20:19
text: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go by the high way; and if we drink of thy water, I and my cattle, then I will pay for it: I will only, without anything else, go through on my feet.

title: Numbers 20:20
text: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

title: Numbers 20:21
text: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; and Israel turned away from him.

title: Numbers 20:22
text: ¶And they removed from Kadesh; and the children of Israel, the whole assembly, came to mount Hor.

title: Numbers 20:23
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron in mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom, saying,

title: Numbers 20:24
text: Aaron shall be gathered unto his peoples; for he shall not enter into the land that I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my commandment at the waters of Meribah.

title: Numbers 20:25
text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor,

title: Numbers 20:26
text: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron shall be gathered [to his peoples], and shall die there.

title: Numbers 20:27
text: And Moses did as Jehovah had commanded, and they went up mount Hor before the eyes of the whole assembly.

title: Numbers 20:28
