text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there upon the top of the mountain; and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

title: Numbers 20:29
text: And the whole assembly saw that Aaron was dead, and they mourned for Aaron thirty days, [even] the whole house of Israel.

title: Numbers 21:1
text: ¶And the Canaanite king of Arad, who dwelt in the south, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim, and he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

title: Numbers 21:2
text: Then Israel vowed a vow to Jehovah, and said, If thou give this people wholly into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

title: Numbers 21:3
text: And Jehovah listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them, and their cities. And they called the name of the place Hormah.

title: Numbers 21:4
text: ¶And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to go round the land of Edom; and the soul of the people became impatient on the way;

title: Numbers 21:5
text: and the people spoke against God, and against Moses, Why have ye brought us up out of Egypt that we should die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, and no water, and our soul loathes this light bread.

title: Numbers 21:6
text: Then Jehovah sent fiery serpents among the people, which bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

title: Numbers 21:7
text: And the people came to Moses and said, We have sinned, in that we have spoken against Jehovah, and against thee: pray to Jehovah that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

title: Numbers 21:8
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Make thee a fiery [serpent], and set it upon a pole; and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, and looketh upon it, shall live.

title: Numbers 21:9
text: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole; and it came to pass, if a serpent had bitten any man, and he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

title: Numbers 21:10
text: ¶And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in Oboth.

title: Numbers 21:11
text: And they removed from Oboth, and encamped at Ijim-Abarim, in the wilderness that is before Moab, toward the sun-rising.

title: Numbers 21:12
text: From thence they removed, and encamped at the torrent Zered.

title: Numbers 21:13
text: From thence they removed, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites. For the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

title: Numbers 21:14
text: Therefore it is said in the book of the wars of Jehovah, Vaheb in Suphah, and the brooks of Arnon;

title: Numbers 21:15
text: And the stream of the brooks which turneth to the dwelling of Ar, And inclineth toward the border of Moab.

title: Numbers 21:16
text: And from thence to Beer: that is the well of which Jehovah spoke to Moses, Assemble the people, and I will give them water.

title: Numbers 21:17
text: Then Israel sang this song, Rise up, well! sing unto it:

title: Numbers 21:18
text: Well which princes digged, which the nobles of the people hollowed out at [the word of] the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness [they went] to Mattanah;

title: Numbers 21:19
text: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

title: Numbers 21:20
text: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the fields of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks over the surface of the waste.

title: Numbers 21:21
text: ¶And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

title: Numbers 21:22
text: Let us pass through thy land; we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink water out of the wells; on the king's road will we go until we have passed thy border.

title: Numbers 21:23
text: But Sihon would not suffer Israel to go through his border; and Sihon gathered all his people, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

title: Numbers 21:24
text: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

title: Numbers 21:25
text: And Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, at Heshbon, and in all its dependent villages.

title: Numbers 21:26
text: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites; and he had fought against the former king of Moab, and had taken all his land out of his hand, even unto the Arnon.

title: Numbers 21:27
text: Therefore the poets say, Come to Heshbon; let the city of Sihon be built and established.

title: Numbers 21:28
text: For there went forth fire from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon; It consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of the Arnon.

title: Numbers 21:29
text: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, people of Chemosh: He gave his sons that had escaped, and his daughters into captivity to Sihon the king of the Amorites.

title: Numbers 21:30
text: And we have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon; and we have laid [them] waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

title: Numbers 21:31
text: And Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

title: Numbers 21:32
text: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took its dependent villages, and he dispossessed the Amorites that were there.

title: Numbers 21:33
text: And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan; and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, for battle to Edrei.

title: Numbers 21:34
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Fear him not! for into thy hand have I given him, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

title: Numbers 21:35
text: And they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, so that they left him none remaining, and took possession of his land.

title: Numbers 22:1
text: ¶And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the plains of Moab on the other side of the Jordan from Jericho.

title: Numbers 22:2
text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

title: Numbers 22:3
text: And Moab was much afraid of the people, because they were many; and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 22:4
text: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now will this company lick up all that is round about us, as an ox licks up the green herb of the field. Now Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

title: Numbers 22:5
text: And he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is on the river in the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, a people is come out from Egypt; behold, they cover the face of the land, and they abide over against me.

title: Numbers 22:6
text: And now come, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are mightier than I: perhaps I may be able to smite them, and drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

title: Numbers 22:7
text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed, having the rewards of divination in their hand. And they came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

title: Numbers 22:8
text: And he said to them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, according as Jehovah shall speak unto me. And the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

title: Numbers 22:9
text: And God came to Balaam, and said, Who are these men with thee?

title: Numbers 22:10
text: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me,

title: Numbers 22:11
text: Behold, a people is come out of Egypt, and it covers the face of the land. Now come, curse me them: perhaps I may be able to fight against them, and drive them out.

title: Numbers 22:12
text: And God said to Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people; for they are blessed.

title: Numbers 22:13
text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, Go into your land; for Jehovah refuses to give me leave to go with you.

title: Numbers 22:14
text: And the princes of Moab rose up; and they went to Balak, and said, Balaam has refused to come with us.

title: Numbers 22:15
text: ¶Then sent Balak yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

title: Numbers 22:16
text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: Suffer not thyself, I pray thee, to be restrained from coming to me;

title: Numbers 22:17
text: for very highly will I honour thee, and whatever thou shalt say to me will I do; come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

title: Numbers 22:18
text: And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, If Balak give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the commandment of Jehovah my God, to do less or more.

title: Numbers 22:19
text: And now, I pray you, abide ye also here this night, and I shall know what Jehovah will say to me further.

title: Numbers 22:20
text: Then God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, If the men have come to call thee, rise up, [and] go with them; but only what I shall say unto thee shalt thou do.

title: Numbers 22:21
text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

title: Numbers 22:22
text: ¶And God's anger was kindled because he went; and the Angel of Jehovah set himself in the way to withstand him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two young men were with him.

title: Numbers 22:23
text: And the ass saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand; and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field, and Balaam smote the ass to turn her into the way.

title: Numbers 22:24
text: And the Angel of Jehovah stood in a hollow of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

title: Numbers 22:25
text: And the ass saw the Angel of Jehovah, and she pressed herself against the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall; and he smote her again.

title: Numbers 22:26
text: Then the Angel of Jehovah went still further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

title: Numbers 22:27
text: And the ass saw the Angel of Jehovah, and lay down under Balaam; and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with his staff.

title: Numbers 22:28
text: And Jehovah opened the mouth of the ass, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

title: Numbers 22:29
text: And Balaam said to the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now would I kill thee!

title: Numbers 22:30
text: And the ass said to Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine to this day? was I ever wont to do so to thee? And he said, No.

title: Numbers 22:31
text: Then Jehovah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed and prostrated himself on his face.

title: Numbers 22:32
text: And the Angel of Jehovah said to him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, it was I who came forth to withstand thee, for the way [thou walkest in] is for ruin before me.

title: Numbers 22:33
text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times; had she not turned from me, I had now certainly slain thee, and saved her alive.

title: Numbers 22:34
text: And Balaam said to the Angel of Jehovah, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me; and now, if it be evil in thine eyes, I will get me back again.

title: Numbers 22:35
text: And the Angel of Jehovah said to Balaam, Go with the men, but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that shalt thou speak. And Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

title: Numbers 22:36
text: ¶And when Balak heard that Balaam came, he went out to meet him, to the city of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is at the extremity of the border.

title: Numbers 22:37
text: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not earnestly send to thee to call thee? why didst thou not come to me? am I not surely able to honour thee?

title: Numbers 22:38
text: And Balaam said to Balak, Lo, I am come to thee; but shall I now be able at all to say anything? the word that God puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.

title: Numbers 22:39
text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjath-huzoth.

title: Numbers 22:40
text: And Balak offered oxen and small cattle, and sent to Balaam and to the princes that were with him.

title: Numbers 22:41
text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up to the high places of Baal, and he saw from thence the extremity of the people.

title: Numbers 23:1
text: ¶And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

title: Numbers 23:2
text: And Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam offered up a bullock and a ram on [each] altar.

title: Numbers 23:3
text: And Balaam said to Balak, Stand by thy burnt-offering, and I will go; perhaps Jehovah will come to meet me; and whatever he shews me I will tell thee. And he went to a hill.

title: Numbers 23:4
text: And God met Balaam; and [Balaam] said to him, I have disposed seven altars, and have offered up a bullock and a ram upon [each] altar.

title: Numbers 23:5
text: And Jehovah put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.

title: Numbers 23:6
text: And he returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt-offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

title: Numbers 23:7
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, from the mountains of the east: Come, curse me Jacob, and come, denounce Israel!

title: Numbers 23:8
text: How shall I curse whom *God hath not cursed? or how shall I denounce whom Jehovah doth not denounce?

title: Numbers 23:9
text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: Lo, [it is] a people that shall dwell alone and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

title: Numbers 23:10
text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let my soul die the death of the righteous, and let my end be like his!

title: Numbers 23:11
text: And Balak said to Balaam, What hast thou done to me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

title: Numbers 23:12
text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Jehovah puts in my mouth?

title: Numbers 23:13
text: ¶And Balak said to him, Come, I pray thee, with me to another place, from whence thou wilt see them; thou shalt see only the extremity of them and shalt not see them all, and curse me them from thence.

title: Numbers 23:14
text: And he took him to the watchmen's field, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bullock and a ram on [each] altar.

title: Numbers 23:15
text: And [Balaam] said to Balak, Stand here by thy burnt-offering, and I will go to meet yonder.

title: Numbers 23:16
text: And Jehovah met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.

title: Numbers 23:17
text: And he came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him; and Balak said to him, What has Jehovah spoken?

title: Numbers 23:18
text: Then he took up his parable and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear! hearken unto me, son of Zippor!

title: Numbers 23:19
text: *God is not a man, that he should lie; neither a son of man, that he should repent. Shall he say and not do? and shall he speak and not make it good?

title: Numbers 23:20
text: Behold, I have received [mission] to bless; and he hath blessed, and I cannot reverse it.

title: Numbers 23:21
text: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen wrong in Israel; Jehovah his God is with him, and the shout of a king is in his midst.

title: Numbers 23:22
text: *God brought him out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of a buffalo.

title: Numbers 23:23
text: For there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. At this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath *God wrought!

title: Numbers 23:24
text: Lo, the people will rise up as a lioness, and lift himself up as a lion. He shall not lie down until he have eaten the prey and drunk the blood of the slain.

title: Numbers 23:25
text: And Balak said to Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

title: Numbers 23:26
text: And Balaam answered and said to Balak, Did I not tell thee, saying, All that Jehovah shall speak, that will I do?

title: Numbers 23:27
text: And Balak said to Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee to another place; perhaps it will be right in the sight of God that thou curse me them from thence.

title: Numbers 23:28
text: And Balak brought Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks over the surface of the waste.

title: Numbers 23:29
text: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

title: Numbers 23:30
text: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bullock and a ram on each altar.

title: Numbers 24:1
text: ¶And Balaam saw that it was good in the sight of Jehovah to bless Israel, and he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

title: Numbers 24:2
text: And Balaam lifted up his eyes and saw Israel dwelling [in tents] according to his tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.

title: Numbers 24:3
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, and the man of opened eye saith,

title: Numbers 24:4
text: He saith, who heareth the words of *God, who seeth the vision of the Almighty, who falleth down, and who hath his eyes open:

title: Numbers 24:5
text: How goodly are thy tents, Jacob, and thy tabernacles, Israel!

title: Numbers 24:6
text: Like valleys are they spread forth, like gardens by the river side, Like aloe-trees which Jehovah hath planted, like cedars beside the waters.

title: Numbers 24:7
text: Water shall flow out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in great waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

title: Numbers 24:8
text: *God brought him out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of a buffalo. He shall consume the nations his enemies, and break their bones, and with his arrows shall smite [them] in pieces.

title: Numbers 24:9
text: He stooped, he lay down like a lion, and like a lioness: who will stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

title: Numbers 24:10
text: ¶Then Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast altogether blessed [them] these three times!

title: Numbers 24:11
text: And now flee thou to thy place; I said I would very highly honour thee, and behold, Jehovah has kept thee back from honour.

title: Numbers 24:12
text: And Balaam said to Balak, Did I not also speak to thy messengers whom thou sentest to me, saying,

title: Numbers 24:13
text: If Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the commandment of Jehovah to do good or bad out of my heart: what Jehovah shall say, that will I speak?

title: Numbers 24:14
text: And now behold, I go to my people: come, I will admonish thee what this people will do to thy people at the end of days.

title: Numbers 24:15
text: ¶And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, and the man of opened eye saith,

title: Numbers 24:16
text: He saith, who heareth the words of *God, who knoweth the knowledge of the Most High, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, who falleth down, and who hath his eyes open:

title: Numbers 24:17
text: I shall see him, but not now; I shall behold him, but not nigh: There cometh a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and he shall cut in pieces the corners of Moab, and destroy all the sons of tumult.

title: Numbers 24:18
text: And Edom shall be a possession, and Seir a possession, --they, his enemies; but Israel will do valiantly.

title: Numbers 24:19
text: And one out of Jacob shall have dominion, and will destroy out of the city what remaineth.

title: Numbers 24:20
text: And he saw Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, Amalek is the first of the nations, but his latter end shall be for destruction.

title: Numbers 24:21
text: And he saw the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Firm is thy dwelling-place, and thy nest fixed in the rock;

title: Numbers 24:22
text: But the Kenite shall be consumed, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

title: Numbers 24:23
text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas! Who shall live when *God doeth this?

title: Numbers 24:24
text: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and afflict Asshur, and afflict Eber, and he also shall be for destruction.

title: Numbers 24:25
text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

title: Numbers 25:1
text: ¶And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to commit fornication with the daughters of Moab.

title: Numbers 25:2
text: And they invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods; and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.

title: Numbers 25:3
text: And Israel joined himself to Baal-Peor; and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.

title: Numbers 25:4
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up to Jehovah before the sun, that the fierce anger of Jehovah may be turned away from Israel.

title: Numbers 25:5
text: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Slay every one his men that have joined themselves to Baal-Peor.

title: Numbers 25:6
text: ¶And behold, a man of the children of Israel came and brought a Midianitish woman to his brethren, in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the entrance of the tent of meeting.

title: Numbers 25:7
text: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, and rose up from among the assembly, and took a javelin in his hand,

title: Numbers 25:8
text: and he went after the man of Israel into the tent-chamber, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly. And the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 25:9
text: And those that died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.

title: Numbers 25:10
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 25:11
text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

title: Numbers 25:12
text: Therefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace!

title: Numbers 25:13
text: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 25:14
text: And the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, the prince of a father's house of the Simeonites.

title: Numbers 25:15
text: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was tribal head of a father's house in Midian.

title: Numbers 25:16
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 25:17
text: Harass the Midianites, and smite them,

title: Numbers 25:18
text: for they have harassed you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague because of the matter of Peor.

title: Numbers 26:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after the plague, that Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

title: Numbers 26:2
text: Take the sum of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, according to their fathers' houses, all that go forth to military service in Israel.

title: Numbers 26:3
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,

title: Numbers 26:4
text: From twenty years old and upward...; as Jehovah had commanded Moses and the children of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt.

title: Numbers 26:5
text: ¶Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: the children of Reuben: [of] Enoch, the family of the Enochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

title: Numbers 26:6
text: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

title: Numbers 26:7
text: These are the families of the Reubenites; and they that were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 26:8
text: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab;

title: Numbers 26:9
text: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, summoned of the assembly, who contended against Moses and against Aaron in the band of Korah, when they contended against Jehovah.

title: Numbers 26:10
text: And the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that band died, when the fire devoured the two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.

title: Numbers 26:11
text: But the children of Korah died not.

title: Numbers 26:12
text: The sons of Simeon, after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

title: Numbers 26:13
text: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites; of Saul, the family of the Saulites.

title: Numbers 26:14
text: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

title: Numbers 26:15
text: The children of Gad, after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

title: Numbers 26:16
text: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

title: Numbers 26:17
text: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

title: Numbers 26:18
text: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 26:19
text: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

title: Numbers 26:20
text: And the sons of Judah, after their families: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Pherez, the family of the Pharzites; of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

title: Numbers 26:21
text: And the sons of Pherez: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

title: Numbers 26:22
text: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 26:23
text: The sons of Issachar, after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puah, the family of the Punites;

title: Numbers 26:24
text: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

title: Numbers 26:25
text: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

title: Numbers 26:26
text: The sons of Zebulun, after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

title: Numbers 26:27
text: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

title: Numbers 26:28
text: The sons of Joseph, after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

title: Numbers 26:29
text: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites (and Machir begot Gilead); of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

title: Numbers 26:30
text: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helkites;

title: Numbers 26:31
text: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

title: Numbers 26:32
text: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

title: Numbers 26:33
text: --And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Numbers 26:34
text: --These are the families of Manasseh; and those that were numbered of them, fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

title: Numbers 26:35
text: These are the sons of Ephraim, after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites; of Becher, the family of the Bachrites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

title: Numbers 26:36
text: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

title: Numbers 26:37
text: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

title: Numbers 26:38
text: The sons of Benjamin, after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

title: Numbers 26:39
text: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

title: Numbers 26:40
text: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman; [of Ard] the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

title: Numbers 26:41
text: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

title: Numbers 26:42
text: These are the sons of Dan, after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

title: Numbers 26:43
text: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 26:44
text: The sons of Asher, after their families: of Jimnah, the family of the Jimnites; of Jishvi, the family of the Jishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

title: Numbers 26:45
text: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

title: Numbers 26:46
text: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

title: Numbers 26:47
text: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 26:48
text: The sons of Naphtali, after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

title: Numbers 26:49
text: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

title: Numbers 26:50
text: These are the families of Naphtali, according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

title: Numbers 26:51
text: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.

title: Numbers 26:52
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 26:53
text: Unto these shall the land be divided for an inheritance according to the number of the names;

title: Numbers 26:54
text: to the many thou shalt increase their inheritance, and to the few thou shalt diminish their inheritance; to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

title: Numbers 26:55
text: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot; according to the names of the tribes of their fathers shall they inherit;

title: Numbers 26:56
text: according to lot shall his inheritance be divided to each, be they many or few in number.

title: Numbers 26:57
text: ¶And these are the numbered of the Levites, after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

title: Numbers 26:58
text: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. --And Kohath begot Amram.

title: Numbers 26:59
text: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

title: Numbers 26:60
text: And to Aaron were born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

title: Numbers 26:61
text: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they presented strange fire before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 26:62
text: And those that were numbered of the [Levites] were twenty-three thousand, all males from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 26:63
text: ¶These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.

title: Numbers 26:64
text: But among these there was not a man numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 26:65
text: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 27:1
text: ¶Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Numbers 27:2
text: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and the whole assembly, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,

title: Numbers 27:3
text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the band of them that banded themselves together against Jehovah in the band of Korah; but he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.

title: Numbers 27:4
text: Why should the name of our father be taken away from his family, because he has no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.

title: Numbers 27:5
text: And Moses brought their cause before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 27:6
text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 27:7
text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

title: Numbers 27:8
text: And unto the children of Israel shalt thou speak, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

title: Numbers 27:9
text: And if he have no daughter, ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

title: Numbers 27:10
text: And if he have no brethren, ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

title: Numbers 27:11
text: And if his father have no brethren, ye shall give his inheritance to his kinsman that is nearest to him in his family, and he shall possess it; and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of right, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 27:12
text: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land that I have given unto the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 27:13
text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy peoples, as Aaron thy brother was gathered,

title: Numbers 27:14
text: because ye rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, as to hallowing me in the matter of the water before their eyes. (That is the water of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

title: Numbers 27:15
text: ¶And Moses spoke to Jehovah, saying,

title: Numbers 27:16
text: Let Jehovah, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the assembly,

title: Numbers 27:17
text: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the assembly of Jehovah be not as sheep that have no shepherd.

title: Numbers 27:18
text: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and thou shalt lay thy hand upon him;

title: Numbers 27:19
text: and thou shalt set him before Eleazar the priest, and before the whole assembly; and give him commandment before their eyes.

title: Numbers 27:20
text: And thou shalt put of thine honour upon him, that the whole assembly of the children of Israel may obey him.

title: Numbers 27:21
text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him, by the judgment of the Urim before Jehovah: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, he, and all the children of Israel with him, even the whole assembly.

title: Numbers 27:22
text: And Moses did as Jehovah had commanded him; and he took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before the whole assembly.

title: Numbers 27:23
text: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him commandment, as Jehovah had said through Moses.

title: Numbers 28:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 28:2
text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, my bread for my offerings by fire of sweet odour to me, shall ye take heed to present to me at their set time.

title: Numbers 28:3
text: And say unto them, This is the offering by fire which ye shall present to Jehovah: two yearling lambs without blemish, day by day, as a continual burnt-offering.

title: Numbers 28:4
text: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings;

title: Numbers 28:5
text: and a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for an oblation, mingled with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin:

title: Numbers 28:6
text: [it is] the continual burnt-offering which was ordained on mount Sinai for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:7
text: And the drink-offering thereof shall be a fourth part of a hin for one lamb; in the sanctuary shall the drink-offering of strong drink be poured out to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:8
text: And the second lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings; [with the] like oblation as that of the morning, and the like drink-offering, shalt thou offer it as an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:9
text: ¶And on the sabbath day two yearling lambs without blemish, and two tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:

title: Numbers 28:10
text: it is the burnt-offering of the sabbath, for each sabbath besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 28:11
text: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall present a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish.

title: Numbers 28:12
text: And three tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, for the ram;

title: Numbers 28:13
text: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil as an oblation for each lamb: [it is] a burnt-offering of a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:14
text: And their drink-offerings: half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the monthly burnt-offering for each month throughout the months of the year.

title: Numbers 28:15
text: And a buck of the goats shall be offered, for a sin-offering to Jehovah, besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 28:16
text: ¶And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the passover to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 28:17
text: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

title: Numbers 28:18
text: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do;

title: Numbers 28:19
text: and ye shall present an offering by fire, a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven yearling lambs; they shall be unto you without blemish;

title: Numbers 28:20
text: and their oblation shall be of fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;

title: Numbers 28:21
text: one tenth part shalt thou offer for each lamb, of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 28:22
text: and a he-goat as a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.

title: Numbers 28:23
text: Besides the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering, shall ye offer this.

title: Numbers 28:24
text: After this manner ye shall offer daily, seven days, the bread of the offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 28:25
text: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation; no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Numbers 28:26
text: And on the day of the first-fruits, when ye present a new oblation to Jehovah, after your weeks, ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Numbers 28:27
text: And ye shall present a burnt-offering for a sweet odour to Jehovah: two young bullocks, one ram, seven yearling lambs;

title: Numbers 28:28
text: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for one bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,

title: Numbers 28:29
text: one tenth part for each lamb of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 28:30
text: [and] one buck of the goats, to make atonement for you.

title: Numbers 28:31
text: Ye shall offer them besides the continual burnt-offering, and its oblation (without blemish shall they be unto you), and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:1
text: ¶And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do; a day of blowing the trumpets shall it be unto you.

title: Numbers 29:2
text: And ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet odour to Jehovah: one young bullock, one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:3
text: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,

title: Numbers 29:4
text: and one tenth part for each lamb of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 29:5
text: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you,

title: Numbers 29:6
text: --besides the monthly burnt-offering and its oblation, and the continual burnt-offering and its oblation, and their drink-offerings, according to their ordinance, for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

title: Numbers 29:7
text: And on the tenth of this seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls; no manner of work shall ye do.

title: Numbers 29:8
text: And ye shall present a burnt-offering to Jehovah for a sweet odour: one young bullock, one ram, seven yearling lambs (without blemish shall they be unto you);

title: Numbers 29:9
text: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,

title: Numbers 29:10
text: one tenth part for each lamb, of the seven lambs;

title: Numbers 29:11
text: [and] one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, --besides the sin-offering of atonement, and the continual burnt-offering and its oblation, and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:12
text: ¶And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do; and ye shall celebrate a feast to Jehovah seven days;

title: Numbers 29:13
text: and ye shall present a burnt-offering, an offering by fire for a sweet odour to Jehovah: thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs (they shall be without blemish);

title: Numbers 29:14
text: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts for each bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,

title: Numbers 29:15
text: and one tenth part for each lamb of the fourteen lambs;

title: Numbers 29:16
text: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 29:17
text: And on the second day, [ye shall present] twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:18
text: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:19
text: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation, and their drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:20
text: And on the third day, eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:21
text: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:22
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 29:23
text: And on the fourth day, ten bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:24
text: their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:25
text: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 29:26
text: And on the fifth day, nine bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:27
text: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:28
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 29:29
text: And on the sixth day, eight bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:30
text: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:31
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:32
text: And on the seventh day, seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:33
text: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to their ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:34
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 29:35
text: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: no manner of servile work shall ye do.

title: Numbers 29:36
text: And ye shall present a burnt-offering, an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah: one bullock, one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish;

title: Numbers 29:37
text: their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;

title: Numbers 29:38
text: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, --besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation and its drink-offering.

title: Numbers 29:39
text: These shall ye offer to Jehovah in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your voluntary-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your oblations, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.

title: Numbers 29:40
text: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 30:1
text: ¶And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is what Jehovah hath commanded.

title: Numbers 30:2
text: If a man vow a vow to Jehovah, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; according to all that hath gone out of his mouth shall he do.

title: Numbers 30:3
text: ¶If a woman also vow a vow to Jehovah, and bind herself by a bond, in her father's house in her youth,

title: Numbers 30:4
text: and her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall be silent at her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

title: Numbers 30:5
text: But if her father prohibited her in the day that he heard, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand; and Jehovah shall pardon her, because her father prohibited her.

title: Numbers 30:6
text: And if she have a husband, when she hath her vow upon her or ought that hath passed her lips wherewith she hath bound her soul,

title: Numbers 30:7
text: and her husband hear it and be silent at her in the day that he heareth it, then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

title: Numbers 30:8
text: But if her husband prohibit her on the day that he heareth it, and annul her vow which is upon her, and what hath passed her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul, then Jehovah shall pardon her.

title: Numbers 30:9
text: But the vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, --everything wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand against her.

title: Numbers 30:10
text: And if she have vowed in her husband's house, or have bound her soul by an oath with a bond,

title: Numbers 30:11
text: and her husband have heard it, and been silent at her, and hath not prohibited her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

title: Numbers 30:12
text: But if her husband have expressly annulled them on the day that he heard them, then nothing of that which is gone out of her lips as to her vows or the bond on her soul, shall stand: her husband hath annulled them; and Jehovah will pardon her.

title: Numbers 30:13
text: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband can establish it, or her husband can annul it.

title: Numbers 30:14
text: And if her husband be altogether silent at her from day to day, then he hath established all her vows or all her bonds which are upon her; he hath confirmed them, for he hath been silent at her in the day that he heard them.

title: Numbers 30:15
text: But if he in any way annul them after he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.

title: Numbers 30:16
text: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, in her youth in her father's house.

title: Numbers 31:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 31:2
text: Avenge the children of Israel upon the Midianites; afterwards shalt thou be gathered unto thy peoples.

title: Numbers 31:3
text: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm from amongst you men for military service, that they go against Midian to execute Jehovah's vengeance upon Midian.

title: Numbers 31:4
text: Of every tribe a thousand, of all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

title: Numbers 31:5
text: And there were levied out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand by tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

title: Numbers 31:6
text: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand by the tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, and the holy instruments, even the alarm-trumpets in his hand.

title: Numbers 31:7
text: ¶And they warred against Midian, as Jehovah had commanded Moses, and slew all the males.

title: Numbers 31:8
text: And they slew the kings of Midian, besides the others slain, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian; and Balaam the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

title: Numbers 31:9
text: And the children of Israel took the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took for a spoil all their cattle and all their flocks and all their goods;

title: Numbers 31:10
text: and all their cities in their settlements and all their encampments they burned with fire.

title: Numbers 31:11
text: And they took all the booty, and all the prey, of man and of cattle;

title: Numbers 31:12
text: and they brought to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and to the assembly of the children of Israel, the captives and the prey and the booty, to the camp in the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan of Jericho.

title: Numbers 31:13
text: ¶And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the princes of the assembly went forth to meet them outside the camp.

title: Numbers 31:14
text: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the army, with the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war;

title: Numbers 31:15
text: and Moses said to them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

title: Numbers 31:16
text: Lo, these, through the counsel of Balaam, caused the children of Israel to commit sin against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague on the assembly of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:17
text: And now slay every male among the little ones, and slay every woman that hath known man by lying with him,

title: Numbers 31:18
text: but all the children among the women that have not known lying with a man, keep alive for yourselves.

title: Numbers 31:19
text: And encamp outside the camp seven days; whoever hath killed a person, and whoever hath touched any slain; ye shall purify yourselves on the third day, and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

title: Numbers 31:20
text: And every garment, and every vessel of skin, and all work of goat's hair, and every utensil of wood shall ye purify.

title: Numbers 31:21
text: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war that had gone to the battle, This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:22
text: Only the gold, and the silver, the copper, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

title: Numbers 31:23
text: everything that passeth through the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean; only it shall be purified with the water of separation; and everything that cannot pass through the fire ye shall make go through the water.

title: Numbers 31:24
text: And ye shall wash your garments on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean; and afterwards ye may come into the camp.

title: Numbers 31:25
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 31:26
text: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, of man and of cattle, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the assembly;

title: Numbers 31:27
text: and divide the prey into halves, between them that conducted the war, who went out to the battle, and the whole assembly.

title: Numbers 31:28
text: And thou shalt levy a tribute for Jehovah of the men of war who went out to the army, one soul of five hundred of the persons, and of the oxen, and of the asses, and of the small cattle.

title: Numbers 31:29
text: Of their half shall ye take it, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for a heave-offering of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:30
text: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the oxen, of the asses, and of the small cattle, of every [kind of] beasts, and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, who keep the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:31
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:32
text: And the prey, the rest of the spoil, which the men of war had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,

title: Numbers 31:33
text: and seventy-two thousand oxen,

title: Numbers 31:34
text: and sixty-one thousand asses,

title: Numbers 31:35
text: and of human persons, of the women that had not known lying with a man, all the persons were thirty-two thousand.

title: Numbers 31:36
text: And the half, the portion of them that had gone out to the war, was in number three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

title: Numbers 31:37
text: and the tribute for Jehovah of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five;

title: Numbers 31:38
text: and the oxen were thirty-six thousand, and the tribute thereof for Jehovah, seventy-two;

title: Numbers 31:39
text: and the asses were thirty thousand five hundred, and the tribute thereof for Jehovah, sixty-one;

title: Numbers 31:40
text: and the human persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the tribute for Jehovah was thirty-two persons.

title: Numbers 31:41
text: And Moses gave the tribute of Jehovah's heave-offering to Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:42
text: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses had divided, [taking it] from the men that served in the war,

title: Numbers 31:43
text: (now the half belonging to the assembly was of the sheep, three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred,

title: Numbers 31:44
text: and thirty-six thousand oxen,

title: Numbers 31:45
text: and thirty thousand five hundred asses,

title: Numbers 31:46
text: and sixteen thousand human persons,)

title: Numbers 31:47
text: ...of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, of man and of cattle, and gave them to the Levites who kept the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

title: Numbers 31:48
text: ¶And the officers who were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses,

title: Numbers 31:49
text: and they said to Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war who were under our hand, and there is not one man of us lacking.

title: Numbers 31:50
text: So we present the offering of Jehovah, that which each one hath found, jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 31:51
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, all manner of wrought jewels.

title: Numbers 31:52
text: And all the gold of the heave-offering that they offered to Jehovah was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, from the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds.

title: Numbers 31:53
text: (The men of war had taken spoil each one for himself.)

title: Numbers 31:54
text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, as a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:1
text: ¶And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had much cattle, a very great multitude; and they saw the land of Jaazer, and the land of Gilead, and behold, the place was a place for cattle.

title: Numbers 32:2
text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the assembly, saying,

title: Numbers 32:3
text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jaazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

title: Numbers 32:4
text: the country that Jehovah smote before the assembly of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle;

title: Numbers 32:5
text: and they said, If we have found favour in thine eyes, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession: bring us not over the Jordan.

title: Numbers 32:6
text: And Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall *ye* abide here?

title: Numbers 32:7
text: And why do ye discourage the children of Israel from going over into the land that Jehovah has given them?

title: Numbers 32:8
text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land:

title: Numbers 32:9
text: they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, and discouraged the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land that Jehovah had given them.

title: Numbers 32:10
text: And Jehovah's anger was kindled the same time, and he swore, saying,

title: Numbers 32:11
text: If the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob! for they have not wholly followed me;

title: Numbers 32:12
text: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; for they have wholly followed Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:13
text: And Jehovah's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation was consumed that had done evil in the eyes of Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:14
text: And behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, a progeny of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.

title: Numbers 32:15
text: If ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

title: Numbers 32:16
text: ¶And they drew near to him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones;

title: Numbers 32:17
text: but we ourselves will go with diligence armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones shall dwell in the strong cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

title: Numbers 32:18
text: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited each one his inheritance.

title: Numbers 32:19
text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side the Jordan, and further, because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side the Jordan eastward.

title: Numbers 32:20
text: And Moses said to them, If ye do this thing, if ye arm yourselves before Jehovah for war,

title: Numbers 32:21
text: and all of you that are armed go over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he have dispossessed his enemies from before him,

title: Numbers 32:22
text: and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and afterwards ye return, ye shall be guiltless toward Jehovah and toward Israel, and this land shall be your possession before Jehovah.

title: Numbers 32:23
text: But if ye do not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah, and be sure your sin will find you out.

title: Numbers 32:24
text: Build yourselves cities for your little ones, and folds for your flocks, and do that which has gone out of your mouth.

title: Numbers 32:25
text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commands.

title: Numbers 32:26
text: Our little ones, our wives, our cattle, and all our beasts shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

title: Numbers 32:27
text: but thy servants will pass over, every one armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord says.

title: Numbers 32:28
text: ¶So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 32:29
text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben pass with you over the Jordan, every one armed for battle, before Jehovah, and the land be subdued before you, then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

title: Numbers 32:30
text: but if they do not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

title: Numbers 32:31
text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah has said to thy servants, so will we do.

title: Numbers 32:32
text: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance on this side the Jordan shall be ours.

title: Numbers 32:33
text: And Moses gave to them, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og the king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and territories, the cities of the land round about.

title: Numbers 32:34
text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

title: Numbers 32:35
text: and Atroth-Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbebah,

title: Numbers 32:36
text: and Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-haran, strong cities, and sheepfolds.

title: Numbers 32:37
text: --And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Kirjathaim,

title: Numbers 32:38
text: and Nebo, and Baal-meon (of which the names were changed), and Sibmah; and they gave other names to the cities that they built.

title: Numbers 32:39
text: --And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and they dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.

title: Numbers 32:40
text: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

title: Numbers 32:41
text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took their hamlets, and called them Havoth-Jair.

title: Numbers 32:42
text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its dependent villages, and called it Nobah, after his name.

title: Numbers 33:1
text: ¶These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt according to their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

title: Numbers 33:2
text: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah; and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

title: Numbers 33:3
text: They journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

title: Numbers 33:4
text: And the Egyptians buried those whom Jehovah had smitten among them, all the firstborn; and upon their gods Jehovah executed judgments.

title: Numbers 33:5
text: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

title: Numbers 33:6
text: And they removed from Succoth and encamped in Etham, which is at the end of the wilderness.

title: Numbers 33:7
text: And they removed from Etham, and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is opposite Baal-Zephon, and encamped before Migdol.

title: Numbers 33:8
text: And they removed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

title: Numbers 33:9
text: And they removed from Marah, and came to Elim; and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm-trees, and they encamped there.

title: Numbers 33:10
text: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

title: Numbers 33:11
text: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

title: Numbers 33:12
text: And they removed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

title: Numbers 33:13
text: And they removed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

title: Numbers 33:14
text: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

title: Numbers 33:15
text: And they removed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Numbers 33:16
text: And they removed from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

title: Numbers 33:17
text: And they removed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

title: Numbers 33:18
text: And they removed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

title: Numbers 33:19
text: And they removed from Rithmah, and encamped at Rimmon-perez.

title: Numbers 33:20
text: And they removed from Rimmon-perez, and encamped in Libnah.

title: Numbers 33:21
text: And they removed from Libnah, and encamped at Rissah.

title: Numbers 33:22
text: And they removed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

title: Numbers 33:23
text: And they removed from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shapher.

title: Numbers 33:24
text: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

title: Numbers 33:25
text: And they removed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

title: Numbers 33:26
text: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

title: Numbers 33:27
text: And they removed from Tahath, and encamped at Terah.

title: Numbers 33:28
text: And they removed from Terah, and encamped in Mithcah.

title: Numbers 33:29
text: And they removed from Mithcah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

title: Numbers 33:30
text: And they removed from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

title: Numbers 33:31
text: And they removed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-Jaakan.

title: Numbers 33:32
text: And they removed from Bene-Jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

title: Numbers 33:33
text: And they removed from Hor-hagidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

title: Numbers 33:34
text: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Abronah.

title: Numbers 33:35
text: And they removed from Abronah, and encamped at Ezion-geber.

title: Numbers 33:36
text: And they removed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

title: Numbers 33:37
text: And they removed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the border of the land of Edom.

title: Numbers 33:38
text: And Aaron the priest went up mount Hor by the commandment of Jehovah, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month.

title: Numbers 33:39
text: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on mount Hor.

title: Numbers 33:40
text: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 33:41
text: And they removed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

title: Numbers 33:42
text: And they removed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

title: Numbers 33:43
text: And they removed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

title: Numbers 33:44
text: And they removed from Oboth, and encamped in Ijim-Abarim, in the border of Moab.

title: Numbers 33:45
text: And they removed from Ijim, and encamped in Dibon-Gad.

title: Numbers 33:46
text: And they removed from Dibon-Gad, and encamped in Almon-Diblathaim.

title: Numbers 33:47
text: And they removed from Almon-Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

title: Numbers 33:48
text: And they removed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho.

title: Numbers 33:49
text: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth unto Abel-Shittim, in the plains of Moab.

title: Numbers 33:50
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,

title: Numbers 33:51
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

title: Numbers 33:52
text: then ye shall dispossess all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and ye shall destroy all their figured images, and all their molten images shall ye destroy, and all their high places shall ye lay waste;

title: Numbers 33:53
text: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein, for to you have I given the land to possess it.

title: Numbers 33:54
text: And ye shall take for yourselves the land as an inheritance by lot according to your families: to the many ye shall increase their inheritance, and to the few thou shalt diminish their inheritance: where the lot falleth to him, there shall be each man's [inheritance]; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye take for yourselves the inheritance.

title: Numbers 33:55
text: But if ye will not dispossess the inhabitants of the land from before you, those that ye let remain of them shall be thorns in your eyes, and pricks in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land wherein ye dwell.

title: Numbers 33:56
text: And it shall come to pass that I will do unto you as I thought to do unto them.

title: Numbers 34:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 34:2
text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan, this shall be the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof.

title: Numbers 34:3
text: Then your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin alongside of Edom, and your southern border shall be from the end of the salt sea eastward;

title: Numbers 34:4
text: and your border shall turn from the south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin, and shall end southward at Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-Addar, and pass on to Azmon.

title: Numbers 34:5
text: And the border shall turn from Azmon unto the torrent of Egypt, and shall end at the sea.

title: Numbers 34:6
text: And as west border ye shall have the great sea, and [its] coast. This shall be your west border.

title: Numbers 34:7
text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;

title: Numbers 34:8
text: from mount Hor ye shall mark out the entrance to Hamath, and the end of the border shall be toward Zedad;

title: Numbers 34:9
text: and the border shall go to Ziphron, and shall end at Hazar-enan. This shall be your north border.

title: Numbers 34:10
text: And ye shall mark out for you as eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

title: Numbers 34:11
text: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall strike upon the extremity of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

title: Numbers 34:12
text: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and shall end at the salt sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.

title: Numbers 34:13
text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall take for yourselves as inheritance by lot, which Jehovah commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe.

title: Numbers 34:14
text: For the tribe of the children of the Reubenites according to their fathers' houses, and the tribe of the children of the Gadites according to their fathers' houses, have received, and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance;

title: Numbers 34:15
text: the two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side the Jordan of Jericho eastward, toward the sun-rising.

title: Numbers 34:16
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 34:17
text: These are the names of the men who shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

title: Numbers 34:18
text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land.

title: Numbers 34:19
text: And these are the names of the men: for the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;

title: Numbers 34:20
text: and for the tribe of the children of Simeon, Samuel the son of Ammihud;

title: Numbers 34:21
text: for the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;

title: Numbers 34:22
text: and for the tribe of the children of Dan, a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli;

title: Numbers 34:23
text: for the children of Joseph: for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod,

title: Numbers 34:24
text: and for the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;

title: Numbers 34:25
text: and for the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a prince, Elizaphan the son of Pharnach;

title: Numbers 34:26
text: and for the tribe of the children of Issachar, a prince, Phaltiel the son of Azzan;

title: Numbers 34:27
text: and for the tribe of the children of Asher, a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi;

title: Numbers 34:28
text: and for the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a prince, Phedahel the son of Ammihud.

title: Numbers 34:29
text: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to distribute to the children of Israel their inheritance in the land of Canaan.

title: Numbers 35:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,

title: Numbers 35:2
text: Command the children of Israel, that of the inheritance of their possession they give unto the Levites cities to dwell in; and a suburb for the cities round about them shall ye give unto the Levites.

title: Numbers 35:3
text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in, and their suburbs shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

title: Numbers 35:4
text: And the suburbs of the cities that ye shall give unto the Levites shall be from the walls of the city outward, a thousand cubits round about.

title: Numbers 35:5
text: And ye shall measure, without the city, the east side two thousand cubits, and the south side two thousand cubits, and the west side two thousand cubits, and the north side two thousand cubits, and the city shall be in the midst: they shall have this as suburbs of the cities.

title: Numbers 35:6
text: And [among] the cities that ye shall give unto the Levites [shall be] the six cities of refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither, --and besides them ye shall give forty-two cities:

title: Numbers 35:7
text: all the cities that ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities, they and their suburbs.

title: Numbers 35:8
text: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have much ye shall take much, and from them that have little ye shall take little; each one according to his inheritance which he will inherit shall give of his cities to the Levites.

title: Numbers 35:9
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Numbers 35:10
text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

title: Numbers 35:11
text: then ye shall appoint for yourselves cities: cities of refuge shall they be for you; that a manslayer may flee thither, who without intent smiteth a person mortally.

title: Numbers 35:12
text: And ye shall have these cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he have stood before the assembly in judgment.

title: Numbers 35:13
text: And the cities that ye shall give shall be six cities of refuge for you.

title: Numbers 35:14
text: Three cities shall ye give on this side of the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.

title: Numbers 35:15
text: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them shall these six cities be a refuge, that one who smiteth a person mortally without intent may flee thither.

title: Numbers 35:16
