text: And if he have smitten him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall certainly be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:17
text: And if he have smitten him with a stone from the hand, wherewith one may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall certainly be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:18
text: Or if he have smitten him with an instrument of wood, in the hand, wherewith one may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall certainly be put to death;

title: Numbers 35:19
text: the avenger of blood, he shall put the murderer to death; when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.

title: Numbers 35:20
text: And if he thrust at him out of hatred, or hurl at him intentionally, so that he die,

title: Numbers 35:21
text: or from enmity smite him with his hand, so that he die, he that smote him shall certainly be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meeteth him. --

title: Numbers 35:22
text: But if he have thrust at him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him anything unintentionally,

title: Numbers 35:23
text: or [have smitten him] with any stone wherewith one may die, without seeing him, and have cast it upon him so that he die, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

title: Numbers 35:24
text: then the assembly shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these judgments;

title: Numbers 35:25
text: and the assembly shall rescue the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the assembly shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he had fled; and he shall abide in it until the death of the high-priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

title: Numbers 35:26
text: But if the manslayer shall in any way come outside the limits of the city of his refuge whither he hath fled,

title: Numbers 35:27
text: and the avenger of blood find him outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kill the manslayer, there shall be no blood-guiltiness upon him;

title: Numbers 35:28
text: for the manslayer should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high-priest; but after the death of the high-priest he may return into the land of his possession.

title: Numbers 35:29
text: And this shall be unto you a statute of right throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

title: Numbers 35:30
text: Whoever shall smite a person mortally, at the mouth of witnesses shall the murderer be put to death; but one witness shall not testify against a person to cause him to die.

title: Numbers 35:31
text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, who is guilty of death, but he shall certainly be put to death.

title: Numbers 35:32
text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that hath fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

title: Numbers 35:33
text: And ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are; for blood, it polluteth the land; and there can be no atonement made for the land, for the blood that hath been shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

title: Numbers 35:34
text: And ye shall not defile the land that ye inhabit, in the midst whereof I dwell; for I am Jehovah who dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.

title: Numbers 36:1
text: ¶And the chief fathers of families of the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

title: Numbers 36:2
text: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel; and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

title: Numbers 36:3
text: Now if they be married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong; and it shall be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

title: Numbers 36:4
text: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall come, then shall their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong; and their inheritance shall be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

title: Numbers 36:5
text: ¶And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

title: Numbers 36:6
text: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry whom they please; only they shall marry one of the tribe of their father,

title: Numbers 36:7
text: that no inheritance of the children of Israel pass from tribe to tribe; for every one of the children of Israel shall keep to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

title: Numbers 36:8
text: And every daughter that possesseth an inheritance among the tribes of the children of Israel, shall be married to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every one the inheritance of his fathers,

title: Numbers 36:9
text: and the inheritance shall not pass from one tribe to another tribe; for each of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep to his inheritance.

title: Numbers 36:10
text: Even as Jehovah had commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad;

title: Numbers 36:11
text: and Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their uncles' sons.

title: Numbers 36:12
text: To those that were of the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph were they married; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

title: Numbers 36:13
text: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded through Moses to the children of Israel, in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.

title: Deuteronomy 1:1
text: ¶These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on this side the Jordan, in the wilderness, in the plain, opposite to Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

title: Deuteronomy 1:2
text: There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:3
text: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, that Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that Jehovah had given him in command to them;

title: Deuteronomy 1:4
text: after he had smitten Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt at Ashtaroth [and] at Edrei.

title: Deuteronomy 1:5
text: On this side the Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to unfold this law, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 1:6
text: Jehovah our God spoke unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have stayed long enough in this mountain.

title: Deuteronomy 1:7
text: Turn and take your journey, and go to the hill-country of the Amorites, and unto all the neighbouring places in the plain, in the mountain, and in the lowland, and in the south, and by the seaside, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

title: Deuteronomy 1:8
text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Jehovah swore unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

title: Deuteronomy 1:9
text: ¶And I spoke unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone.

title: Deuteronomy 1:10
text: Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

title: Deuteronomy 1:11
text: Jehovah, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you as he hath said unto you!

title: Deuteronomy 1:12
text: How can I myself alone sustain your wear, and your burden, and your strife?

title: Deuteronomy 1:13
text: Provide you wise and understanding and known men, according to your tribes, that I may make them your chiefs.

title: Deuteronomy 1:14
text: And ye answered me, and said, The thing that thou hast spoken is good [for us] to do.

title: Deuteronomy 1:15
text: So I took the chiefs of your tribes, wise men and known, and made them chiefs over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers for your tribes.

title: Deuteronomy 1:16
text: And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, Hear [the causes] between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and him also that sojourneth with him.

title: Deuteronomy 1:17
text: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment: ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God's; and the matter that is too hard for you shall ye bring to me, that I may hear it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:18
text: And I commanded you at that time all the things that ye should do.

title: Deuteronomy 1:19
text: ¶And we departed from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw, on the way to the mountain of the Amorites, as Jehovah our God had commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:20
text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which Jehovah our God giveth us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:21
text: Behold, Jehovah thy God hath set the land before thee: go up, take possession, as Jehovah the God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.

title: Deuteronomy 1:22
text: And ye came near to me all of you, and said, We will send men before us, who shall examine the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and of the cities to which we shall come.

title: Deuteronomy 1:23
text: And the matter was good in mine eyes; and I took twelve men of you, one man for a tribe.

title: Deuteronomy 1:24
text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

title: Deuteronomy 1:25
text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hand, and brought it down unto us, and brought us answer, and said, The land is good that Jehovah our God hath given us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:26
text: But ye would not go up, and rebelled against the word of Jehovah your God;

title: Deuteronomy 1:27
text: and ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because Jehovah hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

title: Deuteronomy 1:28
text: Whither shall we go up? Our brethren have made our hearts melt, saying, [They are] a people greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.

title: Deuteronomy 1:29
text: And I said unto you, Be not afraid, neither fear them;

title: Deuteronomy 1:30
text: Jehovah your God who goeth before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

title: Deuteronomy 1:31
text: and in the wilderness where thou hast seen that Jehovah thy God bore thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came to this place.

title: Deuteronomy 1:32
text: But In this thing ye did not believe Jehovah your God,

title: Deuteronomy 1:33
text: who went in the way before you, to search you out a place for your encamping, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in the cloud by day.

title: Deuteronomy 1:34
text: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and swore, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 1:35
text: None among these men, this evil generation, shall in any wise see that good land, which I swore to give unto your fathers!

title: Deuteronomy 1:36
text: Except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 1:37
text: Also Jehovah was angry with me on your account, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

title: Deuteronomy 1:38
text: Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: strengthen him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:39
text: And your little ones, of whom ye said, They shall be a prey, and your children, who this day know neither good nor evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 1:40
text: But ye, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

title: Deuteronomy 1:41
text: --And ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Jehovah, we will go up and fight, according to all that Jehovah our God hath commanded us. And ye girded on every man his weapons of war, and ye would go presumptuously up the hill.

title: Deuteronomy 1:42
text: And Jehovah said to me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

title: Deuteronomy 1:43
text: And I spoke unto you, but ye would not hear, and ye rebelled against the word of Jehovah, and acted presumptuously, and went up the hill.

title: Deuteronomy 1:44
text: And the Amorite that dwelt on that hill came out against you, and chased you, like as bees do, and cut you in pieces in Seir, as far as Hormah.

title: Deuteronomy 1:45
text: And ye returned and wept before Jehovah, but Jehovah would not listen to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

title: Deuteronomy 1:46
text: And ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode [there].

title: Deuteronomy 2:1
text: ¶And we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as Jehovah had said unto me; and we went round mount Seir many days.

title: Deuteronomy 2:2
text: And Jehovah spoke to me, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:3
text: Ye have gone round this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

title: Deuteronomy 2:4
text: And command the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you; and ye shall be very guarded:

title: Deuteronomy 2:5
text: attack them not; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot-breadth; for I have given mount Seir as a possession unto Esau.

title: Deuteronomy 2:6
text: Ye shall buy of them food for money, that ye may eat; and water shall ye also buy of them for money, that ye may drink;

title: Deuteronomy 2:7
text: for Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hand. He hath known thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years hath Jehovah thy God been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

title: Deuteronomy 2:8
text: ¶And we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, by the plain, by Elath, and by Ezion-geber, and we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

title: Deuteronomy 2:9
text: And Jehovah said to me, Distress not the Moabites, neither engage with them in battle; for I will not give thee of their land a possession; for unto the children of Lot have I given Ar as a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:10
text: (The Emim dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall as the Anakim.

title: Deuteronomy 2:11
text: They also are reckoned as giants like the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

title: Deuteronomy 2:12
text: And in Seir dwelt the Horites in times past; and the children of Esau dispossessed them, and destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did to the land of their possession, which Jehovah gave to them.)

title: Deuteronomy 2:13
text: Now rise up, and pass over the torrent Zered. And we passed over the torrent Zered.

title: Deuteronomy 2:14
text: Now the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we had come over the torrent Zered, were thirty-eight years; until the whole generation of the men of war was consumed from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah had sworn unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 2:15
text: Moreover the hand of Jehovah was against them to destroy them from the midst of the camp, until they were consumed.

title: Deuteronomy 2:16
text: And it came to pass when all the men of war were consumed, having died off from among the people,

title: Deuteronomy 2:17
text: that Jehovah spoke to me, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:18
text: Thou art to pass this day over the border of Moab, [which is] Ar,

title: Deuteronomy 2:19
text: and come near over against the children of Ammon; thou shalt not distress them nor attack them; for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon a possession; for unto the children of Lot have I given it as a possession.

title: Deuteronomy 2:20
text: (That also is reckoned a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in time past, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim;

title: Deuteronomy 2:21
text: a people great, and many, and tall as the Anakim; and Jehovah destroyed them before them, and they dispossessed them, and dwelt in their stead;

title: Deuteronomy 2:22
text: as he did to the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, from before whom he destroyed the Horites; and they dispossessed them, and dwelt in their stead, even to this day.

title: Deuteronomy 2:23
text: And the Avvites who dwelt in the hamlets as far as Gazah--the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

title: Deuteronomy 2:24
text: ¶Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon. Behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land: begin, take possession, and engage with him in battle.

title: Deuteronomy 2:25
text: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the peoples under the whole heaven; who will hear report of thee, and will tremble, and quake because of thee.

title: Deuteronomy 2:26
text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon the king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 2:27
text: Let me pass through thy land: by the highway alone will I go; I will neither turn to the right hand nor to the left.

title: Deuteronomy 2:28
text: Thou shalt sell me food for money that I may eat; and thou shalt give me water for money that I may drink; I will only pass through on my feet,

title: Deuteronomy 2:29
text: --as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, --until I shall pass over the Jordan into the land which Jehovah our God giveth us.

title: Deuteronomy 2:30
text: But Sihon the king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Jehovah thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obdurate, that he might give him into thy hand, as it is this day.

title: Deuteronomy 2:31
text: And Jehovah said to me, Behold, I begin to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin, take possession, that thou mayest possess his land.

title: Deuteronomy 2:32
text: And Sihon came out against us for battle, he and all his people, to Jahaz.

title: Deuteronomy 2:33
text: But Jehovah our God gave him up before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and his whole people.

title: Deuteronomy 2:34
text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every city, men, and women, and little ones: we let none escape.

title: Deuteronomy 2:35
text: Only the cattle we took as booty for ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

title: Deuteronomy 2:36
text: From Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the ravine even to Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: Jehovah our God delivered all before us.

title: Deuteronomy 2:37
text: Only thou didst not approach the land of the children of Ammon, the whole border of the river Jabbok, nor the cities of the mountain, nor to whatsoever Jehovah our God had forbidden us.

title: Deuteronomy 3:1
text: ¶And we turned, and went up the way to Bashan; and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, for battle at Edrei.

title: Deuteronomy 3:2
text: And Jehovah said to me, Fear him not; for into thy hand have I given him, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

title: Deuteronomy 3:3
text: And Jehovah our God gave into our hand Og the king of Bashan also, and all his people; and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

title: Deuteronomy 3:4
text: And we took all his cities at that time: there was not a town which we took not from them, sixty cities, the whole region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:5
text: All these cities were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides unwalled towns very many.

title: Deuteronomy 3:6
text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we had done to Sihon the king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every city, men, women and little ones.

title: Deuteronomy 3:7
text: But all the cattle and the spoil of the cities we took as booty for ourselves.

title: Deuteronomy 3:8
text: And we took at that time the land out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites, that were on this side the Jordan, from the river Arnon to mount Hermon

title: Deuteronomy 3:9
text: (the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir):

title: Deuteronomy 3:10
text: all the cities of the plateau, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, as far as Salchah and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:11
text: For only Og the king of Bashan remained of the residue of giants: behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? its length was nine cubits, and its breadth four cubits, after the cubit of a man.

title: Deuteronomy 3:12
text: ¶And this land we took in possession at that time. From Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and the half of mount Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

title: Deuteronomy 3:13
text: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to half the tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob, even all Bashan, is called a land of giants.

title: Deuteronomy 3:14
text: Jair the son of Manasseh took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and called Bashan after his own name, Havoth-Jair, to this day.)

title: Deuteronomy 3:15
text: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

title: Deuteronomy 3:16
text: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the river Arnon, the middle of the ravine and its border, as far as the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

title: Deuteronomy 3:17
text: the plain also, and the Jordan, and [its] border from Chinnereth as far as the sea of the plain, the salt sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

title: Deuteronomy 3:18
text: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Jehovah your God hath given you this land to take possession of it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all [who are] combatants.

title: Deuteronomy 3:19
text: Only your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, --I know that ye have much cattle, --shall abide in your cities which I have given you,

title: Deuteronomy 3:20
text: until Jehovah give rest to your brethren, as well as to you, and they also take possession of the land that Jehovah your God giveth them beyond the Jordan; then shall ye return, each man to his possession, which I have given you.

title: Deuteronomy 3:21
text: ¶And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done to these two kings: so will Jehovah do to all the kingdoms to which thou shalt go.

title: Deuteronomy 3:22
text: Ye shall not fear them; for Jehovah your God, he will fight for you.

title: Deuteronomy 3:23
text: And I besought Jehovah at that time, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 3:24
text: Lord Jehovah, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy powerful hand; for what *God is in the heavens or in the earth that can do like to thy works, and like to thy might?

title: Deuteronomy 3:25
text: Let me go over, I pray thee, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

title: Deuteronomy 3:26
text: But Jehovah was wroth with me on your account, and did not hear me; and Jehovah said to me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter!

title: Deuteronomy 3:27
text: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes; for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

title: Deuteronomy 3:28
text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall put them in possession of the land which thou shalt see.

title: Deuteronomy 3:29
text: And we abode in the valley opposite to Beth-Peor.

title: Deuteronomy 4:1
text: ¶And now, Israel, hearken to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do [them], that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah the God of your fathers giveth you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:2
text: Ye shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall ye take from it, that ye may keep the commandments of Jehovah your God which I command you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:3
text: Your eyes have seen what Jehovah did because of Baal-Peor; for all the men that followed Baal-Peor, Jehovah thy God hath destroyed them from among you;

title: Deuteronomy 4:4
text: but ye that did cleave to Jehovah your God are alive every one of you this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:5
text: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Jehovah my God commanded me, that ye may do so in the land into which ye enter to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:6
text: And ye shall keep and do them; for that will be your wisdom and your understanding before the eyes of the peoples that shall hear all these statutes, and say, Verily this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

title: Deuteronomy 4:7
text: For what great nation is there that hath God near to them as Jehovah our God is in everything we call upon him for?

title: Deuteronomy 4:8
text: And what great nation is there that hath righteous statutes and ordinances, as all this law which I set before you this day?

title: Deuteronomy 4:9
text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things that thine eyes have seen (and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life; but thou shalt make them known to thy sons and to thy sons' sons),

title: Deuteronomy 4:10
text: the day that thou stoodest before Jehovah thy God in Horeb, when Jehovah said to me, Gather me the people together, that I may cause them to hear my words, that they may learn them, and fear me all the days that they live upon the earth, and teach them to their children.

title: Deuteronomy 4:11
text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire to the heart of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and obscurity.

title: Deuteronomy 4:12
text: And Jehovah spoke to you from the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but ye saw no form; only [ye heard] a voice.

title: Deuteronomy 4:13
text: And he declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to do, the ten words; and he wrote them on two tables of stone.

title: Deuteronomy 4:14
text: And Jehovah commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that ye might do them in the land whither ye are passing over to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 4:15
text: And take great heed to your souls (for ye saw no form on the day that Jehovah spoke to you in Horeb from the midst of the fire),

title: Deuteronomy 4:16
text: lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the form of any figure, the pattern of male or female,

title: Deuteronomy 4:17
text: the pattern of any beast that is on the earth, the pattern of any winged fowl that flieth in the heaven,

title: Deuteronomy 4:18
text: the pattern of anything that creepeth on the ground, the pattern of any fish that is in the waters under the earth;

title: Deuteronomy 4:19
text: and lest thou lift up thine eyes to the heavens, and see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, the whole host of heaven, and be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them, which Jehovah thy God hath assigned unto all peoples under the whole heaven.

title: Deuteronomy 4:20
text: But you hath Jehovah taken, and hath brought you forth out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, that ye might be to him a people of inheritance, as it is this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:21
text: And Jehovah was angry with me on your account, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not enter in to that good land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance;

title: Deuteronomy 4:22
text: for I shall die in this land, I shall not go over the Jordan; but ye shall go over, and possess this good land.

title: Deuteronomy 4:23
text: Take heed to yourselves lest ye forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a graven image, the form of anything which Jehovah thy God hath forbidden thee.

title: Deuteronomy 4:24
text: For Jehovah thy God is a consuming fire, a jealous *God.

title: Deuteronomy 4:25
text: When thou begettest sons, and sons' sons, and ye have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, the form of anything, and do evil in the sight of Jehovah thy God, to provoke him to anger,

title: Deuteronomy 4:26
text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye pass over the Jordan to possess it: ye shall not prolong your days on it, but shall be utterly destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 4:27
text: And Jehovah will scatter you among the peoples, and ye shall be left a small company among the nations to which Jehovah will lead you.

title: Deuteronomy 4:28
text: And ye shall there serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

title: Deuteronomy 4:29
text: And from thence ye shall seek Jehovah thy God, and thou shalt find him, if thou shalt seek him with thy whole heart and with thy whole soul.

title: Deuteronomy 4:30
text: In thy tribulation, and when all these things shall come upon thee, at the end of days, thou shalt return to Jehovah thy God, and shalt hearken to his voice,

title: Deuteronomy 4:31
text: --for Jehovah thy God is a merciful *God, --he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he swore unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 4:32
text: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from one end of the heavens to the other end of the heavens, whether there hath been anything as this great thing is, or if anything hath been heard like it?

title: Deuteronomy 4:33
text: Did [ever] people hear the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

title: Deuteronomy 4:34
text: Or hath God essayed to come to take him a nation from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a powerful hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Jehovah your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

title: Deuteronomy 4:35
text: Unto thee it was shewn, that thou mightest know that Jehovah, he is God--there is none other besides him.

title: Deuteronomy 4:36
text: From the heavens he made thee hear his voice, that he might instruct thee; and on the earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words from the midst of the fire.

title: Deuteronomy 4:37
text: And because he loved thy fathers, and chose their seed after them, he brought thee out with his countenance, with his great power, out of Egypt,

title: Deuteronomy 4:38
text: to dispossess nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

title: Deuteronomy 4:39
text: Thou shalt know therefore this day, and consider it in thy heart, that Jehovah, he is God in the heavens above, and on the earth beneath: [there is] none else.

title: Deuteronomy 4:40
text: And thou shalt keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may be well with thee and with thy sons after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days on the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, for ever.

title: Deuteronomy 4:41
text: ¶Then Moses separated three cities on this side the Jordan toward the sun-rising,

title: Deuteronomy 4:42
text: that the manslayer might flee thither, who should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not previously, that fleeing to one of these cities, he might live:

title: Deuteronomy 4:43
text: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plateau, of the Reubenites, and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

title: Deuteronomy 4:44
text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

title: Deuteronomy 4:45
text: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances that Moses declared to the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt,

title: Deuteronomy 4:46
text: on this side the Jordan, in the valley opposite to Beth-Peor, in the land of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote when they came out of Egypt;

title: Deuteronomy 4:47
text: and they took possession of his land, and the land of Og the king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who were on this side the Jordan, toward the sun-rising;

title: Deuteronomy 4:48
text: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, as far as mount Sion, which is Hermon,

title: Deuteronomy 4:49
text: and all the plain on this side the Jordan, eastward, and as far as the sea of the plain, under the slopes of Pisgah.

title: Deuteronomy 5:1
text: ¶And Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances that I speak in your ears this day, and learn them, and keep them to do them.

title: Deuteronomy 5:2
text: Jehovah our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

title: Deuteronomy 5:3
text: Not with our fathers did Jehovah make this covenant, but with us, [even] us, those [who are] here alive all of us this day.

title: Deuteronomy 5:4
text: Face to face on the mountain from the midst of the fire Jehovah spoke with you

title: Deuteronomy 5:5
text: (I stood between Jehovah and you at that time, to declare to you the word of Jehovah; for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up to the mountain), saying,

title: Deuteronomy 5:6
text: ¶I am Jehovah thy God who have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

title: Deuteronomy 5:7
text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

title: Deuteronomy 5:8
text: Thou shalt not make thyself any graven image, any form of what is in the heavens above, or what is in the earth beneath, or what is in the waters under the earth:

title: Deuteronomy 5:9
text: thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them; for I, Jehovah thy God, am a jealous *God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons, and upon the third and upon the fourth [generation] of them that hate me,

title: Deuteronomy 5:10
text: and shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

title: Deuteronomy 5:11
text: Thou shalt not idly utter the name of Jehovah thy God; for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that idly uttereth his name.

title: Deuteronomy 5:12
text: Keep the sabbath day to hallow it, as Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee.

title: Deuteronomy 5:13
text: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work;

title: Deuteronomy 5:14
text: but the seventh day is the sabbath of Jehovah thy God: thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy bondman, nor thy handmaid, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy sojourner that is within thy gates; that thy bondman and thy handmaid may rest as well as thou.

title: Deuteronomy 5:15
text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and that Jehovah thy God brought thee out thence with a powerful hand and with a stretched-out arm; therefore Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee to observe the sabbath day.

title: Deuteronomy 5:16
text: Honour thy father and thy mother, as Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may be well with thee in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

title: Deuteronomy 5:17
text: Thou shalt not kill.

title: Deuteronomy 5:18
text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

title: Deuteronomy 5:19
text: Neither shalt thou steal.

title: Deuteronomy 5:20
text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

title: Deuteronomy 5:21
text: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, nor his bondman, nor his handmaid, his ox, nor his ass, nor anything that is thy neighbour's.

title: Deuteronomy 5:22
text: These words Jehovah spoke to all your congregation on the mountain from the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the obscurity, with a great voice, and he added no more; and he wrote them on two tables of stone, and gave them to me.

title: Deuteronomy 5:23
text: ¶And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, and the mountain burned with fire, that ye came near to me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

title: Deuteronomy 5:24
text: and ye said, Behold, Jehovah our God has shewn us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice from the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God talks with man, and he lives.

title: Deuteronomy 5:25
text: And now, why should we die? for this great fire will consume us. If we hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more, we shall die.

title: Deuteronomy 5:26
text: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we, and has lived?

title: Deuteronomy 5:27
text: Come thou near, and hear all that Jehovah our God will say; and speak thou to us all that Jehovah our God will speak to thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

title: Deuteronomy 5:28
text: And Jehovah heard the voice of your words, when ye spoke to me; and Jehovah said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people that have spoken to thee: they have well spoken all that they have spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 5:29
text: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments continually, that it might be well with them and with their sons for ever!

title: Deuteronomy 5:30
text: Go, say unto them, Get you into your tents again.

title: Deuteronomy 5:31
text: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

title: Deuteronomy 5:32
text: Take heed then to do as Jehovah your God hath commanded you: turn not aside to the right hand or to the left.

title: Deuteronomy 5:33
text: In all the way that Jehovah your God hath commanded you shall ye walk, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

title: Deuteronomy 6:1
text: ¶And these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah your God commanded to teach you, that ye may do them in the land whereunto ye pass over to possess it,

title: Deuteronomy 6:2
text: that thou mayest fear Jehovah thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

title: Deuteronomy 6:3
text: And thou shalt hear, Israel, and take heed to do [them]; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase greatly, as Jehovah the God of thy fathers hath said unto thee, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 6:4
text: ¶Hear, Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah;

title: Deuteronomy 6:5
text: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength.

title: Deuteronomy 6:6
text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thy heart;

title: Deuteronomy 6:7
text: and thou shalt impress them on thy sons, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou goest on the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

title: Deuteronomy 6:8
text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign on thy hand, and they shall be for frontlets between thine eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 6:9
text: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and upon thy gates.

title: Deuteronomy 6:10
text: And it shall be, when Jehovah thy God bringeth thee into the land which he swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee: great and good cities which thou buildedst not,

title: Deuteronomy 6:11
text: and houses full of everything good which thou filledst not, and wells digged which thou diggedst not, vineyards and oliveyards which thou plantedst not, and thou shalt have eaten and shalt be full;

title: Deuteronomy 6:12
text: [then] beware lest thou forget Jehovah who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

title: Deuteronomy 6:13
text: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

title: Deuteronomy 6:14
text: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples that are round about you;

title: Deuteronomy 6:15
text: for Jehovah thy God is a jealous *God in thy midst; lest the anger of Jehovah thy God be kindled against thee, and he destroy thee from the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 6:16
text: Ye shall not tempt Jehovah your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

title: Deuteronomy 6:17
text: ¶Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of Jehovah your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

title: Deuteronomy 6:18
text: And thou shalt do what is right and good in the sight of Jehovah, that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest enter in and possess the good land which Jehovah swore unto thy fathers,

title: Deuteronomy 6:19
text: thrusting out all thine enemies from before thee, as Jehovah hath spoken.

title: Deuteronomy 6:20
text: When thy son shall ask thee in time to come, saying, What are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Jehovah our God hath commanded you?

title: Deuteronomy 6:21
text: then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with a powerful hand;

title: Deuteronomy 6:22
text: and Jehovah shewed signs and wonders, great and grievous, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes;

title: Deuteronomy 6:23
text: and he brought us out thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore unto our fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 6:24
text: And Jehovah commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for our good continually, that he might preserve us alive, as it is this day.

title: Deuteronomy 6:25
text: And it shall be our righteousness if we take heed to do all these commandments before Jehovah our God, as he hath commanded us.

title: Deuteronomy 7:1
text: ¶When Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and shall cast out many nations from before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou,

title: Deuteronomy 7:2
text: and when Jehovah thy God shall give them up before thee and thou shalt smite them, then shalt thou utterly destroy them: thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:3
text: And thou shalt make no marriages with them: thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor take his daughter for thy son;

title: Deuteronomy 7:4
text: for he will turn away thy son from following me, and they will serve other gods, and the anger of Jehovah will be kindled against you, and he will destroy thee quickly.

title: Deuteronomy 7:5
text: But thus shall ye deal with them: ye shall break down their altars, and shatter their statues, and hew down their Asherahs, and burn their graven images with fire.

title: Deuteronomy 7:6
text: For a holy people art thou unto Jehovah thy God: Jehovah thy God hath chosen thee to be unto him a people for a possession, above all the peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 7:7
text: Not because ye were more in number than all the peoples, hath Jehovah been attached to you and chosen you, for ye are the fewest of all the peoples;

title: Deuteronomy 7:8
text: but because Jehovah loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath Jehovah brought you out with a powerful hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 7:9
text: And thou shalt know that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful *God, who keepeth covenant and mercy to a thousand generations with them that love him and keep his commandments;

title: Deuteronomy 7:10
text: and repayeth them that hate him [each] to his face, to cause them to perish: he delayeth not with him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

title: Deuteronomy 7:11
text: And thou shalt keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command thee this day, to do them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:12
text: ¶And it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Jehovah thy God will keep with thee the covenant and the mercy which he swore unto thy fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 7:13
text: and he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee, and will bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy ground, thy corn and thy new wine, and thine oil, the offspring of thy kine, and the increase of thy sheep, in the land which he swore unto thy fathers to give thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:14
text: Thou shalt be blessed above all the peoples; there shall not be male or female barren with thee, or with thy cattle;

title: Deuteronomy 7:15
text: and Jehovah will take away from thee all sickness, and none of the evil infirmities of Egypt, which thou knowest, will he put upon thee; but he will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:16
text: And thou shalt consume all the peoples that Jehovah thy God will give up unto thee; thine eye shall not spare them, and thou shalt not serve their gods; for that would be a snare unto thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:17
text: If thou shouldest say in thy heart, These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?

title: Deuteronomy 7:18
text: fear them not; remember well what Jehovah thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all the Egyptians;

title: Deuteronomy 7:19
text: the great trials which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the powerful hand, and the stretched-out arm, whereby Jehovah thy God brought thee out: so will Jehovah thy God do unto all the peoples whom thou fearest.

title: Deuteronomy 7:20
text: Moreover, Jehovah thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and they that hide themselves from thee, are destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 7:21
text: Thou shalt not be afraid of them; for Jehovah thy God is in thy midst, a *God great and terrible.

title: Deuteronomy 7:22
text: And Jehovah thy God will cast out those nations from before thee by little and little; thou shalt not be able to make an end of them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

title: Deuteronomy 7:23
text: But Jehovah thy God will give them up before thee, and will confound them with great consternation, until they are destroyed.

title: Deuteronomy 7:24
text: And he will give their kings into thy hand, and thou shalt put out their name from under the heavens; no man shall stand before thee, until thou hast destroyed them.

title: Deuteronomy 7:25
text: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire; thou shalt not covet the silver and gold [that is] on them and take it unto thee, lest thou be ensnared therein; for it is an abomination to Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 7:26
text: And thou shalt not bring an abomination into thy house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

title: Deuteronomy 8:1
text: ¶Every commandment which I command thee this day shall ye take heed to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and enter in and possess the land which Jehovah swore unto your fathers.

title: Deuteronomy 8:2
text: And thou shalt remember all the way which Jehovah thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thy heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments or not.

title: Deuteronomy 8:3
text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with the manna, which thou hadst not known, and which thy fathers knew not; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread alone, but by everything that goeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.

title: Deuteronomy 8:4
text: Thy clothing grew not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

title: Deuteronomy 8:5
text: And know in thy heart that, as a man chasteneth his son, so Jehovah thy God chasteneth thee;

title: Deuteronomy 8:6
text: and thou shalt keep the commandments of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

title: Deuteronomy 8:7
text: For Jehovah thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of water-brooks, of springs, and of deep waters, that gush forth in the valleys and hills;

title: Deuteronomy 8:8
text: a land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig-trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive-trees and honey;

title: Deuteronomy 8:9
text: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, where thou shalt lack nothing; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose mountains thou wilt dig copper.

title: Deuteronomy 8:10
text: ¶And thou shalt eat and be filled, and shalt bless Jehovah thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

title: Deuteronomy 8:11
text: Beware that thou forget not Jehovah thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command thee this day;

title: Deuteronomy 8:12
text: lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built and inhabited fine houses,

title: Deuteronomy 8:13
text: and thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied,

title: Deuteronomy 8:14
text: then thy heart be lifted up, and thou forget Jehovah thy God, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

title: Deuteronomy 8:15
text: who led thee through the great and terrible wilderness, [a wilderness of] fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there is no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

title: Deuteronomy 8:16
text: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

title: Deuteronomy 8:17
text: --and thou say in thy heart, My power and the might of my hand has procured me this wealth.

title: Deuteronomy 8:18
text: But thou shalt remember Jehovah thy God, that it is he who giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

title: Deuteronomy 8:19
text: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget Jehovah thy God, and go after other gods, and serve them, and bow down to them, I testify against you this day that ye shall utterly perish.

title: Deuteronomy 8:20
text: As the nations which Jehovah is causing to perish before you, so shall ye perish; because ye would not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah your God.

title: Deuteronomy 9:1
text: ¶Hear, Israel! Thou art to pass over the Jordan this day, to enter in to possess nations greater and mightier than thou, cities great and walled up to heaven,

title: Deuteronomy 9:2
text: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard [say], Who can stand before the sons of Anak!

title: Deuteronomy 9:3
text: Know then this day, that Jehovah thy God is he that goeth over before thee, a consuming fire; he will destroy them, and he will cast them down before thee, and thou shalt dispossess them and cause them to perish quickly, as Jehovah hath said unto thee.

title: Deuteronomy 9:4
text: Thou shalt not say in thy heart, when Jehovah thy God thrusteth them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness Jehovah hath brought me in to possess this land; but for the wickedness of these nations doth Jehovah dispossess them from before thee.

title: Deuteronomy 9:5
text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thy heart, dost thou enter in to possess their land, but for the wickedness of these nations doth Jehovah thy God dispossess them from before thee, and that he may perform the word which Jehovah swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

title: Deuteronomy 9:6
text: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God doth not give thee this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiff-necked people.

title: Deuteronomy 9:7
text: ¶Remember, forget not, how thou provokedst Jehovah thy God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came to this place, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 9:8
text: And at Horeb ye provoked Jehovah to wrath, and Jehovah was angry with you, to destroy you,

title: Deuteronomy 9:9
text: when I went up the mountain to receive the tables of stone, the tables of the covenant which Jehovah made with you, and I abode in the mountain forty days and forty nights, --I ate no bread and drank no water, --

title: Deuteronomy 9:10
text: --and Jehovah delivered to me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them [was written] according to all the words which Jehovah spoke with you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.

title: Deuteronomy 9:11
text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Jehovah gave me the two tables of stone, the tables of the covenant.

title: Deuteronomy 9:12
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Arise, go down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them: they have made for themselves a molten image.

title: Deuteronomy 9:13
text: And Jehovah spoke unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.

title: Deuteronomy 9:14
text: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

title: Deuteronomy 9:15
text: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire; and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

title: Deuteronomy 9:16
text: And I saw, and behold, ye had sinned against Jehovah your God: ye had made for yourselves a molten calf; ye had quickly turned aside from the way which Jehovah had commanded you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:17
text: And I seized the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 9:18
text: And I fell down before Jehovah, as at the first, forty days and forty nights, --I ate no bread and drank no water, --because of all your sin which ye had sinned, in doing what is evil in the eyes of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger.

title: Deuteronomy 9:19
text: For I was afraid of the anger and fury wherewith Jehovah was wroth against you to destroy you. And Jehovah listened unto me also at that time.

title: Deuteronomy 9:20
text: And with Aaron Jehovah was very angry to destroy him; and I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

title: Deuteronomy 9:21
text: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, and ground it very small, until it became fine dust; and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that flowed down from the mountain.

title: Deuteronomy 9:22
text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked Jehovah to wrath.

title: Deuteronomy 9:23
text: And when Jehovah sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and take possession of the land which I have given you, ye rebelled against the word of Jehovah your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

title: Deuteronomy 9:24
text: Ye have been rebellious against Jehovah from the day that I knew you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:25
text: So I fell down before Jehovah the forty days and forty nights, as I fell down; for Jehovah had said he would destroy you.

title: Deuteronomy 9:26
text: I prayed therefore to Jehovah, and said, Lord Jehovah, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a powerful hand.

title: Deuteronomy 9:27
text: Remember thy servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin;

title: Deuteronomy 9:28
text: lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because Jehovah was not able to bring them into the land which he had promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.

title: Deuteronomy 9:29
text: They are indeed thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out with thy great power and with thy stretched-out arm.

title: Deuteronomy 10:1
text: ¶At that time Jehovah said unto me, Hew for thyself two tables of stone like the first, and come up unto me into the mountain, and make thee an ark of wood;

title: Deuteronomy 10:2
text: and I will write on the tables the words that were on the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt lay them in the ark.

title: Deuteronomy 10:3
text: And I made an ark of acacia-wood, and hewed two tables of stone like the first, and went up the mountain with the two tables in my hand.

title: Deuteronomy 10:4
text: And he wrote on the tables, as the first writing, the ten words which Jehovah spoke unto you on the mountain, from the midst of the fire, on the day of the assembly, and Jehovah gave them unto me.

title: Deuteronomy 10:5
text: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; --and they are there, as Jehovah commanded me.

title: Deuteronomy 10:6
text: (And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan to Moserah: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son exercised the priesthood in his stead.

title: Deuteronomy 10:7
text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of water-brooks.)

title: Deuteronomy 10:8
text: At that time Jehovah separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, to stand before Jehovah to do service unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

title: Deuteronomy 10:9
text: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; Jehovah is his inheritance, according as Jehovah thy God told him.

title: Deuteronomy 10:10
text: But I stood upon the mountain according to the former days, forty days and forty nights; and Jehovah listened unto me also at that time: Jehovah would not destroy thee.

title: Deuteronomy 10:11
text: And Jehovah said unto me, Rise up, take thy journey before the people, that they may enter in and possess the land, which I swore unto their fathers to give unto them.

title: Deuteronomy 10:12
text: ¶And now, Israel, what doth Jehovah thy God require of thee, but to fear Jehovah thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Jehovah thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

title: Deuteronomy 10:13
text: to keep the commandments of Jehovah, and his statutes, which I command thee this day, for thy good?

title: Deuteronomy 10:14
text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens belong to Jehovah thy God; the earth and all that is therein.

title: Deuteronomy 10:15
text: Only, Jehovah took pleasure in thy fathers, to love them, and he chose their seed after them, [even] you, out of all the peoples, as it is this day.

title: Deuteronomy 10:16
text: Circumcise then the foreskin of your heart, and stiffen your neck no more.

title: Deuteronomy 10:17
text: For Jehovah your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of lords, the great *God, the mighty and the terrible, who regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward;

title: Deuteronomy 10:18
text: who executeth the judgment of the fatherless and the widow, and loveth the stranger, to give him food and clothing.

title: Deuteronomy 10:19
text: And ye shall love the stranger; for ye have been strangers in the land of Egypt.

title: Deuteronomy 10:20
text: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; him thou shalt serve, and unto him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

title: Deuteronomy 10:21
text: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, who hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

title: Deuteronomy 10:22
text: With seventy souls thy fathers went down into Egypt; and now Jehovah thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

title: Deuteronomy 11:1
text: ¶Thou shalt love then Jehovah thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his ordinances, and his commandments continually.

title: Deuteronomy 11:2
text: And know ye this day...; for [I speak] not with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Jehovah your God, his greatness, his powerful hand, and his stretched-out arm,

title: Deuteronomy 11:3
text: and his signs and his acts which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

title: Deuteronomy 11:4
text: and what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and unto their chariots, over which he made the water of the Red sea flow as they pursued after you, and Jehovah destroyed them unto this day;

title: Deuteronomy 11:5
text: --and what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came to this place;

title: Deuteronomy 11:6
text: and what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben, --how the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, with their households, and their tents, and all the living substance that belonged to them, in the midst of all Israel.

title: Deuteronomy 11:7
text: For your eyes have seen all the great work of Jehovah which he hath done.

title: Deuteronomy 11:8
text: ¶Keep then all the commandment which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and enter in and possess the land, whither ye pass over to possess it;

title: Deuteronomy 11:9
text: and that ye may prolong your days in the land which Jehovah swore unto your fathers to give unto them and unto their seed, a land flowing with milk and honey.

title: Deuteronomy 11:10
text: For the land, whither thou enterest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs;

title: Deuteronomy 11:11
text: but the land, whereunto ye are passing over to possess it, is a land of mountains and valleys, which drinketh water of the rain of heaven,

title: Deuteronomy 11:12
text: a land which Jehovah thy God careth for; the eyes of Jehovah thy God are constantly upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

title: Deuteronomy 11:13
text: And it shall come to pass, if ye hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love Jehovah your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

title: Deuteronomy 11:14
text: that I will give rain to your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain; and thou shalt gather in thy corn, and thy new wine, and thine oil;

title: Deuteronomy 11:15
text: and I will give grass in thy field for thy cattle; and thou shalt eat and be full.

title: Deuteronomy 11:16
text: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside and serve other gods, and bow down to them,

title: Deuteronomy 11:17
text: and Jehovah's wrath kindle against you, and he shut up the heavens, that there be no rain, and that the ground yield not its produce, and ye perish quickly from off the good land which Jehovah is giving you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:18
text: ¶And ye shall lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 11:19
text: And ye shall teach them unto your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou goest on the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up;

title: Deuteronomy 11:20
text: and write them upon the posts of thy house, and upon thy gates;

title: Deuteronomy 11:21
text: that your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which Jehovah swore unto your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens [which are] above the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 11:22
text: For if ye diligently keep all this commandment which I command you [this day] to do it, to love Jehovah your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him,

title: Deuteronomy 11:23
text: then will Jehovah dispossess all these nations from before you, and ye shall take possession of nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

title: Deuteronomy 11:24
text: Every place whereon the sole of your foot shall tread shall be yours; from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the hinder sea shall your border be.

title: Deuteronomy 11:25
text: No man shall be able to stand before you: the fear of you and the dread of you will Jehovah your God lay upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

title: Deuteronomy 11:26
text: ¶See, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse:

title: Deuteronomy 11:27
text: a blessing, if ye obey the commandments of Jehovah your God, which I command you this day;

title: Deuteronomy 11:28
text: and a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of Jehovah your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods which ye have not known.

title: Deuteronomy 11:29
text: And it shall come to pass, when Jehovah thy God hath brought thee into the land whither thou enterest in to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

title: Deuteronomy 11:30
text: Are they not on the other side of the Jordan, beyond the way toward the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites that dwell on the plain opposite to Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

title: Deuteronomy 11:31
text: For ye pass over the Jordan to enter in to possess the land which Jehovah your God giveth you, and ye shall take possession of it, and dwell therein.

title: Deuteronomy 11:32
text: And ye shall take heed to do all the statutes and ordinances which I set before you this day.

title: Deuteronomy 12:1
text: ¶These are the statutes and ordinances, which ye shall take heed to do in the land, which Jehovah the God of thy fathers is giving thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 12:2
text: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places wherein the nations which ye shall dispossess have served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree;

title: Deuteronomy 12:3
text: and ye shall break down their altars, and shatter their statues, and burn their Asherahs with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and ye shall destroy the names of them out of that place.

title: Deuteronomy 12:4
text: Ye shall not do so unto Jehovah your God;

title: Deuteronomy 12:5
text: ¶but unto the place which Jehovah your God will choose out of all your tribes to set his name there, his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come;

title: Deuteronomy 12:6
text: and thither ye shall bring your burnt-offerings and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and your vows, and your voluntary-offerings, and the firstlings of your kine and of your sheep;

title: Deuteronomy 12:7
text: and ye shall eat there before Jehovah your God, and ye shall rejoice, ye and your households, in all the business of your hand, wherein Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee.

title: Deuteronomy 12:8
text: Ye shall not do after all that we do here this day, each one whatever is right in his own eyes.

title: Deuteronomy 12:9
text: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.

title: Deuteronomy 12:10
text: But when ye have gone over the Jordan, and dwell in the land which Jehovah your God causeth you to inherit, and when he hath given you rest from all your enemies round about, and ye dwell in safety,

title: Deuteronomy 12:11
text: then there shall be a place which Jehovah your God will choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you: your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye shall vow to Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 12:12
text: And ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your bondmen, and your handmaids, and the Levite that is within your gates; for he hath no portion nor inheritance with you.

title: Deuteronomy 12:13
text: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt-offerings in every place that thou seest;

title: Deuteronomy 12:14
text: but in the place which Jehovah will choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt-offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

title: Deuteronomy 12:15
text: Nevertheless, according to all the desire of thy soul thou mayest slay and eat flesh in all thy gates, according to the blessing of Jehovah thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the gazelle, and the hart.

title: Deuteronomy 12:16
text: Only, ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

title: Deuteronomy 12:17
text: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy new wine, or of thine oil, or the firstlings of thy kine or of thy sheep, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy voluntary-offerings, nor the heave-offering of thy hand;

title: Deuteronomy 12:18
text: but before Jehovah thy God shalt thou eat them in the place which Jehovah thy God will choose, thou and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy bondman, and thy handmaid, and the Levite that is within thy gates; and thou shalt rejoice before Jehovah thy God in all the business of thy hand.

title: Deuteronomy 12:19
text: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite all the days thou shalt be in thy land.

title: Deuteronomy 12:20
text: When Jehovah thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he promised thee, and thou say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh, thou mayest eat flesh, according to all the desire of thy soul.

title: Deuteronomy 12:21
text: If the place which Jehovah thy God will choose to set his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt slay of thy kine and of thy sheep which Jehovah hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates according to all the desire of thy soul.

title: Deuteronomy 12:22
text: Even as the gazelle and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean alike may eat of them.

title: Deuteronomy 12:23
text: Only, be sure that thou eat not the blood; for the blood is the life, and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh;

title: Deuteronomy 12:24
text: thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water:

title: Deuteronomy 12:25
text: thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do what is right in the eyes of Jehovah.

title: Deuteronomy 12:26
text: But thy hallowed things which thou hast, and what thou hast vowed, thou shalt take, and come to the place which Jehovah will choose;

title: Deuteronomy 12:27
text: and thou shalt offer thy burnt-offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of Jehovah thy God; and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of Jehovah thy God, and the flesh shalt thou eat.

title: Deuteronomy 12:28
text: Take heed to hear all these words which I command thee, that it may be well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest what is good and right in the eyes of Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 12:29
text: When Jehovah thy God cutteth off from before thee the nations whither thou goest, to take possession of them, and thou hast dispossessed them, and dwellest in their land,

title: Deuteronomy 12:30
text: take heed to thyself that thou be not ensnared [to follow] after them, after that they are destroyed from before thee; and that thou inquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

title: Deuteronomy 12:31
text: Thou shalt not do so to Jehovah thy God; for every [thing that is] abomination to Jehovah, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters have they burned in the fire to their gods.

title: Deuteronomy 12:32
text: Everything that I command you, ye shall take heed to do it; thou shalt not add thereto, nor take from it.

title: Deuteronomy 13:1
text: ¶If there arise among you a prophet, or one that dreameth dreams, and he give thee a sign or a wonder,

title: Deuteronomy 13:2
text: and the sign or the wonder come to pass that he told unto thee, when he said, Let us go after other gods, whom thou hast not known, and let us serve them,

title: Deuteronomy 13:3
text: --thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams; for Jehovah your God proveth you, to know whether ye love Jehovah your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Deuteronomy 13:4
text: Ye shall walk after Jehovah your God, and ye shall fear him, and his commandments shall ye keep, and his voice shall ye hear; and ye shall serve him, and unto him shall ye cleave.

title: Deuteronomy 13:5
text: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; for he hath spoken revolt against Jehovah your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, --to draw thee out of the way that Jehovah thy God commanded thee to walk in; and thou shalt put evil away from thy midst.

title: Deuteronomy 13:6
text: ¶If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, who is to thee as thy soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods (whom thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 13:7
text: of the gods of the peoples which are round about you, near unto thee, or far from thee, from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth),

title: Deuteronomy 13:8
text: thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye spare him, neither shalt thou pity him, neither shalt thou screen him,

title: Deuteronomy 13:9
text: but thou shalt in any case kill him: thy hand shall be the first against him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people;

title: Deuteronomy 13:10
text: and thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; for he hath sought to draw thee away from Jehovah thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

title: Deuteronomy 13:11
text: and all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wicked thing as this in thy midst.

title: Deuteronomy 13:12
text: ¶If in one of thy cities, which Jehovah thy God hath given thee to dwell there, thou hearest, saying,

title: Deuteronomy 13:13
text: There are men, children of Belial, gone out from among you, and they have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, whom ye have not known;

title: Deuteronomy 13:14
text: then shalt thou inquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and if it be truth, [and] the thing be certain, that this abomination hath happened in the midst of thee,

title: Deuteronomy 13:15
text: thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, devoting it to destruction, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

title: Deuteronomy 13:16
text: And all the spoil of it shalt thou gather into the midst of the open place thereof, and shalt burn the city with fire, and all the spoil thereof, wholly to Jehovah thy God; and it shall be a heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

title: Deuteronomy 13:17
text: And thou shalt not let anything cleave to thy hand of the devoted thing; that Jehovah may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

title: Deuteronomy 13:18
text: when thou hearkenest to the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, that thou mayest do what is right in the eyes of Jehovah thy God.

title: Deuteronomy 14:1
text: ¶Ye are sons of Jehovah your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for a dead person.

title: Deuteronomy 14:2
text: For thou art a holy people unto Jehovah thy God, and thee hath Jehovah chosen for a people of possession unto himself, out of all the peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

title: Deuteronomy 14:3
text: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

title: Deuteronomy 14:4
text: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat;

title: Deuteronomy 14:5
text: the hart, and the gazelle, and the stag, and the wild goat, and the dishon and the oryx, and the wild sheep.

title: Deuteronomy 14:6
text: And every beast that hath cloven hoofs, and the feet quite split open into double hoofs, [and] which cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

title: Deuteronomy 14:7
text: Only these ye shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those with hoofs cloven and split open: the camel, and the hare, and the rock-badger; for they chew the cud, but have not cloven hoofs--they shall be unclean unto you;

title: Deuteronomy 14:8
