text: with him the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of Jehovah gave them:

title: Joshua 13:9
text: from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the ravine, and all the plateau of Medeba to Dibon,

title: Joshua 13:10
text: and all the cities of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who reigned at Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

title: Joshua 13:11
text: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and the whole of Bashan to Salcah;

title: Joshua 13:12
text: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned at Ashtaroth and at Edrei, who remained of the residue of the giants; and Moses smote them and dispossessed them.

title: Joshua 13:13
text: But the children of Israel did not dispossess the Geshurites nor the Maachathites; but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites to this day.

title: Joshua 13:14
text: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance: the offerings by fire of Jehovah the God of Israel are their inheritance, as he said to them.

title: Joshua 13:15
text: And Moses gave [a portion] to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

title: Joshua 13:16
text: And their territory was from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the ravine, and all the plateau by Medeba;

title: Joshua 13:17
text: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plateau, Dibon, and Bamoth-Baal, and Beth-Baal-meon,

title: Joshua 13:18
text: And Jahzah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

title: Joshua 13:19
text: and Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the mountain of the vale,

title: Joshua 13:20
text: and Beth-Peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth;

title: Joshua 13:21
text: all the cities of the plateau, and the whole kingdom of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who reigned at Heshbon, whom Moses smote, him and the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the chiefs of Sihon dwelling in the land.

title: Joshua 13:22
text: And Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, did the children of Israel kill with the sword among them that were slain by them.

title: Joshua 13:23
text: And the border of the children of Reuben was the Jordan, and [its] border. This is the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 13:24
text: And Moses gave [a portion] to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad according to their families.

title: Joshua 13:25
text: And their territory was Jaazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer which is before Rabbah;

title: Joshua 13:26
text: and from Heshbon to Ramath-Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

title: Joshua 13:27
text: and in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-Nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon the king of Heshbon, the Jordan and [its] border, as far as the edge of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

title: Joshua 13:28
text: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 13:29
text: And Moses gave [a portion] to half the tribe of Manasseh; and for half the tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families:

title: Joshua 13:30
text: their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, the whole kingdom of Og the king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

title: Joshua 13:31
text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, [belonged] to the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, to the one half of the children of Machir according to their families.

title: Joshua 13:32
text: This is that which Moses allotted for inheritance in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan of Jericho, eastward.

title: Joshua 13:33
text: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance: Jehovah the God of Israel is their inheritance, as he said to them.

title: Joshua 14:1
text: ¶And this is what the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, allotted for inheritance to them:

title: Joshua 14:2
text: their inheritance was by lot, as Jehovah had commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and the half tribe.

title: Joshua 14:3
text: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half tribe beyond the Jordan, but to the Levites he had given no inheritance among them.

title: Joshua 14:4
text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and they gave no part to the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, and their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

title: Joshua 14:5
text: As Jehovah had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

title: Joshua 14:6
text: ¶Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, Thou knowest the word that Jehovah spoke to Moses the man of God, concerning me and thee, in Kadesh-barnea.

title: Joshua 14:7
text: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of Jehovah sent me from Kadesh-barnea to search out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

title: Joshua 14:8
text: And my brethren that had gone up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Jehovah my God.

title: Joshua 14:9
text: And Moses swore on that day, saying, The land whereon thy feet have trodden shall assuredly be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever! for thou hast wholly followed Jehovah my God.

title: Joshua 14:10
text: And now behold, Jehovah has kept me alive, as he said, these forty-five years, since Jehovah spoke this word to Moses, when Israel wandered in the wilderness; and now behold, I am this day eighty-five years old.

title: Joshua 14:11
text: I am still this day strong, as in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out and to come in.

title: Joshua 14:12
text: And now give me this mountain, of which Jehovah spoke in that day; for thou heardest in that day that Anakim are there, and great fortified cities. If so be Jehovah shall be with me, then I shall dispossess them, as Jehovah said.

title: Joshua 14:13
text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

title: Joshua 14:14
text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he wholly followed Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: Joshua 14:15
text: Now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-Arba; the great man among the Anakim. And the land rested from war.

title: Joshua 15:1
text: ¶And the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was: to the border of Edom, the wilderness of Zin, southward, in the extreme south.

title: Joshua 15:2
text: And their southern border was from the end of the salt sea, from the tongue that turns southward;

title: Joshua 15:3
text: and it went out south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed on to Zin, and went up on the south of Kadesh-barnea, and passed to Hezron, and went up toward Addar, and turned toward Karkaah,

title: Joshua 15:4
text: and passed on to Azmon, and went out by the torrent of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. That shall be your border southward.

title: Joshua 15:5
text: --And the eastern border was the salt sea as far as the end of the Jordan. --And the border on the north side was from the tongue of the salt sea, at the end of the Jordan;

title: Joshua 15:6
text: and the border went up toward Beth-hoglah, and passed north of Beth-Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben;

title: Joshua 15:7
text: and the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and turned northward to Gilgal, which is opposite to the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the torrent; and the border passed to the waters of En-shemesh, and ended at En-rogel;

title: Joshua 15:8
text: and the border went up to the valley of the son of Hinnom, toward the south side of the Jebusite, that is, Jerusalem; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that is before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of Rephaim northward;

title: Joshua 15:9
text: and the border reached along from the top of the mountain toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out toward the cities of mount Ephron; and the border reached along to Baalah, that is, Kirjath-jearim;

title: Joshua 15:10
text: and the border turned from Baalah westwards toward mount Seir, and passed toward the side of Har-jearim, that is, Chesalon, northwards, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed Timnah.

title: Joshua 15:11
text: And the border went out to the side of Ekron northwards, and the border reached along toward Shicron, and passed mount Baalah, and went toward Jabneel; and the border ended at the sea.

title: Joshua 15:12
text: --And the west border is the great sea and [its] coast. This is the border of the children of Judah round about, according to their families.

title: Joshua 15:13
text: ¶And to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the children of Judah according to the commandment of Jehovah to Joshua, the city of Arba, the father of Anak, that is, Hebron.

title: Joshua 15:14
text: And thence Caleb dispossessed the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, who were born of Anak.

title: Joshua 15:15
text: And from there he went up against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.

title: Joshua 15:16
text: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjath-sepher and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter as wife.

title: Joshua 15:17
text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

title: Joshua 15:18
text: And it came to pass as she came, that she urged him to ask of her father a field; and she sprang down from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What wouldest thou?

title: Joshua 15:19
text: And she said, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a southern land; give me also springs of water. Then he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

title: Joshua 15:20
text: ¶This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

title: Joshua 15:21
text: The cities at the extremity of the tribe of the children of Judah, toward the border of Edom in the south, were: Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

title: Joshua 15:22
text: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

title: Joshua 15:23
text: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Jithnan,

title: Joshua 15:24
text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

title: Joshua 15:25
text: and Hazor-hadattah, and Kerioth-Hezron, that is Hazor,

title: Joshua 15:26
text: Amam, and Shema, and Molada,

title: Joshua 15:27
text: and Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-Pelet,

title: Joshua 15:28
text: and Hazar-Shual, and Beer-sheba, and Biziothiah;

title: Joshua 15:29
text: Baalah, and Ijim, and Ezem,

title: Joshua 15:30
text: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

title: Joshua 15:31
text: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansanna,

title: Joshua 15:32
text: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities twenty-nine, and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:33
text: --In the lowland: Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

title: Joshua 15:34
text: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah and Enam,

title: Joshua 15:35
text: Jarmuth and Adullam, Sochoh and Azekah,

title: Joshua 15:36
text: and Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim: fourteen cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:37
text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-Gad,

title: Joshua 15:38
text: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

title: Joshua 15:39
text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

title: Joshua 15:40
text: and Cabbon, and Lahmas, and Chithlish,

title: Joshua 15:41
text: and Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:42
text: Libna, and Ether, and Ashan,

title: Joshua 15:43
text: and Jiphthah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

title: Joshua 15:44
text: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah: nine cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:45
text: Ekron and its dependent villages and its hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:46
text: From Ekron and westward all that are by the side of Ashdod, and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:47
text: Ashdod, its dependent villages and its hamlets; Gazah, its dependent villages and its hamlets, as far as the torrent of Egypt, and the great sea and [its] coast.

title: Joshua 15:48
text: --And in the hill-country: Shamir, and Jattir, and Sochoh,

title: Joshua 15:49
text: and Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, that is, Debir,

title: Joshua 15:50
text: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

title: Joshua 15:51
text: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh: eleven cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:52
text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshan,

title: Joshua 15:53
text: and Janum, and Beth-Tappuah, and Aphekah,

title: Joshua 15:54
text: and Humtah, and Kirjath-Arba, that is, Hebron, and Zior: nine cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:55
text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Jutah,

title: Joshua 15:56
text: and Jizreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

title: Joshua 15:57
text: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah: ten cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:58
text: Halhul, Beth-Zur, and Gedor,

title: Joshua 15:59
text: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon: six cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:60
text: Kirjath-Baal, that is, Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah: two cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:61
text: --In the wilderness: Beth-Arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

title: Joshua 15:62
text: and Nibshan, and Ir-Hammelah, and En-gedi: six cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 15:63
text: But as for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not dispossess them; and the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

title: Joshua 16:1
text: ¶And the lot came forth for the children of Joseph from the Jordan of Jericho as far as the waters of Jericho eastwards, to the wilderness which goes up from Jericho to the hill-country of Bethel.

title: Joshua 16:2
text: And [the border] went from Bethel to Luz, and passed to the border of the Archites to Ataroth,

title: Joshua 16:3
text: and went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, as far as the border of the lower Beth-horon, and to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

title: Joshua 16:4
text: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

title: Joshua 16:5
text: ¶And the border of the children of Ephraim was according to their families; the border of their inheritance eastwards was Ataroth-Addar as far as the upper Beth-horon;

title: Joshua 16:6
text: and the border went forth westwards to Micmethath on the north; and the border turned eastwards to Taanath-Shiloh, and passed by it eastwards to Janohah,

title: Joshua 16:7
text: and went down from Janohah to Ataroth and Naarath, and touched upon Jericho, and went out to the Jordan.

title: Joshua 16:8
text: From Tappuah the border went westwards to the torrent Kanah, and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families,

title: Joshua 16:9
text: with the cities that were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 16:10
text: But they did not dispossess the Canaanites that dwelt at Gezer; and the Canaanites dwell in the midst of Ephraim to this day, and serve under tribute.

title: Joshua 17:1
text: ¶And the lot came to the tribe of Manasseh (for he was the firstborn of Joseph), to Machir, the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, for he was a man of war, and he had Gilead and Bashan.

title: Joshua 17:2
text: There was also [a portion] for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these are the children of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, the males, according to their families.

title: Joshua 17:3
text: And Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

title: Joshua 17:4
text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, Jehovah commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. And he gave them according to the commandment of Jehovah an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

title: Joshua 17:5
text: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which are beyond the Jordan.

title: Joshua 17:6
text: For the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons; and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.

title: Joshua 17:7
text: ¶And the territory of Manasseh was from Asher to Micmethath, which is before Shechem, and the border went on the right hand toward the inhabitants of En-Tappuah.

title: Joshua 17:8
text: Manasseh had the land of Tappuah; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

title: Joshua 17:9
text: And the border descended to the torrent Kanah, south of the torrent. These cities were Ephraim's among the cities of Manasseh. And the territory of Manasseh was on the north side of the torrent, and ended at the sea.

title: Joshua 17:10
text: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea was his border. And they touched upon Asher on the north, and upon Issachar on the east.

title: Joshua 17:11
text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher, Beth-shean and its dependent villages, and Ibleam and its dependent villages, and the inhabitants of Dor and its dependent villages, and the inhabitants of En-Dor and its dependent villages, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its dependent villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependent villages, the three hilly regions.

title: Joshua 17:12
text: But the children of Manasseh could not dispossess [the inhabitants of] those cities; and the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

title: Joshua 17:13
text: And it came to pass when the children of Israel were become strong, that they made the Canaanites tributary; but they did not utterly dispossess them.

title: Joshua 17:14
text: ¶And the children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me as inheritance one lot and one portion, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as Jehovah has blessed me hitherto?

title: Joshua 17:15
text: And Joshua said unto them, If thou art a great people, then get thee up to the wood, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if the hill-country of Ephraim is too narrow for thee.

title: Joshua 17:16
text: And the children of Joseph said, The hill-country will not be enough for us; and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, those that are of Beth-shean and its dependent villages, and those that are in the valley of Jizreel.

title: Joshua 17:17
text: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only,

title: Joshua 17:18
text: but the hill-country shall be thine, as it is a wood, thou shalt cut it down, and its outgoings shall be thine; for thou shalt dispossess the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots; for they are powerful.

title: Joshua 18:1
text: ¶And the whole assembly of the children of Israel gathered together at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there; and the land was subdued before them.

title: Joshua 18:2
text: ¶And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes whose inheritance had not been distributed to them.

title: Joshua 18:3
text: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, How long will ye shew yourselves slack to go to take possession of the land which Jehovah the God of your fathers hath given you?

title: Joshua 18:4
text: Provide you three men for a tribe; that I may send them, and they shall rise and go through the land, and describe it according to the proportion of their inheritance, and they shall come to me.

title: Joshua 18:5
text: And they shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their border on the north;

title: Joshua 18:6
text: and *ye* shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring [the description] hither to me, and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah our God.

title: Joshua 18:7
text: But the Levites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of Jehovah is their inheritance. And Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave them.

title: Joshua 18:8
text: And the men arose and went away. And Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah in Shiloh.

title: Joshua 18:9
text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven portions, in a book, and they came to Joshua, to the camp at Shiloh.

title: Joshua 18:10
text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Jehovah. And there Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

title: Joshua 18:11
text: ¶And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. And the territory of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

title: Joshua 18:12
text: And their border on the north side was from the Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up to the mountain westward; and ended at the wilderness of Beth-Aven;

title: Joshua 18:13
text: and the border passed on from thence toward Luz, to the south side of Luz, which is Bethel: and the border went down to Ataroth-Addar, near the hill that is on the south of the lower Beth-horon.

title: Joshua 18:14
text: --And the border reached along and turned on the west side, southward from the hill that is before Beth-horon southward; and ended at Kirjath-Baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this is the west side.

title: Joshua 18:15
text: --And the south side was from the extreme end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

title: Joshua 18:16
text: And the border went down to the end of the mountain that is before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim on the north, and went down the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite on the south, and went down to En-rogel;

title: Joshua 18:17
text: and it reached along on the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth towards Geliloth, which is opposite to the ascent of Adummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben,

title: Joshua 18:18
text: and passed along towards the side opposite to Arabah northwards, and went down to Arabah;

title: Joshua 18:19
text: and the border passed on to the side of Beth-hoglah on the north, and the border ended at the tongue of the salt sea northward, at the south end of the Jordan: this is the southern border.

title: Joshua 18:20
text: --And the Jordan borders it on the east side. --This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, according to its borders round about, according to their families.

title: Joshua 18:21
text: And the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were: Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and Emek-Keziz,

title: Joshua 18:22
text: and Beth-Arabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

title: Joshua 18:23
text: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

title: Joshua 18:24
text: and Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Geba: twelve cities and their hamlets;

title: Joshua 18:25
text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

title: Joshua 18:26
text: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

title: Joshua 18:27
text: and Rekem, and Jirpeel, and Tharalah,

title: Joshua 18:28
text: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, that is, Jerusalem, Gibeah, Kirjath: fourteen cities and their hamlets. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:1
text: ¶And the second lot came forth to Simeon, for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families; and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

title: Joshua 19:2
text: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,

title: Joshua 19:3
text: and Hazar-Shual, and Balah, and Ezem,

title: Joshua 19:4
text: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

title: Joshua 19:5
text: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

title: Joshua 19:6
text: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen: thirteen cities and their hamlets;

title: Joshua 19:7
text: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan: four cities and their hamlets;

title: Joshua 19:8
text: and all the hamlets that are round these cities to Baalath-beer, [that is] Ramah of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:9
text: Out of the lot of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too great for them, and the children of Simeon inherited within their inheritance.

title: Joshua 19:10
text: ¶And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. And the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid;

title: Joshua 19:11
text: and their border went up westwards, and [to] Marealah, and reached to Dabbesheth, and reached to the torrent that is before Jokneam;

title: Joshua 19:12
text: and turned from Sarid eastward, toward the sun-rising, to the border of Chisloth-Tabor, and went out to Dabrath, and went up to Japhia;

title: Joshua 19:13
text: and from thence it passed eastward toward the sun-rising to Gath-Hepher, to Eth-kazin, and went out to Rimmon which reaches to Neah;

title: Joshua 19:14
text: and the border turned round it northwards to Hannathon: and ended in the valley of Jiphthah-el; ...

title: Joshua 19:15
text: and Kattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Jidalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:16
text: This was the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:17
text: ¶The fourth lot came forth to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:18
text: And their territory was toward Jizreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

title: Joshua 19:19
text: and Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

title: Joshua 19:20
text: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Ebez,

title: Joshua 19:21
text: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

title: Joshua 19:22
text: and the border reached to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:23
text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:24
text: ¶And the fifth lot came forth for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:25
text: And their territory was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Acshaph,

title: Joshua 19:26
text: and Allammelech, and Amead, and Mishal; and [the border] reached to Carmel westwards, and to Shihor-libnath,

title: Joshua 19:27
text: and turned towards the sun-rising to Beth-Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el northward [to] Beth-emek and Neiel, and went out to Cabul on the left,

title: Joshua 19:28
text: and Ebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, as far as great Zidon;

title: Joshua 19:29
text: and the border turned to Ramah, and as far as the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah; and ended at the sea by the tract of country of Achzib;

title: Joshua 19:30
text: and Ummah, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:31
text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:32
text: ¶The sixth lot came forth to the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:33
text: And their border was from Heleph, from the oak of Zaanannim; and Adami-nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum; and ended at the Jordan;

title: Joshua 19:34
text: and the border turned westwards to Aznoth-Tabor, and went out from thence to Hukkok, and reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah upon Jordan towards the sun-rising.

title: Joshua 19:35
text: And the fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

title: Joshua 19:36
text: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

title: Joshua 19:37
text: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-Hazor,

title: Joshua 19:38
text: and Jiron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh: nineteen cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:39
text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:40
text: ¶The seventh lot came forth for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

title: Joshua 19:41
text: And the territory of their inheritance was Zoreah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

title: Joshua 19:42
text: and Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jithlah,

title: Joshua 19:43
text: and Elon, and Timnathah, and Ekron,

title: Joshua 19:44
text: and El-tekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

title: Joshua 19:45
text: and Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gath-Rimmon,

title: Joshua 19:46
text: and Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border over against Japho.

title: Joshua 19:47
text: And the border of the children of Dan ended with these; and the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and took possession of it, and dwelt in it, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

title: Joshua 19:48
text: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities and their hamlets.

title: Joshua 19:49
text: ¶And they ended dividing the land for inheritance according to its borders. And the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

title: Joshua 19:50
text: According to the word of Jehovah they gave him the city that he asked, Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and dwelt in it.

title: Joshua 19:51
text: These were the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed by lot in Shiloh before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. And they ended dividing the land.

title: Joshua 20:1
text: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Joshua, saying,

title: Joshua 20:2
text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint for yourselves the cities of refuge, whereof I spoke unto you through Moses,

title: Joshua 20:3
text: that the slayer who unwittingly without intent smiteth any one mortally may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

title: Joshua 20:4
text: And he shall flee unto one of those cities and stand at the entrance of the city-gate, and shall declare his matter in the ears of the elders of that city; and they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

title: Joshua 20:5
text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; for he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not previously.

title: Joshua 20:6
text: And he shall dwell in that city, until he have stood before the assembly in judgment, until the death of the high-priest that shall be in those days; then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

title: Joshua 20:7
text: ¶And they hallowed Kedesh in Galilee in the hill-country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Kirjath-Arba, that is, Hebron, in the hill-country of Judah.

title: Joshua 20:8
text: And beyond the Jordan from Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness, in the plateau, out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan of the tribe of Manasseh.

title: Joshua 20:9
text: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever smiteth any one mortally without intent might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the assembly.

title: Joshua 21:1
text: ¶Then the chief fathers of the Levites drew near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

title: Joshua 21:2
text: and they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, Jehovah commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, and their suburbs for our cattle.

title: Joshua 21:3
text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the word of Jehovah, these cities and their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:4
text: And the lot came forth for the families of the Kohathites. And the children of Aaron the priest, of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:5
text: And the children of Kohath that remained had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

title: Joshua 21:6
text: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

title: Joshua 21:7
text: The children of Merari according to their families had by lot out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

title: Joshua 21:8
text: And the children of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities and their suburbs, as Jehovah commanded through Moses.

title: Joshua 21:9
text: ¶And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which were mentioned by name,

title: Joshua 21:10
text: and which the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, of the children of Levi had (for theirs was the first lot);

title: Joshua 21:11
text: and they gave them Kirjath-Arba, [which Arba was] the father of Anak, that is, Hebron, in the mountain of Judah, with its suburbs round about it.

title: Joshua 21:12
text: But the fields of the city and the hamlets thereof gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

title: Joshua 21:13
text: And they gave to the children of Aaron the priest the city of refuge for the slayer, Hebron and its suburbs; and Libnah and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:14
text: and Jattir and its suburbs, and Eshtemoa and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:15
text: and Holon and its suburbs, and Debir and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:16
text: and Ain and its suburbs, and Juttah and its suburbs, [and] Beth-shemesh and its suburbs: nine cities out of those two tribes;

title: Joshua 21:17
text: and out of the tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon and its suburbs, Geba and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:18
text: Anathoth and its suburbs, and Almon and its suburbs; four cities.

title: Joshua 21:19
text: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities and their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:20
text: And to the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites that remained of the children of Kohath, [they gave cities]. And the cities of their lot were out of the tribe of Ephraim,

title: Joshua 21:21
text: and they gave them the city of refuge for the slayer, Shechem and its suburbs in mount Ephraim; and Gezer and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:22
text: and Kibzaim and its suburbs, and Beth-horon and its suburbs: four cities;

title: Joshua 21:23
text: and out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh and its suburbs, Gibbethon and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:24
text: Ajalon and its suburbs, Gath-Rimmon and its suburbs: four cities;

title: Joshua 21:25
text: and out of half the tribe of Manasseh, Taanach and its suburbs and Gath-Rimmon and its suburbs: two cities.

title: Joshua 21:26
text: All the cities were ten and their suburbs, for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

title: Joshua 21:27
text: And to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of half the tribe of Manasseh, [they gave] the city of refuge for the slayer, Golan in Bashan and its suburbs; and Beeshterah and its suburbs: two cities;

title: Joshua 21:28
text: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion and its suburbs, Dabrath and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:29
text: Jarmuth and its suburbs, En-gannim and its suburbs: four cities;

title: Joshua 21:30
text: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal and its suburbs, Abdon and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:31
text: Helkath and its suburbs, and Rehob and its suburbs: four cities;

title: Joshua 21:32
text: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, the city of refuge for the slayer, Kedesh in Galilee, and its suburbs; and Hammoth-Dor and its suburbs, and Kartan and its suburbs: three cities.

title: Joshua 21:33
text: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities and their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:34
text: And to the families of the children of Merari, that remained of the Levites, [they gave] out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam and its suburbs, Kartah and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:35
text: Dimnah and its suburbs, Nahalal and its suburbs: four cities;

title: Joshua 21:36
text: and out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and its suburbs, and Jahzah and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:37
text: Kedemoth and its suburbs, and Mephaath and its suburbs: four cities;

title: Joshua 21:38
text: and out of the tribe of Gad, the city of refuge for the slayer, Ramoth in Gilead and its suburbs; and Mahanaim and its suburbs,

title: Joshua 21:39
text: Heshbon and its suburbs, Jaazer and its suburbs: four cities in all.

title: Joshua 21:40
text: [These were] all the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, which remained of the families of the Levites, and their lot was twelve cities.

title: Joshua 21:41
text: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities and their suburbs.

title: Joshua 21:42
text: Each one of these cities had its suburbs round about it: thus were all these cities.

title: Joshua 21:43
text: ¶And Jehovah gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give unto their fathers; and they took possession of it, and dwelt in it.

title: Joshua 21:44
text: And Jehovah gave them rest round about, according to all that he had sworn unto their fathers; and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them: Jehovah gave all their enemies into their hand.

title: Joshua 21:45
text: There failed nothing of all the good things that Jehovah had spoken to the house of Israel: all came to pass.

title: Joshua 22:1
text: ¶Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

title: Joshua 22:2
text: and said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you, and have hearkened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

title: Joshua 22:3
text: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, and ye have kept the charge of the commandment of Jehovah your God.

title: Joshua 22:4
text: And now Jehovah your God hath given rest to your brethren, as he said unto them; and now return, and get you unto your tents, unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave you beyond the Jordan.

title: Joshua 22:5
text: Only, take great heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded you, to love Jehovah your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

title: Joshua 22:6
text: And Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

title: Joshua 22:7
text: And to half the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given [inheritance] in Bashan, and to the other half thereof had Joshua given among their brethren on this side the Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them also,

title: Joshua 22:8
text: and spoke to them, saying, Return unto your tents with much wealth and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with copper, and with iron, and with clothing, in very great quantity; divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

title: Joshua 22:9
text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the country of Gilead, into the land of their possession, of which they had become possessed, according to the word of Jehovah through Moses.

title: Joshua 22:10
text: ¶And they came to the districts of the Jordan that are in the land of Canaan; and the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, an altar of grand appearance.

title: Joshua 22:11
text: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the districts of the Jordan, separately from the children of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:12
text: And when the children of Israel heard [of it], the whole assembly of the children of Israel gathered together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

title: Joshua 22:13
text: And the children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

title: Joshua 22:14
text: and with him ten princes, of each father's house a prince, out of all the tribes of Israel; and each of them was head of a father's house, of the thousands of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:15
text: And they came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and spoke with them, saying,

title: Joshua 22:16
text: Thus saith the whole assembly of Jehovah: What wickedness is this which ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following Jehovah, in that ye have built yourselves an altar, rebelling this day against Jehovah?

title: Joshua 22:17
text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us? from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the assembly of Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:18
text: And ye turn away this day from following Jehovah; and it will be, that since ye rebel this day against Jehovah, to-morrow he will be wroth with the whole assembly of Israel.

title: Joshua 22:19
text: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession is unclean, come over into the land of the possession of Jehovah, where Jehovah's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession amongst us; but rebel not against Jehovah, and rebel not against us, in building for yourselves an altar besides the altar of Jehovah our God.

title: Joshua 22:20
text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing? and wrath fell on all the assembly of Israel, and he perished not alone in his iniquity.

title: Joshua 22:21
text: ¶And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered and said to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

title: Joshua 22:22
text: The *God of gods, Jehovah, the *God of gods, Jehovah, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know [it]; if it is in rebellion, or if in trespass against Jehovah, --save us not this day!

title: Joshua 22:23
text: --that we have built for ourselves an altar to turn from following Jehovah, and if it is to offer up burnt-offering and oblation on it, and if to offer peace-offerings thereon, let Jehovah himself require it [from us];

title: Joshua 22:24
text: and if we have not done it from fear of this thing, saying, In future your children will speak to our children, saying, What have ye to do with Jehovah the God of Israel?

title: Joshua 22:25
text: Jehovah hath made the Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad, ye have no portion in Jehovah! And so shall your children make our children cease from fearing Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:26
text: And we said, Let us now set to work to build an altar, not for burnt-offering, nor for sacrifice,

title: Joshua 22:27
text: but to be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we might do service to Jehovah before him with our burnt-offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace-offerings; that your children may not say to our children in future, Ye have no portion in Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:28
text: And we said, If it shall be that in future they so say to us and to our generations, we will say, Behold the pattern of the altar of Jehovah which our fathers made, not for burnt-offering, nor for sacrifice, but as a witness between us and you.

title: Joshua 22:29
text: Far be it from us that we should rebel against Jehovah, and turn this day from following Jehovah, in building an altar for burnt-offering, for oblation, and for sacrifice, besides the altar of Jehovah our God that is before his tabernacle.

title: Joshua 22:30
text: ¶And when Phinehas the priest and the princes of the assembly and the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it was good in their sight.

title: Joshua 22:31
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that Jehovah is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against Jehovah: now have ye delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of Jehovah.

title: Joshua 22:32
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

title: Joshua 22:33
text: And the thing was good in the sight of the children of Israel, and the children of Israel blessed God, and no more said that they would go up in warfare against them, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad dwelt.

title: Joshua 22:34
text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad gave a name to the altar; for it is a witness between us that Jehovah is God.

title: Joshua 23:1
text: ¶And it came to pass a long time after that Jehovah had given rest to Israel from all their enemies round about, and Joshua had become old, advanced in age,

title: Joshua 23:2
text: that Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am become old, advanced in age;

title: Joshua 23:3
text: and ye have seen all that Jehovah your God hath done to all these nations because of you. For Jehovah your God is he that hath fought for you.

title: Joshua 23:4
text: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot for an inheritance, according to your tribes, these nations that remain, from the Jordan, as well as all the nations that I have cut off, as far as the great sea toward the sun-setting.

title: Joshua 23:5
text: And Jehovah your God, he will expel them from before you, and dispossess them from out of your sight; and ye shall take possession of their land, as Jehovah your God hath said unto you.

title: Joshua 23:6
text: And be ye very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

title: Joshua 23:7
text: that ye enter not among these nations, these that remain among you; and ye shall make no mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear [by them], neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them;

title: Joshua 23:8
text: but ye shall cleave unto Jehovah your God, as ye have done unto this day.

title: Joshua 23:9
text: For Jehovah hath dispossessed from before you great and strong nations; and as to you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

title: Joshua 23:10
text: One man of you chaseth a thousand; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath said unto you.

title: Joshua 23:11
text: ¶Take great heed therefore unto your souls, that ye love Jehovah your God.

title: Joshua 23:12
text: For if ye in any wise go back, and cleave unto the residue of these nations, these that remain among you, and make marriages with them, and come in unto them and they unto you:

title: Joshua 23:13
text: know for a certainty that Jehovah your God will no more dispossess these nations from before you, and they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which Jehovah your God hath given you.

title: Joshua 23:14
text: And behold, I am going this day the way of all the earth; and ye know in all your heart, and in all your soul, that not one thing hath failed of all the good words that Jehovah your God hath spoken concerning you: all are come to pass unto you--not one thing hath failed thereof.

title: Joshua 23:15
text: But it shall come to pass, that as every good word hath been fulfilled to you, that Jehovah your God spoke to you, so will Jehovah bring upon you every evil word, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which Jehovah your God hath given you;

title: Joshua 23:16
text: when ye transgress the covenant of Jehovah your God which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow yourselves unto them, so that the anger of Jehovah shall be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

title: Joshua 24:1
text: ¶And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

title: Joshua 24:2
text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel: Your fathers dwelt of old on the other side of the river, Terah, the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor, and they served other gods.

title: Joshua 24:3
text: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the river, and led him throughout the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.

title: Joshua 24:4
text: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau; and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; and Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt.

title: Joshua 24:5
text: And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them; and afterwards I brought you out.

title: Joshua 24:6
text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt, and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

title: Joshua 24:7
text: Then they cried to Jehovah, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt; and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long time.

title: Joshua 24:8
text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, who dwelt beyond the Jordan, and they fought with you, and I gave them into your hand, and ye took possession of their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

title: Joshua 24:9
text: And Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you;

title: Joshua 24:10
text: but I would not hearken unto Balaam, and he blessed you expressly, and I delivered you out of his hand.

title: Joshua 24:11
text: And ye went over the Jordan, and came unto Jericho, and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

title: Joshua 24:12
text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, [as] the two kings of the Amorites; not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

title: Joshua 24:13
text: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

title: Joshua 24:14
text: And now fear Jehovah and serve him in perfectness and in truth; and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the river, and in Egypt; and serve Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:15
text: ¶And if it seem evil unto you to serve Jehovah, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods whom your fathers that were on the other side of the river served, or the gods of the Amorite, in whose land ye dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:16
text: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us that we should forsake Jehovah, to serve other gods;

title: Joshua 24:17
text: for Jehovah our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs before our eyes, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the peoples through whom we passed!

title: Joshua 24:18
text: And Jehovah drove out from before us all the peoples, and the Amorites the inhabitants of the land: so therefore we will serve Jehovah, for he is our God.

title: Joshua 24:19
text: And Joshua said to the people, Ye cannot serve Jehovah, for he is a holy God; he is a jealous *God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

title: Joshua 24:20
text: If ye forsake Jehovah, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

title: Joshua 24:21
text: And the people said to Joshua, No; but we will serve Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:22
text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you Jehovah, to serve him. And they said, [We are] witnesses.

title: Joshua 24:23
text: Now therefore put away the strange gods that are among you, and incline your heart unto Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: Joshua 24:24
text: And the people said unto Joshua, Jehovah our God will we serve, and to his voice will we hearken.

title: Joshua 24:25
text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

title: Joshua 24:26
text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Jehovah.

title: Joshua 24:27
text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us, for it hath heard all the words of Jehovah which he spoke unto us; and it shall be a witness against you, lest ye deny your God.

title: Joshua 24:28
text: And Joshua dismissed the people, every man to his inheritance.

title: Joshua 24:29
text: ¶And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, died, a hundred and ten years old.

title: Joshua 24:30
text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the mountain of Gaash.

title: Joshua 24:31
text: And Israel served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders whose days were prolonged after Joshua, and who had known all the works of Jehovah, which he had done for Israel.

title: Joshua 24:32
text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel had brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem in the portion of the field which Jacob had bought of the sons of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred kesitahs; and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

title: Joshua 24:33
text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which had been given him in mount Ephraim.

title: Judges 1:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after the death of Joshua that the children of Israel asked Jehovah, saying, Which of us shall go up against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

title: Judges 1:2
text: And Jehovah said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

title: Judges 1:3
text: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, and let us fight against the Canaanites, and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot; and Simeon went with him.

title: Judges 1:4
text: And Judah went up; and Jehovah delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand, and they smote them in Bezek, ten thousand men.

title: Judges 1:5
text: And they found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and fought against him, and they smote the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

title: Judges 1:6
text: And Adoni-Bezek fled, and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

title: Judges 1:7
text: And Adoni-Bezek said, Seventy kings, with their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gleaned under my table: as I have done, so God has requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

title: Judges 1:8
text: And the children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

title: Judges 1:9
text: ¶And afterwards the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the hill-country, and in the south, and in the lowland.

title: Judges 1:10
text: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron--the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-Arba; and they slew Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.

title: Judges 1:11
text: And from there he went against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.

title: Judges 1:12
text: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjath-sepher and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter as wife.

title: Judges 1:13
text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

title: Judges 1:14
text: And it came to pass as she came, that she urged him to ask of her father the field; and she sprang down from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What wouldest thou?

title: Judges 1:15
text: And she said to him, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a southern land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

title: Judges 1:16
text: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, had gone up out of the city of palm-trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt with the people.

title: Judges 1:17
text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it; and they called the name of the city Hormah.

title: Judges 1:18
text: And Judah took Gazah and its border, and Ashkelon and its border, and Ekron and its border.

title: Judges 1:19
text: And Jehovah was with Judah; and he took possession of the hill-country, for he did not dispossess the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

title: Judges 1:20
text: And they gave to Caleb Hebron, as Moses had said; and he dispossessed from thence the three sons of Anak.

title: Judges 1:21
text: ¶And the children of Benjamin did not dispossess the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

title: Judges 1:22
text: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel; and Jehovah was with them.

title: Judges 1:23
text: And the house of Joseph sent to search out Bethel; now the name of the city before was Luz.

title: Judges 1:24
text: And the guards saw a man come forth out of the city, and said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, how [we] may enter into the city, and we will shew thee kindness.

title: Judges 1:25
text: And he shewed them how to enter into the city. And they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

title: Judges 1:26
text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

title: Judges 1:27
text: And Manasseh did not dispossess Beth-shean and its dependent villages, nor Taanach and its dependent villages, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its dependent villages, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its dependent villages, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependent villages; and the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

title: Judges 1:28
text: And it came to pass when Israel became strong, that they made the Canaanites tributary; but they did not utterly dispossess them.

title: Judges 1:29
text: And Ephraim did not dispossess the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt among them in Gezer.

title: Judges 1:30
text: Zebulun did not dispossess the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

title: Judges 1:31
text: Asher did not dispossess the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor Ahlab, nor Achzib, nor Helbah, nor Aphik, nor Rehob;

title: Judges 1:32
text: and the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not dispossess them.

title: Judges 1:33
text: Naphtali did not dispossess the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; and he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries to them.

title: Judges 1:34
text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill-country, for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley.

title: Judges 1:35
text: And the Amorites would dwell on mount Heres, in Ajalon and in Shaalbim; but the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, and they became tributaries.

title: Judges 1:36
text: And the border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upwards.

title: Judges 2:1
text: ¶And the Angel of Jehovah came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you; and as for you,

title: Judges 2:2
text: ye shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not hearkened unto my voice. Why have ye done this?
